---@id 3bc23bad-e7bc-4505-bab5-ae250175a9cd
---@referenceName ModuleRoot_SwingPivot_ms-swing-motion.lua
-- 控制秋千自然前后摆动，并把鼠标拖拽转化为推力；脚本不接管或移动相机。
---@start
---@var MaxSwingAngle:number=30
---@name 最大摆动角度
---@desc 秋千前后摆动的角度上限
---@range 4,40,1
---@group 摆动
---@var SpringStrength:number=5.6
---@name 回摆力度
---@desc 数值越大，秋千越快回到中心
---@range 1,12,0.1
---@group 摆动
---@var Damping:number=0.44
---@name 空气阻尼
---@desc 数值越大，摆动越快停下
---@range 0.05,2,0.05
---@group 摆动
---@var IdleImpulse:number=0.38
---@name 微风摆动
---@desc 无人推动时保留的温柔微摆力度
---@range 0,1.2,0.02
---@group 摆动
---@var MousePushPower:number=0.085
---@name 鼠标推动力度
---@desc 鼠标上下拖拽转化为秋千速度的倍率
---@range 0,0.16,0.005
---@group 摆动
---@var CancelCameraCollisionFeedback:boolean=true
---@name 取消相机碰撞反馈
---@desc 鼠标拖动秋千时临时吞掉拖拽轴输入，并关闭实体碰撞，避免相机被拖拽或碰撞顶动
---@group 摆动
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local Input = CS.UnityEngine.Input

local target = nil
local angle = 0
local angularVelocity = 0
local dragActive = false
local lastMouseY = 0
local idlePhase = 0

local function clamp(v, minValue, maxValue)
  if v < minValue then return minValue end
  if v > maxValue then return maxValue end
  return v
end

local function updateMouseDrag()
  if Input == nil then return end

  if Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0) then
    dragActive = true
    lastMouseY = Input.mousePosition.y
    return
  end

  if dragActive and Input.GetMouseButton(0) then
    local mouseY = Input.mousePosition.y
    local deltaY = mouseY - lastMouseY
    lastMouseY = mouseY
    angularVelocity = angularVelocity + deltaY * MousePushPower
    angularVelocity = clamp(angularVelocity, -145, 145)
    if CancelCameraCollisionFeedback and Input.ResetInputAxes ~= nil then
      Input.ResetInputAxes()
    end
    return
  end

  if dragActive and Input.GetMouseButtonUp(0) then
    dragActive = false
  end
end

function Start()
  target = self.transform
end

function Update()
  if target == nil then return end

  local dt = Time.deltaTime
  if dt <= 0 then return end

  updateMouseDrag()

  idlePhase = idlePhase + dt * 0.85
  local idleForce = math.sin(idlePhase) * IdleImpulse
  angularVelocity = angularVelocity + (-angle * SpringStrength + idleForce) * dt
  angularVelocity = angularVelocity * math.exp(-Damping * dt)
  angle = angle + angularVelocity * dt

  local maxAngle = math.abs(MaxSwingAngle)
  if angle > maxAngle then
    angle = maxAngle
    angularVelocity = math.min(angularVelocity, 0)
  elseif angle < -maxAngle then
    angle = -maxAngle
    angularVelocity = math.max(angularVelocity, 0)
  end

  target.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(angle, 0, 0)
end

00dd5557-b291-4218-9e73-93a547bc8741.content:
---@id 00dd5557-b291-4218-9e73-93a547bc8741
---@referenceName ModuleRoot_SwingPivot_HangingAssembly_Bench_RightSeatSocket_pi-seat.lua
-- 右侧座位：靠近显示入座按钮，坐下后随秋千摆动并可起身离开。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@range 1,10,0.1
---@group 交互
---@var enterSeatText:string="坐右侧秋千"
---@name 入座文案
---@desc 座位空闲时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@var exitSeatText:string="离开秋千"
---@name 离座文案
---@desc 本地玩家落座后交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local seatAnchorPath = "ModuleRoot/SwingPivot/HangingAssembly/Bench/RightSeatSocket/SeatAnchor"
local standUpAnchorPath = "ModuleRoot/RightStandSocket/StandUpAnchor"
local seatTrans = nil
local standUpTrans = nil
local localActor = nil
local currentPlayer = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local interactionButton = nil
local JoyStickControlMain = nil
local savedBoardOffset = nil
local savedBoardRotation = nil
local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local ownershipPending = false

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end
  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true
  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

function resolveSeatTrans()
  return seatTrans
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or target == nil then return end
  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local orig = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local p = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(orig.x / p.x, orig.y / p.y, orig.z / p.z)

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end
  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end
  local hipsPos = hips.position
  local transPos = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    transPos.x - (hipsPos.x - transPos.x),
    transPos.y - (hipsPos.y - transPos.y),
    transPos.z - (hipsPos.z - transPos.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = enabled
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  actor.gameObject.transform:SetParent(nil)
  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    actor.gameObject.transform.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end
  if standUpTrans ~= nil then
    actor.position = standUpTrans.position
    actor.rotation = standUpTrans.rotation
  elseif savedBoardOffset ~= nil then
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + savedBoardOffset.x,
      self.transform.position.y + savedBoardOffset.y,
      self.transform.position.z + savedBoardOffset.z
    )
    actor.rotation = savedBoardRotation
    savedBoardOffset = nil
    savedBoardRotation = nil
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(self.transform.position.x + right.x, self.transform.position.y, self.transform.position.z + right.z)
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    seatTrans = runtimeScope:FindTransform(seatAnchorPath)
    standUpTrans = runtimeScope:FindTransform(standUpAnchorPath)
  end
  JoyStickControlMain = CS.DouyinUIService.GetJoyStickControl(CS.UIType.MoveJoyStick)
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OnUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OffUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end
  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end
  if currentPlayer ~= actor then
    localActor = nil
    self:DisableInteraction()
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if hasPassenger then
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  else
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end
  ensureOwnership(function()
    if hasPassenger or currentPlayer == localActor then
      localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
    else
      if seatTrans == nil then return end
      localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasPassenger = false
      setButtonText(enterSeatText)
    end
    return
  end
  if actor.isLocal then
    local actorPos = actor.gameObject.transform.position
    local selfPos = self.transform.position
    savedBoardOffset = UnityEngine.Vector3(actorPos.x - selfPos.x, actorPos.y - selfPos.y, actorPos.z - selfPos.z)
    savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    currentPlayer = actor
    hasPassenger = true
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  end
  savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    currentPlayer = nil
    hasPassenger = false
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(eventData)
  local localPlayer = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if localPlayer == nil or currentPlayer ~= localPlayer then return end
  localPlayer:StandUp(self.gameObject)
end

      if seatTrans == nil then return end
      localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasPassenger = false
      setButtonText(enterSeatText)
    end
    return
  end
  if actor.isLocal then
    local actorPos = actor.gameObject.transform.position
    local selfPos = self.transform.position
    savedBoardOffset = UnityEngine.Vector3(actorPos.x - selfPos.x, actorPos.y - selfPos.y, actorPos.z - selfPos.z)
    savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    currentPlayer = actor
    hasPassenger = true
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  end
  savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    currentPlayer = nil
    hasPassenger = false
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(eventData)
  local localPlayer = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if localPlayer == nil or currentPlayer ~= localPlayer then return end
  localPlayer:StandUp(self.gameObject)
end

-- 玩家接触传送石板后立即回到出生点。
local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 0.75
local lastTeleportAt = -9999
local warnedFallback = false

local function getActorGameObject(actor)
  if actor == nil then return nil end
  local okGo, actorGo = pcall(function()
    return actor.gameObject
  end)
  if okGo and actorGo ~= nil then return actorGo end
  return nil
end

local function getActorTransform(actor)
  if actor == nil then return nil end
  local actorGo = getActorGameObject(actor)
  if actorGo ~= nil then
    return actorGo.transform
  end

  local okTrans, actorTrans = pcall(function()
    return actor.transform
  end)
  if okTrans and actorTrans ~= nil then return actorTrans end

  return nil
end

local function tryActorNoArgMethod(actor, methodName)
  if actor == nil or methodName == nil then return false end

  local okLookup, method = pcall(function()
    return actor[methodName]
  end)
  if not okLookup or method == nil then return false end

  local okCall = pcall(function()
    method(actor)
  end)
  return okCall
end

local function findSpawnTransform()
  local names = {
    "SpawnPoint",
    "PlayerSpawnPoint",
    "PlayerSpawn",
    "BirthPoint",
    "StartPoint",
    "出生点"
  }

  for i = 1, #names do
    local found = UnityEngine.GameObject.Find(names[i])
    if found ~= nil then
      return found.transform
    end
  end

  return nil
end

local function resetActorVelocity(actor)
  local actorGo = getActorGameObject(actor)
  if actorGo == nil then return end

  local rb = actorGo:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  if rb ~= nil then
    rb.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
    rb.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
  end
end

local function teleportByKnownActorApi(actor)
  local actorMethods = {
    "TeleportToSpawnPoint",
    "TeleportToSpawn",
    "ReturnToSpawnPoint",
    "ResetToSpawnPoint",
    "Respawn"
  }

  for i = 1, #actorMethods do
    if tryActorNoArgMethod(actor, actorMethods[i]) then
      return true
    end
  end

  return false
end

local function teleportByTransformFallback(actor)
  local actorTrans = getActorTransform(actor)
  if actorTrans == nil then
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("Spawn teleport slab could not find actor transform.")
    return false
  end

  local spawnTrans = findSpawnTransform()
  if spawnTrans ~= nil then
    actorTrans.position = spawnTrans.position
    actorTrans.rotation = spawnTrans.rotation
  else
    actorTrans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 1, 0)
    if not warnedFallback then
      UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("Spawn teleport slab used world origin fallback because no spawn transform was found.")
      warnedFallback = true
    end
  end

  resetActorVelocity(actor)
  return true
end

local function teleportActorToSpawn(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if teleportByKnownActorApi(actor) then
    resetActorVelocity(actor)
    return
  end

  teleportByTransformFallback(actor)
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil then
    return
  end
  if actor.isLocal == false then
    return
  end

  local now = Time.time
  if now - lastTeleportAt < TELEPORT_COOLDOWN then
    return
  end
  lastTeleportAt = now

  teleportActorToSpawn(actor)
end

---@id 8364fbf8-4135-4d3b-a5fe-9cba2a119639

-- 监控足球场出界、进球、比分与记分牌，并在短暂延迟后将足球回位
local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local DouyinUtility = CS.DouyinUtility

local FOOTBALL_NAME = "足球"
local BLUE_TEAM_PREFIX = "蓝队_"
local RED_TEAM_PREFIX = "红队_"
local DISCOVERY_INTERVAL = 1.0
local TOUCHER_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL = 0.5
local OUT_OF_BOUNDS_RESET_DELAY = 1.0
local RESET_COOLDOWN = 0.25
local THROW_IN_INSET = 1.0
local CORNER_INSET = 1.0
local DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH = 52.5
local DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_WIDTH = 34.0
local DEFAULT_GOAL_MOUTH_HALF_WIDTH = 3.57
local DEFAULT_GOAL_INTERIOR_HEIGHT = 2.26
local DEFAULT_GOAL_INTERIOR_DEPTH = 2.16
local DEFAULT_GOAL_AREA_DEPTH = 5.5
local DEFAULT_RESET_LOCAL_Y = 0.6
local TOUCH_TRACK_RADIUS = 2.2
local TOUCH_TRACK_RADIUS_SQR = TOUCH_TRACK_RADIUS * TOUCH_TRACK_RADIUS
local TOUCH_VERTICAL_TOLERANCE = 2.5
local LAST_TOUCH_MEMORY_DURATION = 5.0
local POSITION_EPSILON = 0.0001
local GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON = 0.02
local DIGIT_SEGMENT_NAMES = { "SegmentA", "SegmentB", "SegmentC", "SegmentD", "SegmentE", "SegmentF", "SegmentG" }
local DIGIT_SEGMENT_MAP = {
  [0] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentE = true, SegmentF = true },
  [1] = { SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true },
  [2] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentE = true, SegmentG = true },
  [3] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentG = true },
  [4] = { SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentF = true, SegmentG = true },
  [5] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentF = true, SegmentG = true },
  [6] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentE = true, SegmentF = true, SegmentG = true },
  [7] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true },
  [8] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentE = true, SegmentF = true, SegmentG = true },
  [9] = { SegmentA = true, SegmentB = true, SegmentC = true, SegmentD = true, SegmentF = true, SegmentG = true },
}

local rootTransform = nil
local pitchHalfLength = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH
local pitchHalfWidth = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_WIDTH
local goalMouthHalfWidth = DEFAULT_GOAL_MOUTH_HALF_WIDTH
local resetLocalY = DEFAULT_RESET_LOCAL_Y
local westGoalKickLocalX = -(DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH - DEFAULT_GOAL_AREA_DEPTH)
local eastGoalKickLocalX = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH - DEFAULT_GOAL_AREA_DEPTH
local centerSpotLocalX = 0
local centerSpotLocalZ = 0
local discoveryElapsed = 0
local toucherDiscoveryElapsed = 0
local trackedBalls = {}
local teamTouchers = {}
local blueScore = 0
local redScore = 0
local goalVolumes = {
  west = nil,
  east = nil,
  warningShown = false,
}
local scoreboardCache = {
  warningShown = false,
  blueTensSegments = nil,
  blueOnesSegments = nil,
  redTensSegments = nil,
  redOnesSegments = nil,
}

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
  if value < minValue then return minValue end
  if value > maxValue then return maxValue end
  return value
end

-- 按节点名或相对 / 绝对路径在 `parent` 子树中查找 Transform。
-- 兼容纯叶子名、相对路径，以及第一段是"已失效 glb root 名"（生成期写入、运行时被改名）的情况。
local function findChild(parent, name)
  if parent == nil or name == nil then return nil end

  local lookupName = name
  local prefix = parent.name .. "/"
  if string.sub(lookupName, 1, string.len(prefix)) == prefix then
    lookupName = string.sub(lookupName, string.len(prefix) + 1)
  end
  if lookupName == "" then return parent end

  local direct = parent:Find(lookupName)
  if direct ~= nil then return direct end

  for i = 0, parent.childCount - 1 do
    local child = parent:GetChild(i)
    if child ~= nil then
      if child.name == lookupName then return child end
      local found = findChild(child, lookupName)
      if found ~= nil then return found end
    end
  end

  local slashIdx = string.find(lookupName, "/", 1, true)
  if slashIdx ~= nil then
    local stripped = string.sub(lookupName, slashIdx + 1)
    if stripped ~= "" and stripped ~= lookupName then
      return findChild(parent, stripped)
    end
  end

  return nil
end

local function hasAncestorNamed(targetTransform, targetName)
  if targetTransform == nil or targetName == nil then return false end

  local current = targetTransform.parent
  while current ~= nil do
    if current.name == targetName then
      return true
    end
    current = current.parent
  end

  return false
end

local function getLocalPoint(worldPoint)
  if rootTransform == nil or worldPoint == nil then return nil end
  return rootTransform:InverseTransformPoint(worldPoint)
end

local function buildLocalPosition(localX, localZ)
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(localX, resetLocalY, localZ)
end

local function getLocalBoundsFromWorldBounds(bounds)
  if rootTransform == nil or bounds == nil then return nil end

  local min = bounds.min
  local max = bounds.max
  local corners = {
    UnityEngine.Vector3(min.x, min.y, min.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(min.x, min.y, max.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(min.x, max.y, min.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(min.x, max.y, max.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(max.x, min.y, min.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(max.x, min.y, max.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(max.x, max.y, min.z),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(max.x, max.y, max.z),
  }

  local minX = nil
  local maxX = nil
  local minY = nil
  local maxY = nil
  local minZ = nil
  local maxZ = nil
  for _, worldCorner in ipairs(corners) do
    local localCorner = getLocalPoint(worldCorner)
    if localCorner ~= nil then
      minX = minX == nil and localCorner.x or math.min(minX, localCorner.x)
      maxX = maxX == nil and localCorner.x or math.max(maxX, localCorner.x)
      minY = minY == nil and localCorner.y or math.min(minY, localCorner.y)
      maxY = maxY == nil and localCorner.y or math.max(maxY, localCorner.y)
      minZ = minZ == nil and localCorner.z or math.min(minZ, localCorner.z)
      maxZ = maxZ == nil and localCorner.z or math.max(maxZ, localCorner.z)
    end
  end

  if minX == nil or maxX == nil or minY == nil or maxY == nil or minZ == nil or maxZ == nil then
    return nil
  end

  return {
    minX = minX,
    maxX = maxX,
    minY = minY,
    maxY = maxY,
    minZ = minZ,
    maxZ = maxZ,
  }
end

local function getRendererLocalBounds(targetTransform)
  if targetTransform == nil or targetTransform.gameObject == nil then return nil end

  local renderer = targetTransform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Renderer))
  if renderer == nil then return nil end

  return getLocalBoundsFromWorldBounds(renderer.bounds)
end

local function buildFallbackGoalVolume(endlineSign)
  local goalLineLocalX = endlineSign * pitchHalfLength
  local goalBackLocalX = goalLineLocalX + endlineSign * DEFAULT_GOAL_INTERIOR_DEPTH
  return {
    minX = math.min(goalLineLocalX, goalBackLocalX),
    maxX = math.max(goalLineLocalX, goalBackLocalX),
    minY = 0,
    maxY = DEFAULT_GOAL_INTERIOR_HEIGHT,
    minZ = -goalMouthHalfWidth,
    maxZ = goalMouthHalfWidth,
  }
end

local function buildGoalInteriorVolume(goalRootPath, endlineSign)
  local fallback = buildFallbackGoalVolume(endlineSign)
  local goalLineLocalX = endlineSign * pitchHalfLength
  local goalVolume = {
    minX = fallback.minX,
    maxX = fallback.maxX,
    minY = fallback.minY,
    maxY = fallback.maxY,
    minZ = fallback.minZ,
    maxZ = fallback.maxZ,
  }

  local northPostBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalFrame/NorthPost"))
  local southPostBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalFrame/SouthPost"))
  local crossbarBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalFrame/Crossbar"))
  local backCrossbarBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalFrame/BackCrossbar"))
  local netBackBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalNet/NetBack"))
  local netTopBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalNet/NetTop"))
  local netNorthSideBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalNet/NetNorthSide"))
  local netSouthSideBounds = getRendererLocalBounds(findChild(rootTransform, goalRootPath .. "/GoalNet/NetSouthSide"))

  if northPostBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.maxZ = northPostBounds.minZ
    goalVolume.minY = northPostBounds.minY
  elseif netNorthSideBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.maxZ = netNorthSideBounds.minZ
  end

  if southPostBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.minZ = southPostBounds.maxZ
    goalVolume.minY = math.max(goalVolume.minY, southPostBounds.minY)
  elseif netSouthSideBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.minZ = netSouthSideBounds.maxZ
  end

  if crossbarBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.maxY = crossbarBounds.minY
  elseif netTopBounds ~= nil then
    goalVolume.maxY = netTopBounds.minY
  end

  local goalBackLocalX = nil
  if netBackBounds ~= nil then
    goalBackLocalX = endlineSign >= 0 and netBackBounds.minX or netBackBounds.maxX
  elseif backCrossbarBounds ~= nil then
    goalBackLocalX = endlineSign >= 0 and backCrossbarBounds.minX or backCrossbarBounds.maxX
  end

  if goalBackLocalX ~= nil then
    goalVolume.minX = math.min(goalLineLocalX, goalBackLocalX)
    goalVolume.maxX = math.max(goalLineLocalX, goalBackLocalX)
  end

  if goalVolume.minX >= goalVolume.maxX or goalVolume.minY >= goalVolume.maxY or goalVolume.minZ >= goalVolume.maxZ then
    return fallback, true
  end

  return goalVolume, false
end

local function cacheGoalVolumes()
  local westGoalVolume, westFallback = buildGoalInteriorVolume("ModuleRoot/SoccerField/WestGoal", -1)
  local eastGoalVolume, eastFallback = buildGoalInteriorVolume("ModuleRoot/SoccerField/EastGoal", 1)

  goalVolumes.west = westGoalVolume
  goalVolumes.east = eastGoalVolume

  if westGoalVolume ~= nil and eastGoalVolume ~= nil then
    goalMouthHalfWidth = math.max(
      math.abs(westGoalVolume.minZ),
      math.abs(westGoalVolume.maxZ),
      math.abs(eastGoalVolume.minZ),
      math.abs(eastGoalVolume.maxZ)
    )
  end

  if (westFallback or eastFallback) and not goalVolumes.warningShown then
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[soccer-field] Goal interior nodes are partially missing, using fallback goal volume for score detection.")
    goalVolumes.warningShown = true
  end
end

local function clipSegmentAxis(startValue, deltaValue, minValue, maxValue, currentMinT, currentMaxT)
  if math.abs(deltaValue) < POSITION_EPSILON then
    if startValue < minValue or startValue > maxValue then
      return false, currentMinT, currentMaxT
    end
    return true, currentMinT, currentMaxT
  end

  local t1 = (minValue - startValue) / deltaValue
  local t2 = (maxValue - startValue) / deltaValue
  if t1 > t2 then
    t1, t2 = t2, t1
  end

  currentMinT = math.max(currentMinT, t1)
  currentMaxT = math.min(currentMaxT, t2)
  if currentMinT > currentMaxT then
    return false, currentMinT, currentMaxT
  end

  return true, currentMinT, currentMaxT
end

local function segmentIntersectsAxisAlignedBox(startLocalPosition, endLocalPosition, box)
  if startLocalPosition == nil or endLocalPosition == nil or box == nil then return false end

  local tMin = 0
  local tMax = 1
  local ok = false

  ok, tMin, tMax = clipSegmentAxis(startLocalPosition.x, endLocalPosition.x - startLocalPosition.x, box.minX - GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, box.maxX + GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, tMin, tMax)
  if not ok then return false end

  ok, tMin, tMax = clipSegmentAxis(startLocalPosition.y, endLocalPosition.y - startLocalPosition.y, box.minY - GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, box.maxY + GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, tMin, tMax)
  if not ok then return false end

  ok, tMin, tMax = clipSegmentAxis(startLocalPosition.z, endLocalPosition.z - startLocalPosition.z, box.minZ - GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, box.maxZ + GOAL_VOLUME_EPSILON, tMin, tMax)
  if not ok then return false end

  return tMax >= 0 and tMin <= 1
end

local function getGoalVolumeForEndline(endlineSign)
  if endlineSign >= 0 then
    return goalVolumes.east or buildFallbackGoalVolume(endlineSign)
  end
  return goalVolumes.west or buildFallbackGoalVolume(endlineSign)
end

local function inferTeamFromName(name)
  if name == nil then return nil end

  if string.sub(name, 1, string.len(BLUE_TEAM_PREFIX)) == BLUE_TEAM_PREFIX then
    return "blue"
  end

  if string.sub(name, 1, string.len(RED_TEAM_PREFIX)) == RED_TEAM_PREFIX then
    return "red"
  end

  return nil
end

local function hasTeamAncestor(targetTransform)
  if targetTransform == nil then return false end

  local current = targetTransform.parent
  while current ~= nil do
    if inferTeamFromName(current.name) ~= nil then
      return true
    end
    current = current.parent
  end

  return false
end

local function getBallState(ballTransform)
  if ballTransform == nil then return nil end

  local state = trackedBalls[ballTransform]
  if state ~= nil then return state end

  local rigidbody = nil
  if ballTransform.gameObject ~= nil then
    rigidbody = ballTransform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  end

  state = {
    rigidbody = rigidbody,
    previousLocalPosition = nil,
    pendingReset = nil,
    cooldown = 0,
    lastTouchTeam = nil,
    lastTouchName = nil,
    lastTouchAge = LAST_TOUCH_MEMORY_DURATION + 1,
  }
  trackedBalls[ballTransform] = state
  return state
end

local function cacheDigitSegments(digitTransform)
  if digitTransform == nil then return nil end

  local segments = {}
  local foundAny = false
  for _, segmentName in ipairs(DIGIT_SEGMENT_NAMES) do
    local segmentTransform = findChild(digitTransform, segmentName)
    segments[segmentName] = segmentTransform
    if segmentTransform ~= nil then
      foundAny = true
    end
  end

  if not foundAny then
    return nil
  end

  return segments
end

local function cacheScoreboardNodes()
  local scoreboard = findChild(rootTransform, "Scoreboard")
  local blueScoreDisplay = findChild(rootTransform, "BlueScoreDisplay")
  local redScoreDisplay = findChild(rootTransform, "RedScoreDisplay")
  local blueDigitTens = findChild(rootTransform, "BlueDigitTens")
  local blueDigitOnes = findChild(rootTransform, "BlueDigitOnes")
  local redDigitTens = findChild(rootTransform, "RedDigitTens")
  local redDigitOnes = findChild(rootTransform, "RedDigitOnes")

  scoreboardCache.blueTensSegments = cacheDigitSegments(blueDigitTens)
  scoreboardCache.blueOnesSegments = cacheDigitSegments(blueDigitOnes)
  scoreboardCache.redTensSegments = cacheDigitSegments(redDigitTens)
  scoreboardCache.redOnesSegments = cacheDigitSegments(redDigitOnes)

  if not scoreboardCache.warningShown then
    if scoreboard == nil or blueScoreDisplay == nil or redScoreDisplay == nil or blueDigitTens == nil or blueDigitOnes == nil or redDigitTens == nil or redDigitOnes == nil then
      UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[soccer-field] Scoreboard nodes are partially missing, score rules will continue with degraded display support.")
      scoreboardCache.warningShown = true
    end
  end
end

local function setSegmentVisible(segmentTransform, isVisible)
  if segmentTransform == nil or segmentTransform.gameObject == nil then return end

  local renderer = segmentTransform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Renderer))
  if renderer ~= nil then
    renderer.enabled = isVisible
  end
end

local function setDigitSegmentsValue(segmentMap, value)
  if segmentMap == nil then return end

  local digitValue = clamp(math.floor(value or 0), 0, 9)
  local activeSegments = DIGIT_SEGMENT_MAP[digitValue] or DIGIT_SEGMENT_MAP[0]
  for _, segmentName in ipairs(DIGIT_SEGMENT_NAMES) do
    setSegmentVisible(segmentMap[segmentName], activeSegments[segmentName] == true)
  end
end

local function getScoreDisplayDigits(scoreValue)
  local normalizedScore = math.max(0, math.floor(scoreValue or 0))
  local displayScore = math.min(normalizedScore, 99)
  local tens = math.floor(displayScore / 10)
  local ones = displayScore % 10
  return tens, ones
end

local function updateScoreboardDisplay()
  local blueTens, blueOnes = getScoreDisplayDigits(blueScore)
  local redTens, redOnes = getScoreDisplayDigits(redScore)

  setDigitSegmentsValue(scoreboardCache.blueTensSegments, blueTens)
  setDigitSegmentsValue(scoreboardCache.blueOnesSegments, blueOnes)
  setDigitSegmentsValue(scoreboardCache.redTensSegments, redTens)
  setDigitSegmentsValue(scoreboardCache.redOnesSegments, redOnes)
end

local function addGoalScore(scoreTeam)
  if scoreTeam == "blue" then
    blueScore = blueScore + 1
  elseif scoreTeam == "red" then
    redScore = redScore + 1
  else
    return
  end

  updateScoreboardDisplay()
end

local function getEventPromptMessage(exitCandidate)
  if exitCandidate == nil then return nil end

  if exitCandidate.restartType == "goal" then
    if exitCandidate.scoreTeam == "blue" then
      return "蓝方得分"
    end
    if exitCandidate.scoreTeam == "red" then
      return "红方得分"
    end
    return nil
  end

  if exitCandidate.restartType == "endlineOut" then
    return "底线出界"
  end

  if exitCandidate.restartType == "ordinaryOut" then
    return "边线出界"
  end

  return nil
end

local function showEventPrompt(exitCandidate)
  local message = getEventPromptMessage(exitCandidate)
  if message == nil or message == "" then return end

  if DouyinUtility ~= nil then
    DouyinUtility.Toast(message)
  else
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[soccer-field] Toast API unavailable, skipped prompt: " .. message)
  end
end

local function cacheFieldMetrics()
  pitchHalfLength = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH
  pitchHalfWidth = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_WIDTH
  goalMouthHalfWidth = DEFAULT_GOAL_MOUTH_HALF_WIDTH
  resetLocalY = DEFAULT_RESET_LOCAL_Y
  westGoalKickLocalX = -(DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH - DEFAULT_GOAL_AREA_DEPTH)
  eastGoalKickLocalX = DEFAULT_PITCH_HALF_LENGTH - DEFAULT_GOAL_AREA_DEPTH

  local northTouchline = findChild(rootTransform, "NorthTouchline")
  local southTouchline = findChild(rootTransform, "SouthTouchline")
  local eastGoalLine = findChild(rootTransform, "EastGoalMouthLine")
  local westGoalLine = findChild(rootTransform, "WestGoalMouthLine")
  local leftGoalAreaFront = findChild(rootTransform, "LeftGoalAreaFront")
  local rightGoalAreaFront = findChild(rootTransform, "RightGoalAreaFront")
  local centerSpot = findChild(rootTransform, "CenterSpot")
  if eastGoalLine == nil then
    eastGoalLine = findChild(rootTransform, "EastGoalLine")
  end
  if westGoalLine == nil then
    westGoalLine = findChild(rootTransform, "WestGoalLine")
  end

  if northTouchline ~= nil and southTouchline ~= nil then
    local northLocal = getLocalPoint(northTouchline.position)
    local southLocal = getLocalPoint(southTouchline.position)
    if northLocal ~= nil and southLocal ~= nil then
      pitchHalfWidth = math.max(math.abs(northLocal.z), math.abs(southLocal.z))
    end
  else
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[soccer-field] Missing touchline nodes, using default pitch width.")
  end

  if eastGoalLine ~= nil and westGoalLine ~= nil then
    local eastLocal = getLocalPoint(eastGoalLine.position)
    local westLocal = getLocalPoint(westGoalLine.position)
    if eastLocal ~= nil and westLocal ~= nil then
      pitchHalfLength = math.max(math.abs(eastLocal.x), math.abs(westLocal.x))
    end
  else
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[soccer-field] Missing goal line nodes, using default pitch length.")
  end

  if leftGoalAreaFront ~= nil then
    local leftGoalAreaFrontLocal = getLocalPoint(leftGoalAreaFront.position)
    if leftGoalAreaFrontLocal ~= nil then
      westGoalKickLocalX = leftGoalAreaFrontLocal.x
    end
  end

  if rightGoalAreaFront ~= nil then
    local rightGoalAreaFrontLocal = getLocalPoint(rightGoalAreaFront.position)
    if rightGoalAreaFrontLocal ~= nil then
      eastGoalKickLocalX = rightGoalAreaFrontLocal.x
    end
  end

  local turfStripe = findChild(rootTransform, "TurfStripe01")
  if turfStripe ~= nil and turfStripe.gameObject ~= nil then
    local renderer = turfStripe.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Renderer))
    if renderer ~= nil then
      local stripePosition = turfStripe.position
      local topWorldPoint = UnityEngine.Vector3(stripePosition.x, renderer.bounds.max.y, stripePosition.z)
      local topLocalPoint = getLocalPoint(topWorldPoint)
      if topLocalPoint ~= nil then
        resetLocalY = topLocalPoint.y + 0.35
      end
    end
  end

  centerSpotLocalX = 0
  centerSpotLocalZ = 0
  if centerSpot ~= nil then
    local centerSpotLocal = getLocalPoint(centerSpot.position)
    if centerSpotLocal ~= nil then
      centerSpotLocalX = centerSpotLocal.x
      centerSpotLocalZ = centerSpotLocal.z
    end
  end

  cacheGoalVolumes()
end

local function discoverFootballs()
  local transforms = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType(typeof(UnityEngine.Transform))
  if transforms == nil then return end

  for i = 0, transforms.Length - 1 do
    local candidate = transforms[i]
    if candidate ~= nil and candidate.name == FOOTBALL_NAME and not hasAncestorNamed(candidate, FOOTBALL_NAME) then
      getBallState(candidate)
    end
  end
end

local function discoverTeamTouchers()
  teamTouchers = {}

  local transforms = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType(typeof(UnityEngine.Transform))
  if transforms == nil then return end

  for i = 0, transforms.Length - 1 do
    local candidate = transforms[i]
    local team = candidate ~= nil and inferTeamFromName(candidate.name) or nil
    if candidate ~= nil and team ~= nil and not hasTeamAncestor(candidate) then
      teamTouchers[#teamTouchers + 1] = {
        transform = candidate,
        team = team,
        name = candidate.name,
      }
    end
  end
end

local function updateBallLastTouchTeam(ballTransform, state)
  if ballTransform == nil or state == nil then return end

  state.lastTouchAge = state.lastTouchAge + Time.deltaTime

  local nearestTeam = nil
  local nearestName = nil
  local nearestDistanceSqr = nil
  local ballPosition = ballTransform.position

  for _, toucher in ipairs(teamTouchers) do
    local toucherTransform = toucher.transform
    if toucherTransform ~= nil and toucherTransform.gameObject ~= nil then
      local toucherPosition = toucherTransform.position
      local verticalDistance = math.abs(toucherPosition.y - ballPosition.y)
      if verticalDistance <= TOUCH_VERTICAL_TOLERANCE then
        local deltaX = toucherPosition.x - ballPosition.x
        local deltaZ = toucherPosition.z - ballPosition.z
        local distanceSqr = deltaX * deltaX + deltaZ * deltaZ
        if distanceSqr <= TOUCH_TRACK_RADIUS_SQR and (nearestDistanceSqr == nil or distanceSqr < nearestDistanceSqr) then
          nearestDistanceSqr = distanceSqr
          nearestTeam = toucher.team
          nearestName = toucher.name
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if nearestTeam ~= nil then
    state.lastTouchTeam = nearestTeam
    state.lastTouchName = nearestName
    state.lastTouchAge = 0
  elseif state.lastTouchAge > LAST_TOUCH_MEMORY_DURATION then
    state.lastTouchTeam = nil
    state.lastTouchName = nil
  end
end

local function buildTouchlineResetLocalPosition(exitX, sidelineSign)
  local targetLocalX = clamp(exitX, -pitchHalfLength + THROW_IN_INSET, pitchHalfLength - THROW_IN_INSET)
  local targetLocalZ = sidelineSign * (pitchHalfWidth - THROW_IN_INSET)
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(targetLocalX, resetLocalY, targetLocalZ)
end

local function buildEndlineResetLocalPosition(exitZ, endlineSign)
  local targetLocalX = endlineSign * (pitchHalfLength - THROW_IN_INSET)
  local targetLocalZ = clamp(exitZ, -pitchHalfWidth + THROW_IN_INSET, pitchHalfWidth - THROW_IN_INSET)
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(targetLocalX, resetLocalY, targetLocalZ)
end

local function buildCornerResetLocalPosition(endlineSign, cornerSign)
  local targetLocalX = endlineSign * (pitchHalfLength - CORNER_INSET)
  local targetLocalZ = cornerSign * (pitchHalfWidth - CORNER_INSET)
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(targetLocalX, resetLocalY, targetLocalZ)
end

local function buildGoalKickResetLocalPosition(endlineSign)
  local targetLocalX = endlineSign >= 0 and eastGoalKickLocalX or westGoalKickLocalX
  return buildLocalPosition(targetLocalX, 0)
end

local function buildKickoffResetLocalPosition()
  return buildLocalPosition(centerSpotLocalX, centerSpotLocalZ)
end

local function chooseEarlierExitCandidate(primaryCandidate, secondaryCandidate)
  if primaryCandidate == nil then return secondaryCandidate end
  if secondaryCandidate == nil then return primaryCandidate end
  if secondaryCandidate.t < primaryCandidate.t then
    return secondaryCandidate
  end
  return primaryCandidate
end

local function buildTouchlineExitCandidate(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition)
  if previousLocalPosition == nil or currentLocalPosition == nil then return nil end

  local deltaZ = currentLocalPosition.z - previousLocalPosition.z
  if math.abs(deltaZ) < POSITION_EPSILON or math.abs(currentLocalPosition.z) <= pitchHalfWidth then
    return nil
  end

  local sidelineSign = currentLocalPosition.z >= 0 and 1 or -1
  local boundaryZ = sidelineSign * pitchHalfWidth
  local interpolation = (boundaryZ - previousLocalPosition.z) / deltaZ
  if interpolation < 0 or interpolation > 1 then
    return nil
  end

  local exitX = previousLocalPosition.x + (currentLocalPosition.x - previousLocalPosition.x) * interpolation
  if math.abs(exitX) > pitchHalfLength then
    return nil
  end

  return {
    t = interpolation,
    shouldReset = true,
    restartType = "ordinaryOut",
    targetLocalPosition = buildTouchlineResetLocalPosition(exitX, sidelineSign),
  }
end

local function getGoalScoringTeam(endlineSign)
  if endlineSign >= 0 then
    return "red"
  end
  return "blue"
end

local function isGoalScoredAtGoalInterior(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, endlineSign)
  return segmentIntersectsAxisAlignedBox(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, getGoalVolumeForEndline(endlineSign))
end

local function buildGoalExitCandidate(endlineSign, interpolation)
  return {
    t = interpolation,
    shouldReset = true,
    restartType = "goal",
    scoreTeam = getGoalScoringTeam(endlineSign),
    targetLocalPosition = buildKickoffResetLocalPosition(),
  }
end

local function buildEndlineOutRestartCandidate(exitZ, endlineSign, interpolation)
  local cornerSign = exitZ >= 0 and 1 or -1
  return {
    t = interpolation,
    shouldReset = true,
    restartType = "endlineOut",
    targetLocalPosition = buildCornerResetLocalPosition(endlineSign, cornerSign),
  }
end

local function buildEndlineExitCandidate(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, lastTouchTeam)
  if previousLocalPosition == nil or currentLocalPosition == nil then return nil end

  local deltaX = currentLocalPosition.x - previousLocalPosition.x
  if math.abs(deltaX) < POSITION_EPSILON or math.abs(currentLocalPosition.x) <= pitchHalfLength then
    return nil
  end

  local endlineSign = currentLocalPosition.x >= 0 and 1 or -1
  local boundaryX = endlineSign * pitchHalfLength
  local interpolation = (boundaryX - previousLocalPosition.x) / deltaX
  if interpolation < 0 or interpolation > 1 then
    return nil
  end

  local exitZ = previousLocalPosition.z + (currentLocalPosition.z - previousLocalPosition.z) * interpolation
  if math.abs(exitZ) > pitchHalfWidth then
    return nil
  end

  if math.abs(exitZ) <= goalMouthHalfWidth then
    -- 只有越线后实际进入球门内部空间才算进球，否则统一按端线出界回最近角球点。
    if isGoalScoredAtGoalInterior(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, endlineSign) then
      return buildGoalExitCandidate(endlineSign, interpolation)
    end
    return buildEndlineOutRestartCandidate(exitZ, endlineSign, interpolation)
  end

  return buildEndlineOutRestartCandidate(exitZ, endlineSign, interpolation)
end

local function classifyFieldExit(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, lastTouchTeam)
  if previousLocalPosition == nil or currentLocalPosition == nil then return nil end

  local wasInsidePitch = math.abs(previousLocalPosition.x) <= pitchHalfLength and math.abs(previousLocalPosition.z) <= pitchHalfWidth
  local isOutsidePitch = math.abs(currentLocalPosition.x) > pitchHalfLength or math.abs(currentLocalPosition.z) > pitchHalfWidth
  if not wasInsidePitch or not isOutsidePitch then
    return nil
  end

  local touchlineCandidate = buildTouchlineExitCandidate(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition)
  local endlineCandidate = buildEndlineExitCandidate(previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, lastTouchTeam)
  return chooseEarlierExitCandidate(touchlineCandidate, endlineCandidate)
end

local function scheduleFieldReset(state, exitCandidate)
  if state == nil or exitCandidate == nil or exitCandidate.targetLocalPosition == nil then return end

  if exitCandidate.restartType == "goal" and exitCandidate.scoreTeam ~= nil then
    addGoalScore(exitCandidate.scoreTeam)
  end

  showEventPrompt(exitCandidate)

  state.pendingReset = {
    delayRemaining = OUT_OF_BOUNDS_RESET_DELAY,
    restartType = exitCandidate.restartType,
    scoreTeam = exitCandidate.scoreTeam,
    targetLocalPosition = exitCandidate.targetLocalPosition,
  }
end

local function moveBallToRestartPosition(ballTransform, state, targetLocalPosition)
  if rootTransform == nil or ballTransform == nil or state == nil or targetLocalPosition == nil then return end

  local targetWorldPosition = rootTransform:TransformPoint(targetLocalPosition)

  if state.rigidbody == nil and ballTransform.gameObject ~= nil then
    state.rigidbody = ballTransform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  end

  if state.rigidbody ~= nil then
    state.rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
    state.rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
    state.rigidbody.position = targetWorldPosition
  end

  ballTransform.position = targetWorldPosition
  state.previousLocalPosition = targetLocalPosition
  state.pendingReset = nil
  state.cooldown = RESET_COOLDOWN
  state.lastTouchTeam = nil
  state.lastTouchName = nil
  state.lastTouchAge = LAST_TOUCH_MEMORY_DURATION + 1
end

function Start()
  rootTransform = self.transform
  if rootTransform == nil then
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("[soccer-field] Missing root transform, unable to start out-of-bounds rule.")
    return
  end

  cacheFieldMetrics()
  cacheScoreboardNodes()
  updateScoreboardDisplay()
  discoverFootballs()
  discoverTeamTouchers()
end

function Update()
  if rootTransform == nil then return end

  discoveryElapsed = discoveryElapsed + Time.deltaTime
  if discoveryElapsed >= DISCOVERY_INTERVAL then
    discoveryElapsed = 0
    discoverFootballs()
  end

  toucherDiscoveryElapsed = toucherDiscoveryElapsed + Time.deltaTime
  if toucherDiscoveryElapsed >= TOUCHER_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL then
    toucherDiscoveryElapsed = 0
    discoverTeamTouchers()
  end

  for ballTransform, state in pairs(trackedBalls) do
    if ballTransform == nil or ballTransform.gameObject == nil then
      trackedBalls[ballTransform] = nil
    else
      if state.cooldown > 0 then
        state.cooldown = math.max(0, state.cooldown - Time.deltaTime)
      end

      if state.pendingReset ~= nil then
        state.pendingReset.delayRemaining = math.max(0, state.pendingReset.delayRemaining - Time.deltaTime)
        if state.pendingReset.delayRemaining <= 0 then
          moveBallToRestartPosition(ballTransform, state, state.pendingReset.targetLocalPosition)
        end
      else
        updateBallLastTouchTeam(ballTransform, state)

        local currentLocalPosition = getLocalPoint(ballTransform.position)
        if currentLocalPosition ~= nil then
          if state.previousLocalPosition ~= nil and state.cooldown <= 0 then
            local exitCandidate = classifyFieldExit(state.previousLocalPosition, currentLocalPosition, state.lastTouchTeam)
            if exitCandidate ~= nil and exitCandidate.shouldReset and exitCandidate.targetLocalPosition ~= nil then
              scheduleFieldReset(state, exitCandidate)
              state.previousLocalPosition = currentLocalPosition
            else
              state.previousLocalPosition = currentLocalPosition
            end
          else
            state.previousLocalPosition = currentLocalPosition
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

---@id 53974e38-8d45-4e64-9d1c-2ad5dc39bab4
---@referenceName pi-lantern-switch.lua
-- 莲花花灯的靠近按钮交互与柔和灯光开关
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@var InitialLightOn:boolean=true
---@name 初始点亮
---@desc 开始游戏时花灯是否处于点亮状态
---@group 灯光
---@var LightIntensity:number=1.8
---@name 灯光亮度
---@desc 点亮时粉橙色点光源的强度
---@group 灯光
---@var LightRange:number=2.2
---@name 灯光范围
---@desc 点亮时光源影响的半径
---@group 灯光
---@var PulseStrength:number=0.08
---@name 呼吸强度
---@desc 点亮后灯光随时间轻微明暗变化的幅度
---@group 灯光
---@var TurnOnText:string="点亮花灯"
---@name 点亮按钮文案
---@desc 花灯熄灭时的交互按钮文字
---@group 交互
---@var TurnOffText:string="熄灭花灯"
---@name 熄灭按钮文案
---@desc 花灯点亮时的交互按钮文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local lightObject = nil
local pointLight = nil
local isLit = true
local materialCount = 0
local touchedMaterials = {}
local baseColors = {}
local basePowers = {}
local ownershipPending = false

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
  if isLit then
    setButtonText(TurnOffText)
  else
    setButtonText(TurnOnText)
  end
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function setupLight()
  if lightObject ~= nil then
    return
  end

  lightObject = UnityEngine.GameObject("SoftPinkOrangeLight")
  lightObject.transform:SetParent(self.transform, false)
  lightObject.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0.35, 0)

  pointLight = lightObject:AddComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Light))
  pointLight.type = UnityEngine.LightType.Point
  pointLight.color = UnityEngine.Color(1, 0.58, 0.36, 1)
  pointLight.range = LightRange
end

local function rememberMaterial(material)
  if material == nil or baseColors[material] ~= nil then
    return
  end

  materialCount = materialCount + 1
  touchedMaterials[materialCount] = material

  if material:HasProperty("_BaseColor") then
    baseColors[material] = material:GetColor("_BaseColor")
  else
    baseColors[material] = false
  end

  if material:HasProperty("_ColorPower") then
    local power = material:GetFloat("_ColorPower")
    if power < 0.05 then
      power = 1
    end
    basePowers[material] = power
  else
    basePowers[material] = false
  end
end

local function collectMaterials()
  local renderers = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Renderer), true)
  if renderers == nil then
    return
  end

  for i = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
    local renderer = renderers[i]
    if renderer ~= nil then
      local materials = renderer.materials
      if materials ~= nil then
        for j = 0, materials.Length - 1 do
          rememberMaterial(materials[j])
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

local function applyMaterialState()
  local colorFactor = 0.55
  local powerFactor = 0.45
  if isLit then
    colorFactor = 1
    powerFactor = 1.25
  end

  for i = 1, materialCount do
    local material = touchedMaterials[i]
    if material ~= nil then
      local baseColor = baseColors[material]
      if baseColor ~= false and baseColor ~= nil and material:HasProperty("_BaseColor") then
        material:SetColor(
          "_BaseColor",
          UnityEngine.Color(baseColor.r * colorFactor, baseColor.g * colorFactor, baseColor.b * colorFactor, baseColor.a)
        )
      end

      local basePower = basePowers[material]
      if basePower ~= false and basePower ~= nil and material:HasProperty("_ColorPower") then
        material:SetFloat("_ColorPower", basePower * powerFactor)
      end
    end
  end
end

local function applyLightState()
  if pointLight ~= nil then
    pointLight.enabled = isLit
    pointLight.range = LightRange
    if isLit then
      pointLight.intensity = LightIntensity
    else
      pointLight.intensity = 0
    end
  end

  applyMaterialState()
  refreshButtonText()
end

local function toggleLantern()
  isLit = not isLit
  applyLightState()
end

local function clearInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function Start()
  isLit = InitialLightOn
  setupLight()
  collectMaterials()
  applyLightState()
end

function Update()
  if not isLit or pointLight == nil then
    return
  end

  local pulse = 1 + math.sin(Time.time * 2.2) * PulseStrength
  pointLight.intensity = LightIntensity * pulse
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  refreshButtonText()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    toggleLantern()
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  clearInteractionButton()
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  refreshButtonText()
end

function OnDisable()
  clearInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  clearInteractionButton()
  if lightObject ~= nil then
    UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(lightObject)
    lightObject = nil
    pointLight = nil
  end
end

c97d603a-e8a0-4de9-b32b-0d29b6311a63.content:
---@id c97d603a-e8a0-4de9-b32b-0d29b6311a63
---@referenceName ms-vehicle.lua
-- 泳圈载具运动：运动学刚体平面驾驶、锁定初始高度、阻挡检测与无人回位。
---@start
---@var CruiseSpeed:number=4.5
---@name 前进速度
---@range 0.5,12,0.1
---@group 驾驶
---@var ReverseSpeed:number=2.0
---@name 倒退速度
---@range 0,8,0.1
---@group 驾驶
---@var Acceleration:number=8.0
---@name 加速度
---@range 0.5,30,0.1
---@group 驾驶
---@var BrakeAcceleration:number=10.0
---@name 松手刹停速度
---@range 0.5,40,0.1
---@group 驾驶
---@var TurnSpeed:number=90.0
---@name 转向速度
---@range 10,240,1
---@group 转向
---@var DeadZone:number=0.08
---@name 输入死区
---@range 0,0.4,0.01
---@group 输入
---@var ResetDelaySeconds:number=10.0
---@name 无人回位秒数
---@range 1,60,0.5
---@group 回位
---@var CollisionProbePadding:number=0.08
---@name 阻挡检测余量
---@range 0,0.5,0.01
---@group 碰撞
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = UnityEngine.Time
local Mathf = UnityEngine.Mathf

local body = nil
local initialPosition = nil
local initialRotation = nil
local lockedY = 0
local moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
local occupied = false
local wasOccupied = false
local shouldResetWhenEmpty = false
local emptyTimer = 0
local currentSpeed = 0
local warnedNoBody = false

local function captureInitialTransform()
  if self == nil or self.transform == nil then return end
  initialPosition = self.transform.position
  initialRotation = self.transform.rotation
  lockedY = initialPosition.y
end

local function zeroBodyMotion()
  if body == nil then return end
  pcall(function()
    body.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    body.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  end)
end

local function moveBodyPosition(pos)
  if body ~= nil then
    body:MovePosition(pos)
  end
end

local function moveBodyRotation(rot)
  if body ~= nil then
    body:MoveRotation(rot)
  end
end

local function lockCurrentHeight()
  if self == nil or self.transform == nil then return end
  local p = self.transform.position
  if Mathf.Abs(p.y - lockedY) > 0.001 then
    moveBodyPosition(UnityEngine.Vector3(p.x, lockedY, p.z))
  end
end

local function safeSweepBlocked(direction, distance)
  if body == nil or direction == nil or distance <= 0.0001 then return false end
  if direction.sqrMagnitude <= 0.0001 then return false end

  local ok, result = pcall(function()
    local hit = UnityEngine.RaycastHit()
    return body:SweepTest(direction, hit, distance + CollisionProbePadding)
  end)

  if ok and result == true then
    return true
  end
  return false
end

local function yawDirection(yawDeg)
  local rad = yawDeg * Mathf.Deg2Rad
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(Mathf.Sin(rad), 0, Mathf.Cos(rad))
end

local function resetToInitialTransform()
  if initialPosition == nil or initialRotation == nil then
    captureInitialTransform()
  end
  if initialPosition == nil or initialRotation == nil then return end

  currentSpeed = 0
  moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
  zeroBodyMotion()
  moveBodyPosition(UnityEngine.Vector3(initialPosition.x, lockedY, initialPosition.z))
  moveBodyRotation(initialRotation)
  emptyTimer = 0
  shouldResetWhenEmpty = false
end

local function driveKinematic(dt)
  if body == nil then
    if not warnedNoBody then
      UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[module-swim-ring-vehicle] 缺少 Rigidbody，无法执行稳定运动学驾驶。")
      warnedNoBody = true
    end
    return
  end

  local accelInput = 0
  if moveVec ~= nil and Mathf.Abs(moveVec.y) > DeadZone then
    accelInput = moveVec.y
  end

  local turnInput = 0
  if moveVec ~= nil and Mathf.Abs(moveVec.x) > DeadZone then
    turnInput = moveVec.x
  end

  local euler = self.transform.eulerAngles
  local yaw = euler.y + turnInput * TurnSpeed * dt
  local targetRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.Euler(0, yaw, 0)
  moveBodyRotation(targetRotation)

  local targetSpeed = 0
  if accelInput > 0 then
    targetSpeed = accelInput * CruiseSpeed
  elseif accelInput < 0 then
    targetSpeed = accelInput * ReverseSpeed
  end

  local rate = Acceleration
  if Mathf.Abs(targetSpeed) < 0.001 then
    rate = BrakeAcceleration
  end
  currentSpeed = Mathf.MoveTowards(currentSpeed, targetSpeed, rate * dt)

  local distance = Mathf.Abs(currentSpeed) * dt
  if distance <= 0.0001 then
    lockCurrentHeight()
    zeroBodyMotion()
    return
  end

  local dir = yawDirection(yaw)
  if currentSpeed < 0 then
    dir = UnityEngine.Vector3(-dir.x, 0, -dir.z)
  end

  if safeSweepBlocked(dir, distance) then
    currentSpeed = 0
    lockCurrentHeight()
    zeroBodyMotion()
    return
  end

  local p = self.transform.position
  local nextPos = UnityEngine.Vector3(p.x + dir.x * distance, lockedY, p.z + dir.z * distance)
  moveBodyPosition(nextPos)
  zeroBodyMotion()
end

function Start()
  body = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  captureInitialTransform()
  zeroBodyMotion()
end

function FixedUpdate()
  if self == nil or self.transform == nil then return end
  local dt = Time.fixedDeltaTime

  if occupied then
    emptyTimer = 0
    shouldResetWhenEmpty = false
    driveKinematic(dt)
    return
  end

  currentSpeed = Mathf.MoveTowards(currentSpeed, 0, BrakeAcceleration * dt)
  lockCurrentHeight()
  zeroBodyMotion()

  if shouldResetWhenEmpty then
    emptyTimer = emptyTimer + dt
    if emptyTimer >= ResetDelaySeconds then
      resetToInitialTransform()
    end
  end
end

function SetPassenger(active)
  occupied = active == true
  if occupied then
    wasOccupied = true
    shouldResetWhenEmpty = false
    emptyTimer = 0
    return
  end

  moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
  currentSpeed = 0
  emptyTimer = 0
  if wasOccupied then
    shouldResetWhenEmpty = true
  end
end

function SetDriveInput(vec)
  if vec == nil or not occupied then
    moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
  else
    moveVec = vec
  end
end

function ResetToInitialTransform()
  resetToInitialTransform()
end

function IsOccupied()
  return occupied
end

98594861-bb73-458c-80f2-935d5ae282a5.content:
---@id 98594861-bb73-458c-80f2-935d5ae282a5
---@referenceName pi-vehicle.lua
-- 泳圈载具交互：靠近按钮上/下船、座位对齐、本地输入采集并转交运动脚本。
---@start
---@var BoardButtonText:string="上船"
---@name 上船按钮文案
---@group 交互
---@var ExitButtonText:string="下船"
---@name 下船按钮文案
---@group 交互
---@var AutoExitOnMoveStick:boolean=false
---@name 摇杆拖动离船
---@desc 默认关闭，摇杆用于驾驶；开启后在座时拖动摇杆会离船。
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local DouyinUIService = CS.DouyinUIService
local UIType = CS.UIType

local seatAnchorPath = "ModuleRoot/Anchors/SeatAnchor"
local seatTrans = nil
local standUpTrans = nil
local localActor = nil
local currentPlayer = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local interactionButton = nil
local movementScript = nil
local moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
local lastControlSource = "none"

local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil
local JoyStickControlMain = nil
local joystickSubscribed = false

local savedBoardOffset = nil
local savedBoardRotation = nil
local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local ownershipPending = false

local function normalizePath(path)
  if path == nil then return "" end
  local result = tostring(path)
  while string.sub(result, 1, 1) == "/" do
    result = string.sub(result, 2)
  end
  while string.sub(result, -1) == "/" do
    result = string.sub(result, 1, string.len(result) - 1)
  end
  return result
end

local function collectTransformPaths(parent, currentPath, entries)
  entries[#entries + 1] = { path = currentPath, transform = parent }
  for i = 0, parent.childCount - 1 do
    local child = parent:GetChild(i)
    if child ~= nil then
      local childPath = child.name
      if currentPath ~= "" then
        childPath = currentPath .. "/" .. child.name
      end
      collectTransformPaths(child, childPath, entries)
    end
  end
end

local function pathHasSuffix(path, suffix)
  if path == suffix then return true end
  local pathLen = string.len(path)
  local suffixLen = string.len(suffix)
  if suffixLen <= 0 or pathLen <= suffixLen then return false end
  if string.sub(path, pathLen - suffixLen + 1) ~= suffix then return false end
  return string.sub(path, pathLen - suffixLen, pathLen - suffixLen) == "/"
end

local function findUniquePathSuffix(entries, suffix)
  local found = nil
  local count = 0
  for i = 1, #entries do
    local entry = entries[i]
    if pathHasSuffix(entry.path, suffix) then
      found = entry.transform
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return found, count
end

local function findChild(parent, targetPath)
  if parent == nil or targetPath == nil then return nil end

  local entries = {}
  collectTransformPaths(parent, normalizePath(parent.name), entries)

  local lookupPath = normalizePath(targetPath)
  if lookupPath == "" then return parent end

  while lookupPath ~= "" do
    local found, count = findUniquePathSuffix(entries, lookupPath)
    if count == 1 then return found end
    if count > 1 then return nil end

    local slashIdx = string.find(lookupPath, "/", 1, true)
    if slashIdx == nil then break end
    lookupPath = string.sub(lookupPath, slashIdx + 1)
    lookupPath = normalizePath(lookupPath)
  end

  return nil
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function getMovementScript()
  if movementScript ~= nil then return movementScript end
  local component = self:GetDouyinScript("ms-vehicle.lua")
  if component ~= nil then
    movementScript = component.script
  end
  return movementScript
end

local function notifyPassenger(active)
  local script = getMovementScript()
  if script ~= nil and script.SetPassenger ~= nil then
    script.SetPassenger(active)
  end
end

local function pushDriveInput(vec, source)
  if vec == nil then
    moveVec = UnityEngine.Vector2.zero
  else
    moveVec = vec
  end
  lastControlSource = source or "unknown"

  local script = getMovementScript()
  if script ~= nil and script.SetDriveInput ~= nil then
    if hasPassenger then
      script.SetDriveInput(moveVec)
    else
      script.SetDriveInput(UnityEngine.Vector2.zero)
    end
  end
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

function resolveSeatTrans()
  return seatTrans
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end
  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local orig = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local p = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(orig.x / p.x, orig.y / p.y, orig.z / p.z)

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end
  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPos = hips.position
  local transPos = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    transPos.x - (hipsPos.x - transPos.x),
    transPos.y - (hipsPos.y - transPos.y),
    transPos.z - (hipsPos.z - transPos.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = enabled
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  actor.gameObject.transform:SetParent(nil)
  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    actor.gameObject.transform.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end
  if standUpTrans ~= nil then
    actor.position = standUpTrans.position
    actor.rotation = standUpTrans.rotation
  elseif savedBoardOffset ~= nil then
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + savedBoardOffset.x,
      self.transform.position.y + savedBoardOffset.y,
      self.transform.position.z + savedBoardOffset.z
    )
    actor.rotation = savedBoardRotation
    savedBoardOffset = nil
    savedBoardRotation = nil
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + right.x,
      self.transform.position.y,
      self.transform.position.z + right.z
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end
end

local function subscribeInputs()
  onMoveInputStart = function(vec)
    pushDriveInput(vec, "stick-start")
  end
  onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
    pushDriveInput(vec, "stick")
  end
  onMoveInputCancel = function()
    pushDriveInput(UnityEngine.Vector2.zero, "stick-cancel")
  end

  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

local function unsubscribeInputs()
  if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    onMoveInputStart = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    onMoveInputPerform = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    onMoveInputCancel = nil
  end
end

local function unsubscribeJoystickDrag()
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil and joystickSubscribed then
    JoyStickControlMain:OffUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
    joystickSubscribed = false
  end
end

function Start()
  seatTrans = findChild(self.transform, seatAnchorPath)
  standUpTrans = seatTrans
  getMovementScript()
  notifyPassenger(false)
  pushDriveInput(UnityEngine.Vector2.zero, "init")
  subscribeInputs()

  JoyStickControlMain = DouyinUIService.GetJoyStickControl(UIType.MoveJoyStick)
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OnUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
    joystickSubscribed = true
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  unsubscribeJoystickDrag()
end

function OnDestroy()
  unsubscribeInputs()
  unsubscribeJoystickDrag()
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  if not hasPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    if actor == localActor then
      localActor = nil
    end
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if hasPassenger then
    setButtonText(ExitButtonText)
  else
    setButtonText(BoardButtonText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if hasPassenger then
      localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
    else
      if seatTrans == nil then
        UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("[module-swim-ring-vehicle] 未找到 SeatAnchor，无法上船。")
        return
      end
      localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    if hasPassenger then
      setButtonText(ExitButtonText)
    else
      setButtonText(BoardButtonText)
    end
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasPassenger = false
      notifyPassenger(false)
      setButtonText(BoardButtonText)
    end
    return
  end

  if actor.isLocal then
    local actorPos = actor.gameObject.transform.position
    local rootPos = self.transform.position
    savedBoardOffset = UnityEngine.Vector3(actorPos.x - rootPos.x, actorPos.y - rootPos.y, actorPos.z - rootPos.z)
    savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    currentPlayer = actor
    hasPassenger = true
    setButtonText(ExitButtonText)
    notifyPassenger(true)
    pushDriveInput(moveVec, "seat-enter")
  end

  savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    currentPlayer = nil
    hasPassenger = false
    pushDriveInput(UnityEngine.Vector2.zero, "seat-exit")
    notifyPassenger(false)
    setButtonText(BoardButtonText)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(eventData)
  if not AutoExitOnMoveStick then return end
  local localPlayer = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if localPlayer == nil or currentPlayer ~= localPlayer then return end
  localPlayer:StandUp(self.gameObject)
end

function GetLastControlSource()
  return lastControlSource
end

-- 可拾取的卡皮巴拉打地鼠锤：靠近拾取，手持时显示挥锤按钮并通过 Runtime Host 结算命中。

---@group 交互

---@name 放下文案

---@name 挥锤冷却
---@desc 两次有效挥锤之间的最短间隔，单位秒
---@range 0.15,2,0.05
---@group 攻击
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local DouyinNetService = CS.DouyinNetService
local UIType = CS.UIType
local DouyinUIService = CS.DouyinUIService
local EventTrigger = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTrigger
local EventTriggerType = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTriggerType
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-capybara-hammer")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

local RESOURCE_ID = "module-capybara-whack-hammer"
local TARGET_RESOURCE_ID = "module-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-3"
local HOST_SCRIPT_ID = "runtime-host.lua"
local GRIP_ANCHOR_PATH = "ModuleRoot/Handle/GripAnchor"
local HIT_POINT_PATH = "ModuleRoot/HammerHead/HitPoint"
local HEAD_PATH = "ModuleRoot/HammerHead"
local RESOURCE_TAG = "capybaraHammer"
local pickupHand = CS.HandType.Right
-- 手持锤子时的握持抬升角度（度）：仅围绕握把（GripAnchor）旋转，使锤头相对默认姿态大幅向上/向后扬起。
-- 目标姿态参考截图：锤头高高举起朝上偏后、锤柄斜向前下方握持。
-- 只改握持旋转角度，不改握持位置（绕握把 pivot 旋转，握持接触点保持不动）。
local HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES = 88
-- 握柄轴向翻转角度（度）：绕"握把→锤头"的握柄轴旋转，使锤头方向翻转 180 度。
-- 同样绕握把 pivot 旋转，握持接触点位置保持不变。
local HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES = 180
-- 挥锤动作是否随握柄翻转同步适配：翻转 180 度后，绕锤子右轴的挥击方向会相对反向，
-- 置为 true 时自动镜像挥击/抖动方向，使翻转后的挥锤手感与握持姿态保持一致。
-- 命中结算窗口（SWING_IMPACT_DELAY 时刻上报命中）不受影响。
local SWING_MATCH_HOLD_FLIP = false
local SWING_SECONDS = 0.42
local SWING_IMPACT_DELAY = 0.23
local SWING_BACKSWING_DEGREES = 28
local SWING_ANGLE_DEGREES = -105
local HIT_PULSE_SECONDS = 0.28
local HIT_PULSE_SCALE = 0.3
local HIT_SQUASH_SCALE = 0.1
local HIT_SHAKE_SECONDS = 0.22
local HIT_SHAKE_DEGREES = 7
local REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.5
local MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS = 20

local triggerCollider, triggerReason = Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
if triggerCollider == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("trigger-scale-failed", "trigger range not adjusted", triggerReason)
end

local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "hammer host features disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
end

local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false

local gripPoint = nil
local hitPoint = nil
local headTransform = nil
local headBaseScale = nil
local rigidbody = nil
local isKinematic = false
local bodyColliders = {}
local currentPlayer = nil
local prevParent = nil

local attackBtn = nil
local attackTrigger = nil
local swingActive = false
local swingStartTime = 0
local swingImpactTime = 0
local nextSwingAllowedAt = 0
local hitReportedForSwing = false
local swingShouldReportHit = false
local baseLocalPosition = nil
local baseLocalEuler = nil
local hitPulseUntil = 0
local impactShakeUntil = 0

local resourceEntry = nil
local registerAttemptCount = 0
local nextRegisterDelay = 0

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function isHeldByLocal()
  return currentPlayer ~= nil and currentPlayer.isLocal
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

local function ClearTrigger(trigger)
  if trigger == nil then return end
  if trigger.triggers ~= nil then
    trigger.triggers:Clear()
  end
end

local function BindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  if btn == nil or btn.gameObject == nil then return nil end
  local trigger = btn.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  if trigger == nil then
    trigger = btn.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  end
  ClearTrigger(trigger)

  local entryDown = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryDown.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerDown
  entryDown.callback:AddListener(function(_) onDown() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryDown)

  local entryUp = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryUp.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerUp
  entryUp.callback:AddListener(function(_) onUp() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryUp)

  return trigger
end

local function SetActionButtonText(btn, text)
  if btn == nil then return end
  local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function SetupActionButton(uiType, btnText, onDown, onUp)
  local btn = DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(uiType)
  if btn == nil then return nil, nil end
  btn.gameObject:SetActive(true)
  btn.transition = UnityEngine.UI.Selectable.Transition.None
  if CS.ButtonTweenEffect ~= nil then
    local tween = btn.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.ButtonTweenEffect), true)
    if tween ~= nil then
      tween.enabled = false
    end
  end
  SetActionButtonText(btn, btnText)
  local trigger = BindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  return btn, trigger
end

  if trigger ~= nil then ClearTrigger(trigger) end
  if btn ~= nil then btn.gameObject:SetActive(false) end
end
