end

local function getRuntimeHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable", "Runtime Scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end

  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT_ID)
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "Runtime Host unavailable", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function collectBodyColliders()
  local result = {}
  local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if colliders ~= nil then
    for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
      local col = colliders[i]
      if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then
        result[#result + 1] = col
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled)
  for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do
    if col ~= nil then
      col.enabled = enabled
    end
  end
end

local function disablePhysical()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = true
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(false)
end

local function enablePhysical()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
end

-- 手持时把锤子绕握把（GripAnchor）大幅向上/向后抬起 HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES 度，并绕握柄轴翻转 HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES 度，使默认姿态与截图一致。
-- 仅调整握持"角度"：全部绕握把 pivot 旋转，握持接触点位置保持不变；不修改任何 localPosition 坐标。
-- 旋转后重新缓存基准姿态，挥锤动画与命中结算逻辑均基于该基准，交互逻辑保持不变。
local function applyHoldPitch()
  if self == nil or self.transform == nil then
    return
  end
  if (HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES == nil or HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES == 0) and (HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES == nil or HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES == 0) then
    return
  end

  if gripPoint ~= nil then
    -- 1) 绕握把中心、沿锤子右轴向上抬起，保证握持点不发生位移，只改变锤子仰角
    if HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES ~= nil and HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES ~= 0 then
      self.transform:RotateAround(gripPoint.position, self.transform.right, -HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES)
    end
    -- 2) 绕"握把→锤头"的握柄轴翻转锤头方向，同样以握把为 pivot，握持点不移动
    if HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES ~= nil and HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES ~= 0 then
      local axis
      if hitPoint ~= nil then
        axis = hitPoint.position - gripPoint.position
      else
        axis = self.transform.up
      end
      if axis.sqrMagnitude > 0.000001 then
        self.transform:RotateAround(gripPoint.position, axis, HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES)
      end
    end
  else
    -- 兜底：无握把时绕自身轴旋转朝向
    if HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES ~= nil and HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES ~= 0 then
      self.transform:Rotate(self.transform.right, -HOLD_PITCH_DEGREES, UnityEngine.Space.World)
    end
    if HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES ~= nil and HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES ~= 0 then
      self.transform:Rotate(self.transform.up, HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES, UnityEngine.Space.World)
    end
  end

  -- 以抬升后的姿态作为静止握持基准，供挥锤动画复位使用
  baseLocalPosition = self.transform.localPosition
  baseLocalEuler = self.transform.localEulerAngles
end

local function updateTransform(handType, pickupMatrix)
  if currentPlayer == nil then return end
  local isLeft = handType == CS.HandType.Left
  local palmPosition, palmRotation = currentPlayer:CalculatePalmTransform(isLeft)
  local palmWorldMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    palmPosition,
    palmRotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  local finalMatrix = palmWorldMatrix * pickupMatrix
  self.transform.position = finalMatrix:GetPosition()
  self.transform.rotation = finalMatrix.rotation
end

local function computeGripMatrix()
  if gripPoint == nil then
    return UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity
  end
  local selfMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    self.transform.position,
    self.transform.rotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  local gripMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    gripPoint.position,
    gripPoint.rotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  return selfMat.inverse * gripMat
end

local function tryPickupOrDrop(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  if isHeldByLocal() then
    actor:Drop(self.gameObject)
  else
    disablePhysical()
    actor:Pickup(self.gameObject, pickupHand, computeGripMatrix())
  end
end

local function findNearestTarget()
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.GetResources) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  if hitPoint == nil then
    return nil
  end

  local ok, targets = pcall(function()
    return host.GetResources({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID })
  end)
  if not ok or type(targets) ~= "table" then
    logger:warnOnce("target-query-failed", "hammer target query failed", targets)
    return nil
  end

  local hitPos = hitPoint.position
  local radiusSq = HitRadius * HitRadius
  local best = nil
  local bestDistanceSq = radiusSq
  for _, entry in ipairs(targets) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil and entry.gameObject.transform ~= nil then
      local pos = entry.gameObject.transform.position
      local dx = pos.x - hitPos.x
      local dy = pos.y - hitPos.y
      local dz = pos.z - hitPos.z
      local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
      if distSq <= bestDistanceSq then
        bestDistanceSq = distSq
        best = entry.gameObject
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function reportHammerHit()
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.ReportHammerHit) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("hammer-hit-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: ReportHammerHit")
    return false
  end

  local targetGo = findNearestTarget()
  if targetGo == nil then
    return false
  end

  local ok, acceptedOrError = pcall(function()
    return host.ReportHammerHit({
      targetGameObject = targetGo,
      hammerGameObject = resourceRoot,
      hitRadius = HitRadius,
    })
  end)
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("hammer-hit-failed", "ReportHammerHit failed", acceptedOrError)
    return false
  end

  if acceptedOrError == true then
    hitPulseUntil = Time.time + HIT_PULSE_SECONDS
    impactShakeUntil = Time.time + HIT_SHAKE_SECONDS
    return true
  end
  return false
end

local function smoothStep01(value)
  local t = tonumber(value) or 0
  if t < 0 then t = 0 end
  if t > 1 then t = 1 end
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

local function computeSwingAngle(t)
  if t < 0.22 then
    local p = smoothStep01(t / 0.22)
    return SWING_BACKSWING_DEGREES * p
  end

  if t < 0.58 then
    local p = smoothStep01((t - 0.22) / 0.36)
    return SWING_BACKSWING_DEGREES + (SWING_ANGLE_DEGREES - SWING_BACKSWING_DEGREES) * p
  end

  local p = smoothStep01((t - 0.58) / 0.42)
  return SWING_ANGLE_DEGREES * (1 - p)
end

local function computeImpactShake(now)
  if now >= impactShakeUntil then
    return 0
  end
  local remain = (impactShakeUntil - now) / HIT_SHAKE_SECONDS
  return math.sin(remain * math.pi * 8) * HIT_SHAKE_DEGREES * remain
end

local function beginSwingVisual(shouldReportHit)
  local now = Time.time
  swingActive = true
  swingStartTime = now
  swingImpactTime = now + SWING_IMPACT_DELAY
  hitReportedForSwing = false
  swingShouldReportHit = shouldReportHit == true
  if baseLocalPosition == nil then
    baseLocalPosition = self.transform.localPosition
  end
  if baseLocalEuler == nil then
    baseLocalEuler = self.transform.localEulerAngles
  end
end

local function startSwing()
  if not isHeldByLocal() or not self:HasOwnership() then
    return
  end
  local now = Time.time
  if now < nextSwingAllowedAt then
    return
  end
  nextSwingAllowedAt = now + SwingCooldown
  beginSwingVisual(true)
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host ~= nil and type(host.RequestHammerSwing) == "function" then
    pcall(host.RequestHammerSwing)
  end
end

local function showAttackButton()
  hideAttackButton()
  attackBtn, attackTrigger = SetupActionButton(
    UIType.CustomMain,
    attackButtonText,
    function() startSwing() end,
    function() end
  )
end

local function resetSwingPose()
  if baseLocalPosition ~= nil and self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil then
    self.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseLocalPosition.x, baseLocalPosition.y, baseLocalPosition.z)
  end
  if baseLocalEuler ~= nil and self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil then
    self.transform.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseLocalEuler.x, baseLocalEuler.y, baseLocalEuler.z)
  end
  if headTransform ~= nil and headBaseScale ~= nil then
    headTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(headBaseScale.x, headBaseScale.y, headBaseScale.z)
  end
end

-- 挥锤方向系数：握柄翻转 180 度后，绕锤子右轴的挥击相对反向，
-- 开启同步适配时取反，使翻转后的挥锤仍朝自然的下劈方向，命中窗口逻辑不变。
local function getSwingDirection()
  if SWING_MATCH_HOLD_FLIP and HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES ~= nil then
    -- 翻转角接近 180 的奇数倍时朝向反转，需要取反补偿
    local normalized = math.abs(HOLD_ROLL_DEGREES % 360)
    if normalized > 90 and normalized < 270 then
      return -1
    end
  end
  return 1
end

local function applySwingAroundHandle(swingAngle, shakeAngle)
  resetSwingPose()

  local dir = getSwingDirection()
  swingAngle = swingAngle * dir
  shakeAngle = shakeAngle * dir

  if gripPoint == nil then
    self.transform.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      baseLocalEuler.x + swingAngle,
      baseLocalEuler.y,
      baseLocalEuler.z + shakeAngle
    )
    return
  end

  local pivot = gripPoint.position
  self.transform:RotateAround(pivot, self.transform.right, swingAngle)
  if shakeAngle ~= 0 then
    self.transform:RotateAround(pivot, self.transform.forward, shakeAngle)
  end
end

local function updateSwingMotion()
  if not swingActive then
    return
  end
  if baseLocalEuler == nil then
    baseLocalEuler = self.transform.localEulerAngles
  end
  if baseLocalPosition == nil then
    baseLocalPosition = self.transform.localPosition
  end

  local now = Time.time
  if not hitReportedForSwing and now >= swingImpactTime then
    hitReportedForSwing = true
    if swingShouldReportHit then
      reportHammerHit()
    end
  end

  local t = (now - swingStartTime) / SWING_SECONDS
  if t >= 1 then
    swingActive = false
    swingShouldReportHit = false
    resetSwingPose()
    return
  end
  if t < 0 then t = 0 end

  local swing = computeSwingAngle(t)
  local shake = computeImpactShake(now)
  applySwingAroundHandle(swing, shake)
end

local function updateHitPulse()
  if headTransform == nil or headBaseScale == nil then
    return
  end
  local now = Time.time
  if now >= hitPulseUntil then
    headTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(headBaseScale.x, headBaseScale.y, headBaseScale.z)
    return
  end
  local t = (hitPulseUntil - now) / HIT_PULSE_SECONDS
  local pulse = 1 + t * HIT_PULSE_SCALE
  local squash = 1 - t * HIT_SQUASH_SCALE
  headTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(headBaseScale.x * pulse, headBaseScale.y * squash, headBaseScale.z * pulse)
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == "CapybaraGame.hammerSwing" then
    -- 持锤本地端已经即时播放；其余客户端只播放视觉，不进行命中结算。
    if not isHeldByLocal() then
      beginSwingVisual(false)
    end
    return true
  end
  return false
end

local function registerResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil then
    return true
  end
  if resourceRoot == nil then
    return false
  end

  registerAttemptCount = registerAttemptCount + 1
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  local ok, entryOrError = pcall(function()
    return host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
      tags = { RESOURCE_TAG },
      events = { "CapybaraGame.hammerSwing" },
      handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
      options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID, tag = RESOURCE_TAG },
    })
  end)
  if ok and entryOrError ~= nil then
    resourceEntry = entryOrError
    return true
  end
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-failed", "hammer registration failed", entryOrError)
  end
  return false
end

local function unregisterResource()
  if resourceEntry == nil then
    return
  end
  local entry = resourceEntry
  resourceEntry = nil
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      host.UnregisterResource(entry)
    end)
    if not ok then
      logger:warnOnce("unregister-resource-failed", "hammer unregister failed", err)
    end
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    gripPoint = runtimeScope:FindTransform(GRIP_ANCHOR_PATH)
    if gripPoint == nil then
      logger:warnOnce("grip-point-missing", "GripPoint missing")
    end
    hitPoint = runtimeScope:FindTransform(HIT_POINT_PATH)
    if hitPoint == nil then
      logger:warnOnce("hit-point-missing", "HitPoint missing")
    end
    headTransform = runtimeScope:FindTransform(HEAD_PATH)
    if headTransform ~= nil then
      headBaseScale = headTransform.localScale
    end
  end

  rigidbody = self.transform:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    isKinematic = rigidbody.isKinematic
  end
  bodyColliders = collectBodyColliders()
  registerResource()
end

function OnEnable()
  nextRegisterDelay = 0
  registerAttemptCount = 0
  registerResource()
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  if not isHeldByLocal() then
    localActor = nil
    removeInteractionButton()
    self:DisableInteraction()
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if isHeldByLocal() then
    setButtonText(dropText)
  else
    setButtonText(pickupText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    tryPickupOrDrop(localActor)
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnPickup(actor, handType, pickUpPoint)
  if actor == nil then return end

  local resolvedHandType = handType or pickupHand
  disablePhysical()
  currentPlayer = actor

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator ~= nil then
    local bone = nil
    if resolvedHandType == CS.HandType.Left then
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.LeftHand)
    else
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.RightHand)
    end
    if bone ~= nil then
      prevParent = self.transform.parent
      self.transform:SetParent(bone)
    end
  end

  local pickupMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity
  if pickUpPoint ~= nil then
    pickupMatrix = pickUpPoint.inverse
  end
  updateTransform(resolvedHandType, pickupMatrix)
  baseLocalPosition = self.transform.localPosition
  baseLocalEuler = self.transform.localEulerAngles
  applyHoldPitch()

  if actor.isLocal then
    localActor = actor
    setButtonText(dropText)
    showAttackButton()
  end
end

function OnDrop(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor ~= currentPlayer then return end

  swingActive = false
  hitReportedForSwing = false
  swingShouldReportHit = false
  resetSwingPose()
  self.transform:SetParent(prevParent)
  prevParent = nil
  enablePhysical()
  currentPlayer = nil
  baseLocalPosition = nil
  baseLocalEuler = nil

  if actor.isLocal then
    hideAttackButton()
    setButtonText(pickupText)
  end
end

function Update()
  updateSwingMotion()
  updateHitPulse()

  if resourceEntry == nil and registerAttemptCount < MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
    nextRegisterDelay = nextRegisterDelay - Time.deltaTime
    if nextRegisterDelay <= 0 then
      registerResource()
      nextRegisterDelay = REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL
    end
  end
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    if isHeldByLocal() then
      setButtonText(dropText)
    else
      setButtonText(pickupText)
    end
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  hideAttackButton()
  removeInteractionButton()
  unregisterResource()
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnDestroy()
  hideAttackButton()
  removeInteractionButton()
  unregisterResource()
end

713dd9cb-cbf3-40e3-a047-1f6fa7f05e41.content:
---@id 713dd9cb-cbf3-40e3-a047-1f6fa7f05e41
---@referenceName pi-capybara-target.lua
-- 卡皮巴拉打地鼠目标：接收 Runtime Host 激活事件，处理本地玩家踩踏并上报命中。
---@start
---@var RetractedHeight:number=-1.65
---@name 缩回高度
---@desc 未激活时相对初始位置向下缩回的高度，单位米
---@range -2.5,0,0.05
---@group 运动
---@var PopupHeight:number=-0.55
---@name 弹出高度
---@desc 激活时相对初始位置弹出的高度，单位米
---@range -1,1.5,0.05
---@group 运动
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@range 1,10,0.1
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local Object = CS.UnityEngine.Object
local RendererType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)
local ColliderType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider)
local RigidbodyType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Rigidbody)
local MaterialType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Material)
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-capybara-target")
local RESOURCE_ID = "module-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-3"
local RESOURCE_TAG = "capybaraTarget"
local HOST_SCRIPT_ID = "runtime-host.lua"

local EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE = "CapybaraGame.targetActivate"
local EVENT_TARGET_DEACTIVATE = "CapybaraGame.targetDeactivate"
local EVENT_TARGET_RESET = "CapybaraGame.targetReset"

local MOVE_SPEED = 3.2
local STOMP_RETRACT_SPEED = 8.5
local STOMP_FEEDBACK_SECONDS = 0.38
local STOMP_MIN_HEIGHT_ABOVE_TARGET = 0.65
local STOMP_EFFECT_SECONDS = 0.46
local STOMP_EFFECT_SPARK_COUNT = 6
local STOMP_DIZZY_SECONDS = 0.86
local STOMP_DIZZY_COUNT = 5
local STOMP_EFFECT_HEAD_Y = 1.56
local STOMP_EFFECT_HEAD_Z = 0.48
local ACTOR_DROP_ASSIST_SECONDS = 0.18
local ACTOR_DROP_EXTRA_SPEED = 3.8
local ACTOR_DROP_MIN_VELOCITY = -5.5
local REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.5
local MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS = 20

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "capybara target disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
end

local triggerCollider, triggerReason = Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
if triggerCollider == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("trigger-scale-failed", "trigger range not adjusted", triggerReason)
end

local targetTransform = nil
local baseLocalPosition = nil
local baseLocalScale = nil
local desiredYOffset = RetractedHeight
local stompFeedbackActive = false
local stompFeedbackUntil = 0
local pendingRetractAfterFeedback = false
local stompEffects = {}
local solidColliders = nil
local dropAssistActorTransform = nil
local dropAssistUntil = 0
local dropAssistLastTime = 0

local targetActive = false
local currentRoundId = nil
local currentTargetToken = nil
local reportedToken = nil

local resourceEntry = nil
local registerAttemptCount = 0
local nextRegisterDelay = 0

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
  return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function numberOrDefault(value, fallback)
  if isFiniteNumber(value) then
    return value
  end
  return fallback
end

local function ensureTransform()
  if targetTransform == nil and self ~= nil then
    targetTransform = self.transform
  end
  if targetTransform ~= nil and baseLocalPosition == nil then
    baseLocalPosition = targetTransform.localPosition
  end
  if targetTransform ~= nil and baseLocalScale == nil then
    baseLocalScale = targetTransform.localScale
  end
  return targetTransform ~= nil and baseLocalPosition ~= nil and baseLocalScale ~= nil
end

local function applyScaleMultiplier(xMultiplier, yMultiplier, zMultiplier)
  if not ensureTransform() then
    return
  end
  targetTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    baseLocalScale.x * numberOrDefault(xMultiplier, 1),
    baseLocalScale.y * numberOrDefault(yMultiplier, 1),
    baseLocalScale.z * numberOrDefault(zMultiplier, 1)
  )
end

local function resetScale()
  applyScaleMultiplier(1, 1, 1)
end

local function cacheSolidColliders()
  if solidColliders ~= nil then
    return
  end

  solidColliders = {}
  if self == nil or self.gameObject == nil then
    return
  end

  local ok, colliders = pcall(function()
    return self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(ColliderType, true)
  end)
  if not ok then
    ok, colliders = pcall(function()
      return self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(ColliderType)
    end)
  end
  if not ok or colliders == nil or colliders.Length == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("solid-collider-query-failed", "solid collider list unavailable")
    return
  end

  for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
    local collider = colliders[i]
    if collider ~= nil and collider ~= triggerCollider and collider.isTrigger ~= true then
      table.insert(solidColliders, collider)
    end
  end
end

local function setSolidCollidersEnabled(enabled)
  cacheSolidColliders()
  for _, collider in ipairs(solidColliders or {}) do
    if collider ~= nil then
      collider.enabled = enabled == true
    end
  end
end

local function createEffectMaterial(baseColor)
  local template = UnityEngine.Resources.Load("GAGAS_Mat", MaterialType)
  local material = nil

  if template ~= nil then
    material = UnityEngine.Material(template)
  else
    local shader = UnityEngine.Shader.Find("Douyin/AI/Cartoon/ItemNPR_NoOutline")
    if shader ~= nil then
      material = UnityEngine.Material(shader)
    end
  end

  if material == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("stomp-effect-material-missing", "supported stomp effect material unavailable")
    return nil
  end

  material:SetColor("_BaseColor", baseColor)
  material:SetColor("_DarkColor", baseColor)
  material:SetFloat("_ColorPower", 1.25)
  return material
end

local function destroyEffectEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then
    return
  end

  if entry.gameObject ~= nil then
    Object.Destroy(entry.gameObject)
  end
  if entry.material ~= nil then
    Object.Destroy(entry.material)
  end
end

local function clearStompEffects()
  for i = #stompEffects, 1, -1 do
    destroyEffectEntry(stompEffects[i])
    table.remove(stompEffects, i)
  end
end

local function disablePrimitiveCollider(go)
  if go == nil then
    return
  end

  local collider = go:GetComponent(ColliderType)
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = false
  end
end

local function addStompEffectPrimitive(name, localPosition, localScale, direction, duration, baseColor, effectKind, primitiveType)
  if targetTransform == nil then
    return
  end

  local material = createEffectMaterial(baseColor)
  if material == nil then
    return
  end

  local ok, go = pcall(function()
    return UnityEngine.GameObject.CreatePrimitive(primitiveType or UnityEngine.PrimitiveType.Sphere)
  end)
  if not ok or go == nil then
    Object.Destroy(material)
    logger:warnOnce("stomp-effect-create-failed", "failed to create stomp effect primitive", go)
    return
  end

  go.name = name
  disablePrimitiveCollider(go)
  local renderer = go:GetComponent(RendererType)
  if renderer ~= nil then
    renderer.sharedMaterial = material
  else
    Object.Destroy(go)
    Object.Destroy(material)
    logger:warnOnce("stomp-effect-renderer-missing", "stomp effect renderer missing")
    return
  end

  local transform = go.transform
  transform:SetParent(targetTransform, false)
  transform.localPosition = localPosition
  transform.localScale = localScale

  table.insert(stompEffects, {
    gameObject = go,
    transform = transform,
    material = material,
    startTime = Time.time,
    duration = duration,
    basePosition = localPosition,
    baseScale = localScale,
    direction = direction,
    kind = effectKind,
  })
end

local function spawnStompEffect()
  if not ensureTransform() then
    return
  end

  local topY = STOMP_EFFECT_HEAD_Y
  local headZ = STOMP_EFFECT_HEAD_Z
  addStompEffectPrimitive(
    "StompShockDisc",
    UnityEngine.Vector3(0, topY, headZ),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(0.24, 0.025, 0.24),
    UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
    STOMP_EFFECT_SECONDS,
    UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 0.68, 0.12, 1),
    "disc"
  )

  for i = 1, STOMP_EFFECT_SPARK_COUNT do
    local angle = (i - 1) / STOMP_EFFECT_SPARK_COUNT * math.pi * 2
    local dirX = math.cos(angle)
    local dirZ = math.sin(angle)
    addStompEffectPrimitive(
      "StompSpark" .. tostring(i),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(dirX * 0.06, topY + 0.035, headZ + dirZ * 0.06),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(0.055, 0.055, 0.055),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(dirX * 0.15, 0.12, dirZ * 0.15),
      STOMP_EFFECT_SECONDS,
      UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.28, 1),
      "spark"
    )
  end

  for i = 1, STOMP_DIZZY_COUNT do
    local angle = (i - 1) / STOMP_DIZZY_COUNT * math.pi * 2
    addStompEffectPrimitive(
      "DizzyStar" .. tostring(i),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(math.cos(angle) * 0.34, topY + 0.28, headZ + math.sin(angle) * 0.2),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(0.11, 0.035, 0.11),
      UnityEngine.Vector3(angle, 0.035, 0),
      STOMP_DIZZY_SECONDS,
      UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.16, 1),
      "dizzy",
      UnityEngine.PrimitiveType.Cube
    )
  end
end

local function updateStompEffects()
  local now = Time.time
  for i = #stompEffects, 1, -1 do
    local entry = stompEffects[i]
    if entry == nil or entry.transform == nil or entry.duration <= 0 then
      destroyEffectEntry(entry)
      table.remove(stompEffects, i)
    else
      local t = (now - entry.startTime) / entry.duration
      if t >= 1 then
        destroyEffectEntry(entry)
        table.remove(stompEffects, i)
      elseif entry.kind == "disc" then
        local expand = 1 + t * 1.5
        local shrinkY = 1 - t * 0.75
        entry.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
          entry.baseScale.x * expand,
          entry.baseScale.y * shrinkY,
          entry.baseScale.z * expand
        )
      elseif entry.kind == "dizzy" then
        local angle = entry.direction.x + t * math.pi * 2.6
        local fadeScale = 1 - t * 0.55
        local pulse = 0.92 + math.sin(t * math.pi * 8) * 0.16
        entry.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(
          math.cos(angle) * 0.34,
          entry.basePosition.y + math.sin(t * math.pi * 4 + entry.direction.x) * entry.direction.y,
          STOMP_EFFECT_HEAD_Z + math.sin(angle) * 0.2
        )
        entry.transform.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, angle * 57.2958, 35)
        entry.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
          entry.baseScale.x * fadeScale * pulse,
          entry.baseScale.y * fadeScale,
          entry.baseScale.z * fadeScale * pulse
        )
      else
        local fadeScale = 1 - t
        entry.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(
          entry.basePosition.x + entry.direction.x * t,
          entry.basePosition.y + entry.direction.y * t,
          entry.basePosition.z + entry.direction.z * t
        )
        entry.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
          entry.baseScale.x * fadeScale,
          entry.baseScale.y * fadeScale,
          entry.baseScale.z * fadeScale
        )
      end
    end
  end
end

local function getActorTransform(actor)
  if actor == nil then
    return nil
  end

  local ok, actorTransform = pcall(function()
    return actor.transform
  end)
  if ok and actorTransform ~= nil then
    return actorTransform
  end

  local okGameObject, actorGameObject = pcall(function()
    return actor.gameObject
  end)
  if okGameObject and actorGameObject ~= nil then
    return actorGameObject.transform
  end

  return nil
end

local function getActorGameObject(actor)
  if actor == nil then
    return nil
  end

  local ok, actorGameObject = pcall(function()
    return actor.gameObject
  end)
  if ok and actorGameObject ~= nil then
    return actorGameObject
  end

  local actorTransform = getActorTransform(actor)
  if actorTransform ~= nil then
    local okFromTransform, go = pcall(function()
      return actorTransform.gameObject
    end)
    if okFromTransform then
      return go
    end
  end

  return nil
end

local function tryApplyRigidbodyDrop(actor)
  local actorGameObject = getActorGameObject(actor)
  if actorGameObject == nil then
    return false
  end

  local ok, rigidbody = pcall(function()
    return actorGameObject:GetComponent(RigidbodyType)
  end)
  if not ok or rigidbody == nil then
    return false
  end

  local okVelocity, velocity = pcall(function()
    return rigidbody.velocity
  end)
  if not okVelocity or velocity == nil then
    return false
  end

  local nextY = velocity.y
  if nextY > ACTOR_DROP_MIN_VELOCITY then
    nextY = ACTOR_DROP_MIN_VELOCITY
  end

  local okSet = pcall(function()
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(velocity.x, nextY, velocity.z)
  end)
  return okSet == true
end

local function startActorDropAssist(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.isLocal ~= true then
    return
  end

  if tryApplyRigidbodyDrop(actor) then
    dropAssistActorTransform = nil
    dropAssistUntil = 0
    return
  end

  local actorTransform = getActorTransform(actor)
  if actorTransform == nil then
    return
  end

  dropAssistActorTransform = actorTransform
  dropAssistUntil = Time.time + ACTOR_DROP_ASSIST_SECONDS
  dropAssistLastTime = Time.time
end

local function updateActorDropAssist()
  if dropAssistActorTransform == nil then
    return
  end

  local now = Time.time
  if now >= dropAssistUntil then
    dropAssistActorTransform = nil
    dropAssistUntil = 0
    return
  end

  local dt = now - dropAssistLastTime
  dropAssistLastTime = now
  if dt <= 0 then
    return
  end
  if dt > 0.05 then
    dt = 0.05
  end

  local ok, pos = pcall(function()
    return dropAssistActorTransform.position
  end)
  if not ok or pos == nil then
    dropAssistActorTransform = nil
    return
  end

  local downDistance = ACTOR_DROP_EXTRA_SPEED * dt
  pcall(function()
    dropAssistActorTransform.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(pos.x, pos.y - downDistance, pos.z)
  end)
end

local function isStompFromAbove(actor)
  if not ensureTransform() then
    return false
  end

  local actorTransform = getActorTransform(actor)
  if actorTransform == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("actor-transform-missing", "stomp check skipped: actor transform unavailable")
    return false
  end

  local actorY = actorTransform.position.y
  local targetY = targetTransform.position.y
  return actorY >= targetY + STOMP_MIN_HEIGHT_ABOVE_TARGET
end

local function setDesiredYOffset(offset, instant)
  desiredYOffset = numberOrDefault(offset, RetractedHeight)
  if not instant then
    return
  end
  if not ensureTransform() then
    return
  end
  targetTransform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    baseLocalPosition.x,
    baseLocalPosition.y + desiredYOffset,
    baseLocalPosition.z
  )
end

local function deactivateTarget(instant)
  stompFeedbackActive = false
  pendingRetractAfterFeedback = false
  targetActive = false
  currentRoundId = nil
  currentTargetToken = nil
  reportedToken = nil
  dropAssistActorTransform = nil
  dropAssistUntil = 0
  resetScale()
  setSolidCollidersEnabled(false)
  if instant then
    clearStompEffects()
  end
  setDesiredYOffset(RetractedHeight, instant)
end

local function activateTarget(roundId, targetToken)
  stompFeedbackActive = false
  pendingRetractAfterFeedback = false
  clearStompEffects()
  resetScale()
  setSolidCollidersEnabled(true)
  targetActive = true
  currentRoundId = roundId
  currentTargetToken = targetToken
  reportedToken = nil
  setDesiredYOffset(PopupHeight, false)
end

local function startStompFeedback()
  if stompFeedbackActive and Time.time < stompFeedbackUntil then
    return
  end

  targetActive = false
  currentRoundId = nil
  currentTargetToken = nil
  stompFeedbackActive = true
  pendingRetractAfterFeedback = false
  stompFeedbackUntil = Time.time + STOMP_FEEDBACK_SECONDS
  setDesiredYOffset(RetractedHeight, false)
  setSolidCollidersEnabled(false)
  applyScaleMultiplier(1.16, 0.58, 1.16)
  spawnStompEffect()
end

local function updateStompFeedback()
  if not stompFeedbackActive then
    return
  end
  if Time.time < stompFeedbackUntil then
    return
  end

  stompFeedbackActive = false
  resetScale()
  if pendingRetractAfterFeedback then
    pendingRetractAfterFeedback = false
    setDesiredYOffset(RetractedHeight, false)
  end
end

local function payloadMatchesCurrentActivation(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then
    return true
  end
  if payload.roundId ~= nil and currentRoundId ~= nil and payload.roundId ~= currentRoundId then
    return false
  end
  if payload.targetToken ~= nil and currentTargetToken ~= nil and payload.targetToken ~= currentTargetToken then
    return false
  end
  return true
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == EVENT_TARGET_RESET then
    deactivateTarget(false)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_TARGET_DEACTIVATE then
    if payloadMatchesCurrentActivation(payload) then
      if type(payload) == "table" and payload.stomped == true then
        startStompFeedback()
        return true
      end
      deactivateTarget(false)
      return true
    end
    return false
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE then
    if type(payload) ~= "table" then
      logger:warnOnce("target-activate-invalid", "invalid target activation payload")
      deactivateTarget(false)
      return false
    end

    if payload.active ~= true then
      deactivateTarget(false)
      return true
    end

    local roundId = payload.roundId
    local targetToken = payload.targetToken
    if type(roundId) ~= "number" or roundId <= 0 or type(targetToken) ~= "string" or targetToken == "" then
      logger:warnOnce("target-activate-invalid-fields", "invalid target activation fields")
      deactivateTarget(false)
      return false
    end

    activateTarget(roundId, targetToken)
    return true
  end

  return false
end

local function getRuntimeHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "Runtime Host unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end

  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT_ID)
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "Runtime Host unavailable", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function registerResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil then
    return true
  end
  if resourceRoot == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-root-unavailable", "resource root unavailable")
    return false
  end

  registerAttemptCount = registerAttemptCount + 1
  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil then
    return false
  end
  if type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: RegisterResource")
    return false
  end

  local ok, entryOrError = pcall(function()
    return host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
      tags = { RESOURCE_TAG },
      events = { EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE, EVENT_TARGET_DEACTIVATE, EVENT_TARGET_RESET },
      handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
      options = {
        resourceId = RESOURCE_ID,
        tag = RESOURCE_TAG
      }
    })
  end)

  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-failed", "RegisterResource failed", entryOrError)
    return false
  end
  if entryOrError == nil or entryOrError == false then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-empty", "RegisterResource returned no entry")
    return false
  end

  resourceEntry = entryOrError
  logger:info("registered capybara target")
  return true
end

local function unregisterResource()
  if resourceEntry == nil then
    return
  end

  local entry = resourceEntry
  resourceEntry = nil

  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil then
    return
  end
  if type(host.UnregisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("unregister-resource-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: UnregisterResource")
    return
  end

  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    return host.UnregisterResource(entry)
  end)
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("unregister-resource-failed", "UnregisterResource failed", err)
  end
end

local function reportStompHit(actor)
  if currentTargetToken == nil or currentTargetToken == "" or currentRoundId == nil or currentRoundId <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if reportedToken == currentTargetToken then
    return false
  end

  local host = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil then
    reportedToken = currentTargetToken
    return false
  end
  if type(host.ReportStompHit) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("report-hit-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: ReportStompHit")
    reportedToken = currentTargetToken
    return false
  end

  local payload = {
    roundId = currentRoundId,
    targetToken = currentTargetToken,
    targetGameObject = resourceRoot
  }

  reportedToken = currentTargetToken
  local ok, acceptedOrError = pcall(function()
    return host.ReportStompHit(payload)
  end)
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("report-hit-failed", "ReportStompHit failed", acceptedOrError)
    return false
  end

  if acceptedOrError == true then
    startActorDropAssist(actor)
    startStompFeedback()
    return true
  end
  return false
end

local function updateMotion(deltaTime)
  if not ensureTransform() then
    return
  end

  local targetY = baseLocalPosition.y + numberOrDefault(desiredYOffset, RetractedHeight)
  local pos = targetTransform.localPosition
  local dy = targetY - pos.y
  if math.abs(dy) <= 0.001 then
    targetTransform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseLocalPosition.x, targetY, baseLocalPosition.z)
    return
  end

  local currentMoveSpeed = MOVE_SPEED
  if stompFeedbackActive and desiredYOffset == RetractedHeight then
    currentMoveSpeed = STOMP_RETRACT_SPEED
  end

  local step = currentMoveSpeed * numberOrDefault(deltaTime, 0)
  if step <= 0 or math.abs(dy) <= step then
    targetTransform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseLocalPosition.x, targetY, baseLocalPosition.z)
    return
  end

  local direction = dy > 0 and 1 or -1
  targetTransform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseLocalPosition.x, pos.y + step * direction, baseLocalPosition.z)
end

function Start()
  ensureTransform()
  deactivateTarget(true)
  registerResource()
end

function OnEnable()
  nextRegisterDelay = 0
  registerAttemptCount = 0
  registerResource()
end

function Update()
  updateStompFeedback()
  updateStompEffects()
  updateActorDropAssist()
  updateMotion(Time.deltaTime)

  if resourceEntry == nil and registerAttemptCount < MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
    nextRegisterDelay = nextRegisterDelay - Time.deltaTime
    if nextRegisterDelay <= 0 then
      registerResource()
      nextRegisterDelay = REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL
    end
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.isLocal ~= true then
    return
  end
  if not targetActive then
    return
  end
  if not isStompFromAbove(actor) then
    return
  end
  reportStompHit(actor)
end

function OnDisable()
  unregisterResource()
  deactivateTarget(true)
end

function OnDestroy()
  unregisterResource()
  clearStompEffects()
end

97bd34fd-b3a1-423f-8d59-4a2643c0f9f0.content:
---@id 97bd34fd-b3a1-423f-8d59-4a2643c0f9f0
---@referenceName pi-game-panel.lua
-- 管理圆盘打地鼠机的开始按钮显隐与开始交互。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@range 1,10,0.1
---@group 交互
---@var interactionButtonText:string="开始游戏"
---@name 交互按钮文案
---@desc 玩家靠近圆盘后显示的按钮文案
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local DouyinNetService = CS.DouyinNetService
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-capy-arena")
local RESOURCE_ID = "module-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-12"
local ROUND_DURATION = 30
local MAX_SCORE = 99
local REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.5
local REGISTER_RETRY_MAX = 20

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "cross-resource feature disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
end

local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local currentRoundActive = false
local startButtonGo = nil
local resourceEntry = nil
local registerAttempts = 0
local registerTimer = 0

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

local function setObjectActive(go, active)
  if go ~= nil then
    go:SetActive(active == true)
  end
end

local function setRoundVisualActive(active)
  currentRoundActive = active == true
  setObjectActive(startButtonGo, not currentRoundActive)

  if currentRoundActive then
    removeInteractionButton()
    self:DisableInteraction()
  else
    if localActor ~= nil then
      self:EnableInteraction()
    end
  end
end

local function cacheNodes()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    return
  end

  startButtonGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("ModuleRoot/StartButton")
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == "CapybaraGame.roundStarted" then
    setRoundVisualActive(true)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == "CapybaraGame.roundEnded" then
    setRoundVisualActive(false)
    return true
  end

  return false
end

local function tryRegisterResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil then
    return true
  end

  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
    return false
  end

  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "arena event registration skipped", hostReason)
    return false
  end
  if type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: RegisterResource")
    return false
  end

  local ok, entry = pcall(host.RegisterResource, resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    tags = { "capybara-whack-arena" },
    events = {
      "CapybaraGame.roundStarted",
      "CapybaraGame.roundEnded",
    },
    handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })

  if ok and entry ~= nil then
    resourceEntry = entry
    return true
  end

  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-failed", "arena registration failed", entry)
  else
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-empty", "arena registration returned nil")
  end
  return false
end

local function unregisterResource()
  if resourceEntry == nil or runtimeScope == nil then
    resourceEntry = nil
    return
  end

  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    local ok, err = pcall(host.UnregisterResource, resourceEntry)
    if not ok then
      logger:warnOnce("unregister-resource-failed", "arena unregister failed", err)
    end
  else
    logger:warnOnce("unregister-resource-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: UnregisterResource", hostReason)
  end

  resourceEntry = nil
end

local function callStartRound()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable-start", "StartRound skipped", runtimeScopeReason)
    return false
  end

  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "StartRound skipped", hostReason)
    return false
  end
  if type(host.StartRound) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("start-round-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: StartRound")
    return false
  end

  local ok, result = pcall(host.StartRound, { duration = ROUND_DURATION, maxScore = MAX_SCORE })
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("start-round-failed", "StartRound call failed", result)
    return false
  end

  return result == true
end

local function updateRoundStateFromHost()
  if not currentRoundActive or runtimeScope == nil then
    return
  end

  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil or type(host.GetGameState) ~= "function" then
    return
  end

  local ok, state = pcall(host.GetGameState)
  if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" then
    return
  end

  if state.roundActive ~= true then
    setRoundVisualActive(false)
  end
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

-- 主权检查：用于按钮点击，或按钮外修改网络对象之前。
local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

function Start()
  cacheNodes()
  setRoundVisualActive(false)
  tryRegisterResource()
end

function Update()
  updateRoundStateFromHost()

  if resourceEntry ~= nil or registerAttempts >= REGISTER_RETRY_MAX then
    return
  end

  registerTimer = registerTimer + Time.deltaTime
  if registerTimer < REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL then
    return
  end

  registerTimer = 0
  registerAttempts = registerAttempts + 1
  tryRegisterResource()
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  if not currentRoundActive then
    self:EnableInteraction()
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  if currentRoundActive then
    return
  end
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  setButtonText(interactionButtonText)
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil or currentRoundActive then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if callStartRound() then
      setRoundVisualActive(true)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    setButtonText(interactionButtonText)
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
  localActor = nil
  currentRoundActive = false
  setObjectActive(startButtonGo, true)
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnDestroy()
  unregisterResource()
  removeInteractionButton()
  localActor = nil
end

4843c07a-6a1d-4639-ad1c-6bec5f7b7c08.content:
---@id 4843c07a-6a1d-4639-ad1c-6bec5f7b7c08
---@referenceName runtime-host.lua
