-- 卡皮巴拉打地鼠玩法 Runtime Host：登记资源、刷新目标、计分，并支持手持锤命中结算。
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local hostLogger = Logger.create("runtime-host")
local hostReady = false

local TARGET_RESOURCE_ID = "module-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-3"
local ARENA_RESOURCE_ID = "module-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-12"
local RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID = "ui-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-2"
local HAMMER_RESOURCE_ID = "module-capybara-whack-hammer"

local EVENT_ROUND_STARTED = "CapybaraGame.roundStarted"
local EVENT_ROUND_ENDED = "CapybaraGame.roundEnded"
local EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED = "CapybaraGame.scoreChanged"
local EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE = "CapybaraGame.targetActivate"
local EVENT_TARGET_DEACTIVATE = "CapybaraGame.targetDeactivate"
local EVENT_TARGET_RESET = "CapybaraGame.targetReset"
local EVENT_SHOW_RESULT = "CapybaraGame.showResult"
local EVENT_HAMMER_SWING = "CapybaraGame.hammerSwing"

local DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS = 30
local DEFAULT_MAX_SCORE = 99
local TARGET_VISIBLE_SECONDS = 2.0
local NEXT_TARGET_DELAY_SECONDS = 0.25
local TARGET_RETRY_SECONDS = 0.5

local resources = {}
local resourceIdIndex = {}
local resourceTagIndex = {}
local resourceObjectIndex = {}
local registry = {}
local statsVersion = 0

local gameState = {
  roundActive = false,
  roundId = 0,
  score = 0,
  displayScore = 0,
  maxScore = DEFAULT_MAX_SCORE,
  duration = DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS,
  timeLeft = 0,
  roundEndTime = 0,
}

local settledTokens = {}
local activeTargetEntry = nil
local activeTargetToken = nil
local activeTargetExpiresAt = 0
local nextTargetAt = 0
local targetSerial = 0
local networkReady = false
local nextStatePublishAt = 0
local appliedRoundId = -1
local appliedRoundActive = false
local appliedScore = -1
local appliedTargetSerial = -1
local hammerSwingSerial = 0
local appliedHammerSwingSerial = 0
local STATE_SYNC_INTERVAL = 0.25

local function cloneShallowTable(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end
  for key, value in pairs(source) do
    result[key] = value
  end
  return result
end

local function cloneArray(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end
  for _, value in ipairs(source) do
    table.insert(result, value)
  end
  return result
end

local function normalizeStringList(values)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}

  local function addValue(value)
    if value == nil then return end
    local normalized = tostring(value)
    if normalized == "" or seen[normalized] == true then return end
    seen[normalized] = true
    table.insert(result, normalized)
  end

  if type(values) == "string" then
    for value in string.gmatch(values, "[^,%s;]+") do
      addValue(value)
    end
    return result
  end
  if type(values) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(values) do
      if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" then
        addValue(value)
      elseif type(key) == "string" and value == true then
        addValue(key)
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function buildStringSet(values)
  local result = {}
  if type(values) ~= "table" then return result end
  for _, value in ipairs(values) do
    result[value] = true
  end
  return result
end

local function removeEntryFromArray(array, entry)
  if array == nil then return end
  for i = #array, 1, -1 do
    if array[i] == entry then
      table.remove(array, i)
    end
  end
end

local function getResourceIdBucket(resourceId)
  resourceIdIndex[resourceId] = resourceIdIndex[resourceId] or {}
  return resourceIdIndex[resourceId]
end

local function getResourceTagBucket(tag)
  resourceTagIndex[tag] = resourceTagIndex[tag] or {}
  return resourceTagIndex[tag]
end

local function getResourceObjectBucket(gameObject)
  resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] = resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] or {}
  return resourceObjectIndex[gameObject]
end

local function indexResourceEntry(entry)
  table.insert(getResourceIdBucket(entry.resourceId), entry)
  table.insert(getResourceObjectBucket(entry.gameObject), entry)
  for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags or {}) do
    table.insert(getResourceTagBucket(tag), entry)
  end
end

local function removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceIdIndex[entry.resourceId], entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceObjectIndex[entry.gameObject], entry)
  for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags or {}) do
    removeEntryFromArray(resourceTagIndex[tag], entry)
  end
end

local function cleanupBucket(bucket)
  if bucket == nil then return {} end
  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    local entry = bucket[i]
    if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
    end
  end
  return bucket
end

local function addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil or seen[entry] == true then return end
  seen[entry] = true
  table.insert(result, entry)
end

local function collectBucketEntries(bucket, result, seen)
  cleanupBucket(bucket)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket or {}) do
    addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  end
end

local function collectGameObjectEntries(gameObject, result, seen)
  if gameObject == nil then return end
  local resourceRoot = RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(gameObject)
  collectBucketEntries(resourceObjectIndex[resourceRoot], result, seen)
end

local function collectSelectorList(values, visitor)
  if values == nil then return end
  if type(values) == "table" then
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do visitor(value) end
  else
    visitor(values)
  end
end

local function collectTargetEntries(target)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}
  if target == nil then return result end

  if type(target) ~= "table" then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target, result, seen)
    return result
  end

  collectSelectorList(target.id or target.resourceId, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.ids or target.resourceIds, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tag, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tags, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)
  if target.gameObject ~= nil then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target.gameObject, result, seen)
  end
  table.sort(result, function(a, b)
    local an = a.gameObject ~= nil and tostring(a.gameObject.name) or ""
    local bn = b.gameObject ~= nil and tostring(b.gameObject.name) or ""
    if an ~= bn then return an < bn end
    local ap = a.gameObject.transform.position
    local bp = b.gameObject.transform.position
    if ap.x ~= bp.x then return ap.x < bp.x end
    if ap.z ~= bp.z then return ap.z < bp.z end
    return ap.y < bp.y
  end)
  return result
end

local function findResourceEntry(gameObject, resourceId)
  for _, entry in ipairs(resources) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and entry.gameObject == gameObject and entry.resourceId == resourceId then
      return entry
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function acceptsEvent(entry, eventName)
  return entry ~= nil and entry.eventSet ~= nil and entry.eventSet[eventName] == true
end

local function snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return nil end
  return {
    gameObject = entry.gameObject,
    resourceId = entry.resourceId,
    options = cloneShallowTable(entry.options),
    removed = entry.removed == true,
    tags = cloneArray(entry.tags),
    events = cloneArray(entry.events),
  }
end

local function clampInteger(value, minValue, maxValue)
  local numberValue = tonumber(value) or minValue
  numberValue = math.floor(numberValue)
  if numberValue < minValue then return minValue end
  if numberValue > maxValue then return maxValue end
  return numberValue
end

local function clampDuration(value)
  local duration = tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
  if duration ~= duration or duration <= 0 then
    return DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
  end
  if duration > 300 then return 300 end
  return duration
end

local function buildRoundPayload(extra)
  local payload = {
    roundId = gameState.roundId,
    roundActive = gameState.roundActive,
    score = gameState.score,
    displayScore = gameState.displayScore,
    maxScore = gameState.maxScore,
    duration = gameState.duration,
    timeLeft = gameState.timeLeft,
  }
  if type(extra) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(extra) do
      payload[key] = value
    end
  end
  return payload
end

local function clearActiveTarget()
  activeTargetEntry = nil
  activeTargetToken = nil
  activeTargetExpiresAt = 0
end

local function getSyncValue(wrapper, fallback)
  if not networkReady or wrapper == nil then return fallback end
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return wrapper:GetValue() end)
  if ok and value ~= nil then return value end
  return fallback
end

local function setSyncValue(wrapper, value)
  if not networkReady or wrapper == nil or not self:HasOwnership() then return end
  pcall(function() wrapper:SetValue(value) end)
end

local function getActiveTargetIndex()
  if activeTargetEntry == nil then return 0 end
  local targets = collectTargetEntries({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID })
  for index, entry in ipairs(targets) do
    if entry == activeTargetEntry then return index end
  end
  return 0
end

local function publishNetworkState()
  if not networkReady or not self:HasOwnership() then return end
  setSyncValue(netRoundActive, gameState.roundActive == true)
  setSyncValue(netRoundId, gameState.roundId)
  setSyncValue(netScore, gameState.score)
  setSyncValue(netMaxScore, gameState.maxScore)
  setSyncValue(netDuration, gameState.duration)
  setSyncValue(netTimeLeft, math.max(0, gameState.timeLeft))
  setSyncValue(netTargetIndex, getActiveTargetIndex())
  setSyncValue(netTargetSerial, targetSerial)
  setSyncValue(netHammerSwingSerial, hammerSwingSerial)
end

local function buildSyncedRoundPayload()
  return {
    roundActive = getSyncValue(netRoundActive, false) == true,
    roundId = getSyncValue(netRoundId, 0),
    score = getSyncValue(netScore, 0),
    displayScore = getSyncValue(netScore, 0),
    maxScore = getSyncValue(netMaxScore, DEFAULT_MAX_SCORE),
    duration = getSyncValue(netDuration, DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS),
    timeLeft = getSyncValue(netTimeLeft, 0),
    roundEndTime = Time.time + getSyncValue(netTimeLeft, 0),
  }
end

local function dispatchSpecificEntry(entry, eventName, payload)
  if entry == nil or entry.gameObject == nil then return 0 end
  return DispatchEvent({ gameObject = entry.gameObject }, eventName, payload or {}, {
    sourceResourceId = "runtime-host",
  })
end

local function deactivateActiveTarget(stomped)
  if activeTargetEntry ~= nil and activeTargetToken ~= nil then
    dispatchSpecificEntry(activeTargetEntry, EVENT_TARGET_DEACTIVATE, {
      roundId = gameState.roundId,
      targetToken = activeTargetToken,
      active = false,
      stomped = stomped == true,
    })
  end
  clearActiveTarget()
end

local function broadcastScoreChanged()
  DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED, buildRoundPayload(), { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED, buildRoundPayload(), { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
end

local function activateNextTarget(now)
  if gameState.roundActive ~= true then return end
  local targets = collectTargetEntries({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID })
  if #targets <= 0 then
    nextTargetAt = now + TARGET_RETRY_SECONDS
    return
  end

  deactivateActiveTarget(false)
  DispatchEvent({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_TARGET_RESET, {
    roundId = gameState.roundId,
    active = false,
  }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })

  local target = targets[math.random(1, #targets)]
  targetSerial = targetSerial + 1
  local token = tostring(gameState.roundId) .. ":" .. tostring(targetSerial)
  activeTargetEntry = target
  activeTargetToken = token
  activeTargetExpiresAt = now + TARGET_VISIBLE_SECONDS
  dispatchSpecificEntry(target, EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE, {
    roundId = gameState.roundId,
    targetToken = token,
    active = true,
  })
  publishNetworkState()
end

local function finishRound()
  if gameState.roundActive ~= true then return false end
  gameState.roundActive = false
  gameState.timeLeft = 0
  deactivateActiveTarget(false)
  DispatchEvent({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_TARGET_RESET, {
    roundId = gameState.roundId,
    active = false,
  }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })

  local payload = buildRoundPayload()
  DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_ENDED, payload, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_ENDED, payload, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SHOW_RESULT, payload, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  targetSerial = targetSerial + 1
  publishNetworkState()
  return true
end

local function resolvePayloadTargetRoot(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.targetGameObject == nil then
    return nil
  end
  local targetRoot = RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(payload.targetGameObject)
  if targetRoot == nil then
    targetRoot = payload.targetGameObject
  end
  return targetRoot
end

local function settleActiveTargetFromPayload(payload, sourceKind)
  if gameState.roundActive ~= true or activeTargetEntry == nil or activeTargetToken == nil then
    return false
  end
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  if payload.roundId ~= nil and payload.roundId ~= gameState.roundId then
    return false
  end

  local targetRoot = resolvePayloadTargetRoot(payload)
  if targetRoot ~= activeTargetEntry.gameObject then
    return false
  end
  if settledTokens[activeTargetToken] == true then
    return false
  end

  settledTokens[activeTargetToken] = true
  gameState.score = clampInteger(gameState.score + 1, 0, gameState.maxScore)
  gameState.displayScore = clampInteger(gameState.score, 0, gameState.maxScore)
  broadcastScoreChanged()
  deactivateActiveTarget(true)
  nextTargetAt = Time.time + NEXT_TARGET_DELAY_SECONDS
  targetSerial = targetSerial + 1
  publishNetworkState()
  hostLogger:info("target hit", "source=" .. tostring(sourceKind), "score=" .. tostring(gameState.score))
  return true
end

function IsReady()
  return hostReady
end

function EnsureScene()
  return true
end

function RegisterResource(gameObject, resourceId, config)
  if gameObject == nil or resourceId == nil then return nil end
  local normalizedResourceId = tostring(resourceId)
  if normalizedResourceId == "" then return nil end
  config = config or {}

  local entry = findResourceEntry(gameObject, normalizedResourceId)
  if entry ~= nil then
    removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  else
    entry = { gameObject = gameObject, resourceId = normalizedResourceId }
    table.insert(resources, entry)
  end

  entry.tags = normalizeStringList(config.tags)
  entry.events = normalizeStringList(config.events)
  entry.eventSet = buildStringSet(entry.events)
  entry.handler = config.handler
  entry.options = config.options or entry.options or {}
  entry.removed = false
  indexResourceEntry(entry)
  return entry
end

function UnregisterResource(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true then return end
  if activeTargetEntry == entry then clearActiveTarget() end
  removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resources, entry)
  entry.removed = true
end

function GetResources(target)
  local snapshot = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    local item = snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
    if item ~= nil then table.insert(snapshot, item) end
  end
  return snapshot
end

function DispatchEvent(target, eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == nil then return 0 end
  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and type(entry.handler) == "function" and acceptsEvent(entry, eventName) then
      local ok, result = pcall(entry.handler, eventName, payload or {}, context or {})
      if ok and result ~= false then
        count = count + 1
      elseif not ok then
        hostLogger:warn("event dispatch failed", "event=" .. tostring(eventName), "error=" .. tostring(result))
      end
    end
  end
  return count
end

function Register(component, group, gameObject, initialState, options)
  if component == nil or group == nil or gameObject == nil then return nil end
  registry[component] = registry[component] or {}
  registry[component][group] = registry[component][group] or {}
  local entry = { component = component, group = group, gameObject = gameObject, state = initialState or {}, options = options or {} }
  table.insert(registry[component][group], entry)
  statsVersion = statsVersion + 1
  return entry
end

function UpdateRegistry(entry, patch)
  if entry == nil or entry.state == nil then return end
  if type(patch) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(patch) do entry.state[key] = value end
  end
  statsVersion = statsVersion + 1
end

function Unregister(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  local bucket = registry[entry.component] ~= nil and registry[entry.component][entry.group] or nil
  removeEntryFromArray(bucket, entry)
  statsVersion = statsVersion + 1
end

function GetStats(component, group)
  local bucket = registry[component] ~= nil and registry[component][group] or {}
  local total = 0
  local active = 0
  local collected = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket or {}) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil then
      total = total + 1
      if entry.state == nil or entry.state.active ~= false then active = active + 1 end
      if entry.state ~= nil and entry.state.collected == true then collected = collected + 1 end
    end
  end
  return { total = total, active = active, collected = collected, allCollected = total > 0 and collected >= total, version = statsVersion }
end

function GetGameState()
  if networkReady and not self:HasOwnership() then
    return buildSyncedRoundPayload()
  end
  return buildRoundPayload()
end

function NetworkStartRound(durationValue, maxScoreValue)
  if not networkReady or not self:HasOwnership() then return false end
  if gameState.roundActive == true then return false end
  local duration = clampDuration(durationValue or DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS)
  local maxScore = clampInteger(maxScoreValue or DEFAULT_MAX_SCORE, 1, 99)
  local now = Time.time

  gameState.roundId = gameState.roundId + 1
  gameState.roundActive = true
  gameState.score = 0
  gameState.displayScore = 0
  gameState.maxScore = maxScore
  gameState.duration = duration
  gameState.timeLeft = duration
  gameState.roundEndTime = now + duration
  settledTokens = {}
  clearActiveTarget()
  nextTargetAt = now + NEXT_TARGET_DELAY_SECONDS
  targetSerial = 0

  DispatchEvent({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_TARGET_RESET, { roundId = gameState.roundId, active = false }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_STARTED, buildRoundPayload(), { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_STARTED, buildRoundPayload(), { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
  broadcastScoreChanged()
  publishNetworkState()
  return true
end

function StartRound(payload)
  local duration = type(payload) == "table" and payload.duration or DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
  local maxScore = type(payload) == "table" and payload.maxScore or DEFAULT_MAX_SCORE
  if not networkReady then return false end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    return NetworkStartRound(duration, maxScore)
  end
  self:OwnerCall("NetworkStartRound", function() end, duration, maxScore)
  return true
end

function NetworkReportHit(roundId, targetToken, sourceKind)
  if not networkReady or not self:HasOwnership() then return false end
  if gameState.roundActive ~= true or activeTargetEntry == nil then return false end
  if roundId ~= gameState.roundId or targetToken ~= activeTargetToken then return false end
  return settleActiveTargetFromPayload({
    roundId = roundId,
    targetToken = targetToken,
    targetGameObject = activeTargetEntry.gameObject,
  }, sourceKind or "remote")
end

function ReportStompHit(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or not networkReady then return false end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    return NetworkReportHit(payload.roundId, payload.targetToken, "stomp")
  end
  self:OwnerCall("NetworkReportHit", function() end, payload.roundId or 0, payload.targetToken or "", "stomp")
  return true
end

function ReportHammerHit(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or not networkReady then return false end
  local roundId = payload.roundId
  if roundId == nil then
    roundId = self:HasOwnership() and gameState.roundId or getSyncValue(netRoundId, 0)
  end
  local targetToken = payload.targetToken or activeTargetToken or ""
  if activeTargetEntry == nil or payload.targetGameObject ~= activeTargetEntry.gameObject then return false end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    return NetworkReportHit(roundId, targetToken, "hammer")
  end
  self:OwnerCall("NetworkReportHit", function() end, roundId, targetToken, "hammer")
  return true
end

function NetworkPublishHammerSwing()
  if not networkReady or not self:HasOwnership() then return false end
  hammerSwingSerial = hammerSwingSerial + 1
  setSyncValue(netHammerSwingSerial, hammerSwingSerial)
  self:SendMessageToOther("OnHammerSwingBroadcast", hammerSwingSerial)
  -- 主权端也必须播放远端持锤者动作；本地持锤者会在锤子脚本中忽略重复事件。
  DispatchEvent({ id = HAMMER_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_HAMMER_SWING, {
    serial = hammerSwingSerial,
  }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-hammer-sync" })
  return true
end

function OnHammerSwingBroadcast(serial)
  if not networkReady then return end
  local value = tonumber(serial) or 0
  if value <= appliedHammerSwingSerial then return end
  appliedHammerSwingSerial = value
  DispatchEvent({ id = HAMMER_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_HAMMER_SWING, {
    serial = value,
  }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-hammer-rpc" })
end

function RequestHammerSwing()
  if not networkReady then return false end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    return NetworkPublishHammerSwing()
  end
  self:OwnerCall("NetworkPublishHammerSwing", function() end)
  return true
end

local function applySyncedStateLocally()
  if not networkReady or self:HasOwnership() then return end
  local state = buildSyncedRoundPayload()
  local targetSerialValue = getSyncValue(netTargetSerial, 0)
  local targetIndexValue = getSyncValue(netTargetIndex, 0)
  local hammerSwingSerialValue = getSyncValue(netHammerSwingSerial, 0)

  if state.roundId ~= appliedRoundId or state.roundActive ~= appliedRoundActive then
    appliedRoundId = state.roundId
    appliedRoundActive = state.roundActive
    if state.roundActive then
      DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_STARTED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
      DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_STARTED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
    else
      DispatchEvent({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_TARGET_RESET, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
      DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_ENDED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
      DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_ROUND_ENDED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
      if state.roundId > 0 then
        DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SHOW_RESULT, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
      end
    end
  end

  if state.score ~= appliedScore then
    appliedScore = state.score
    DispatchEvent({ id = ARENA_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
    DispatchEvent({ id = RESULT_UI_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
  end

  if targetSerialValue ~= appliedTargetSerial then
    appliedTargetSerial = targetSerialValue
    DispatchEvent({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_TARGET_RESET, state, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-sync" })
    activeTargetEntry = nil
    activeTargetToken = nil
    if state.roundActive and targetIndexValue > 0 then
      local targets = collectTargetEntries({ id = TARGET_RESOURCE_ID })
      local target = targets[targetIndexValue]
      if target ~= nil then
        activeTargetEntry = target
        activeTargetToken = tostring(state.roundId) .. ":" .. tostring(targetSerialValue)
        dispatchSpecificEntry(target, EVENT_TARGET_ACTIVATE, {
          roundId = state.roundId,
          targetToken = activeTargetToken,
          active = true,
        })
      end
    end
  end

  if hammerSwingSerialValue ~= appliedHammerSwingSerial then
    local shouldPlay = appliedHammerSwingSerial >= 0 and hammerSwingSerialValue > appliedHammerSwingSerial
    appliedHammerSwingSerial = hammerSwingSerialValue
    if shouldPlay then
      DispatchEvent({ id = HAMMER_RESOURCE_ID }, EVENT_HAMMER_SWING, {
        serial = hammerSwingSerialValue,
      }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host-hammer-sync" })
    end
  end
end

function Start()
  math.randomseed(math.floor(Time.time * 1000) + os.time())
  hostReady = true
  hostLogger:info("capybara whack host ready", "hammer=" .. HAMMER_RESOURCE_ID)
end

function OnNetworkSettled()
  networkReady = true
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    publishNetworkState()
  end
end

function Update()
  if not networkReady then return end
  if not self:HasOwnership() then
    applySyncedStateLocally()
    return
  end
  if gameState.roundActive ~= true then return end

  local now = Time.time
  gameState.timeLeft = gameState.roundEndTime - now
  if gameState.timeLeft <= 0 then
    finishRound()
    return
  end

  if activeTargetEntry ~= nil and now >= activeTargetExpiresAt then
    deactivateActiveTarget(false)
    targetSerial = targetSerial + 1
    nextTargetAt = now + NEXT_TARGET_DELAY_SECONDS
    publishNetworkState()
  end
  if activeTargetEntry == nil and now >= nextTargetAt then
    activateNextTarget(now)
  end
  if now >= nextStatePublishAt then
    nextStatePublishAt = now + STATE_SYNC_INTERVAL
    publishNetworkState()
  end
end

function OnDestroy()
  gameState.roundActive = false
  clearActiveTarget()
  resources = {}
  resourceIdIndex = {}
  resourceTagIndex = {}
  resourceObjectIndex = {}
  registry = {}
end

1fea5d7c-1e06-46a0-b064-53b28eb44e3f.content:
---@id 1fea5d7c-1e06-46a0-b064-53b28eb44e3f
---@referenceName ui.lua
-- 卡皮巴拉打地鼠运行时 HUD 与结算面板，开始后显示分数和闹钟式倒计时。
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local ButtonType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Button)
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local logger = Logger.create("ui-capybara-result")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

local RESOURCE_ID = "ui-resource-821bb3c0-17bbf11e-2"
local RESOURCE_TAG = "resultUi"
local EVENT_ROUND_STARTED = "CapybaraGame.roundStarted"
local EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED = "CapybaraGame.scoreChanged"
local EVENT_ROUND_ENDED = "CapybaraGame.roundEnded"
local EVENT_SHOW_RESULT = "CapybaraGame.showResult"
local HOST_SCRIPT_ID = "runtime-host.lua"
local MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS = 20
local RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 0.25
local DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS = 30

local hudRoot = nil
local hudScoreTextGo = nil
local alarmTimeTextGo = nil
local resultPanelRoot = nil
local finalScoreTextGo = nil
local closeButton = nil
local closeButtonHandler = nil
local buttonListenerAdded = false
local resourceEntry = nil
local registerAttempts = 0
local nextRegisterTime = 0
local destroyed = false
local hudActive = false
local currentScore = 0
local currentDuration = DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
local currentTimeLeft = DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS

local function setGameObjectActive(go, active)
  if go ~= nil then
    go:SetActive(active == true)
  end
end

local function clampScore(value)
  local score = tonumber(value) or 0
  score = math.floor(score)
  if score < 0 then return 0 end
  if score > 99 then return 99 end
  return score
end

local function formatScore(value)
  local score = clampScore(value)
  if score < 10 then
    return "0" .. tostring(score)
  end
  return tostring(score)
end

local function formatTime(value)
  local seconds = tonumber(value) or 0
  seconds = math.ceil(seconds)
  if seconds < 0 then seconds = 0 end
  if seconds > 99 then seconds = 99 end
  return tostring(seconds) .. "秒"
end

local function setText(go, value)
  if go == nil then
    return false
  end

  local textComponent = nil
  if CS.TMPro ~= nil and CS.TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI ~= nil then
    local ok, component = pcall(function()
      return go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI))
    end)
    if ok then
      textComponent = component
    end
  end

  if textComponent == nil and CS.UnityEngine ~= nil and CS.UnityEngine.UI ~= nil and CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text ~= nil then
    local ok, component = pcall(function()
      return go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text))
    end)
    if ok then
      textComponent = component
    end
  end

  if textComponent == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("text-component-missing", "text component not found")
    return false
  end

  textComponent.text = tostring(value)
  return true
end

local function setPanelOpen(open)
  setGameObjectActive(resultPanelRoot, open == true)
end

local function setHudOpen(open)
  hudActive = open == true
  setGameObjectActive(hudRoot, hudActive)
end

local function applyHudValues(score, timeLeft, duration)
  currentScore = clampScore(score)
  currentDuration = tonumber(duration) or DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
  if currentDuration <= 0 then
    currentDuration = DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
  end
  currentTimeLeft = tonumber(timeLeft) or currentDuration
  if currentTimeLeft < 0 then currentTimeLeft = 0 end
  if currentTimeLeft > currentDuration then currentTimeLeft = currentDuration end

  setText(hudScoreTextGo, formatScore(currentScore))
  setText(alarmTimeTextGo, formatTime(currentTimeLeft))
end

local function payloadNumber(payload, key, fallback)
  if type(payload) == "table" and payload[key] ~= nil then
    return payload[key]
  end
  return fallback
end

local function updateHudFromPayload(payload, forceOpen)
  payload = payload or {}
  if forceOpen then
    setPanelOpen(false)
    setHudOpen(true)
  end
  applyHudValues(
    payloadNumber(payload, "score", currentScore),
    payloadNumber(payload, "timeLeft", currentTimeLeft),
    payloadNumber(payload, "duration", currentDuration)
  )
end

local function showResult(payload)
  payload = payload or {}
  local score = clampScore(payload.score)
  setHudOpen(false)
  setText(finalScoreTextGo, formatScore(score))
  setPanelOpen(true)
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then
    payload = {}
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_ROUND_STARTED then
    currentScore = 0
    currentDuration = tonumber(payload.duration) or DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS
    currentTimeLeft = tonumber(payload.timeLeft) or currentDuration
    updateHudFromPayload(payload, true)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED then
    updateHudFromPayload(payload, true)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_ROUND_ENDED then
    updateHudFromPayload(payload, false)
    setHudOpen(false)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == EVENT_SHOW_RESULT then
    showResult(payload)
    return true
  end

  return false
end

local function getRuntimeHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    return nil, runtimeScopeReason
  end

  local host, reason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT_ID)
  if host == nil then
    return nil, reason
  end
  if type(host.IsReady) == "function" and host.IsReady() ~= true then
    return nil, "runtime-not-ready"
  end
  return host, nil
end

local function tryRegisterResource()
  if destroyed or resourceEntry ~= nil then
    return true
  end
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "result UI cannot register", runtimeScopeReason)
    return true
  end
  if registerAttempts >= MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
    return false
  end

  registerAttempts = registerAttempts + 1
  local host, reason = getRuntimeHost()
  if host == nil then
    if registerAttempts == MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
      logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "result UI registration failed", reason)
    end
    return false
  end
  if type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-missing", "Runtime Host RegisterResource is missing")
    return false
  end

  local ok, entryOrReason = pcall(function()
    return host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
      tags = { RESOURCE_TAG },
      events = { EVENT_ROUND_STARTED, EVENT_SCORE_CHANGED, EVENT_ROUND_ENDED, EVENT_SHOW_RESULT },
      handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
      options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID, tag = RESOURCE_TAG },
    })
  end)

  if ok and entryOrReason ~= nil then
    resourceEntry = entryOrReason
    return true
  end

  if registerAttempts == MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-failed", "result UI registration returned no entry", entryOrReason)
  end
  return false
end

local function bindCloseButton()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    return
  end

  local closeButtonGo, reason = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("resultPanelRoot/closeButton")
  if closeButtonGo == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("close-button-missing", "close button not found", reason)
    return
  end

  closeButton = closeButtonGo:GetComponent(ButtonType)
  if closeButton == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("close-button-component-missing", "closeButton has no Button component")
    return
  end

  closeButtonHandler = function()
    setPanelOpen(false)
  end
  closeButton.onClick:AddListener(closeButtonHandler)
  buttonListenerAdded = true
end

local function clearButtonListener()
  if buttonListenerAdded and closeButton ~= nil and closeButtonHandler ~= nil then
    closeButton.onClick:RemoveListener(closeButtonHandler)
  end
  buttonListenerAdded = false
  closeButton = nil
  closeButtonHandler = nil
end

local function unregisterResource()
  if resourceEntry == nil or runtimeScope == nil then
    resourceEntry = nil
    return
  end

  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT_ID)
  if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    pcall(function()
      host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
    end)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
end

local function pollHostState()
  if runtimeScope == nil then return end
  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT_ID)
  if host == nil or type(host.GetGameState) ~= "function" then
    return
  end

  local ok, state = pcall(host.GetGameState)
  if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" then
    return
  end

  if state.roundActive == true then
    updateHudFromPayload(state, true)
  elseif hudActive then
    setHudOpen(false)
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "result UI disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
    return
  end

  hudRoot = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("hudRoot")
  hudScoreTextGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("hudRoot/hudScoreText")
  alarmTimeTextGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("hudRoot/alarmClockRoot/alarmTimeText")
  resultPanelRoot = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("resultPanelRoot")
  finalScoreTextGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("resultPanelRoot/finalScoreText")

  if hudRoot == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("hud-root-missing", "hudRoot not found")
  end
  if resultPanelRoot == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("result-panel-missing", "resultPanelRoot not found")
    return
  end

  setHudOpen(false)
  setPanelOpen(false)
  setText(hudScoreTextGo, formatScore(0))
  setText(alarmTimeTextGo, formatTime(DEFAULT_DURATION_SECONDS))
  setText(finalScoreTextGo, formatScore(0))
  bindCloseButton()
  tryRegisterResource()
  nextRegisterTime = Time.time + RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS
end

function Update()
  pollHostState()

  if destroyed or resourceEntry ~= nil or registerAttempts >= MAX_REGISTER_ATTEMPTS then
    return
  end
  if Time.time < nextRegisterTime then
    return
  end

  tryRegisterResource()
  nextRegisterTime = Time.time + RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS
end

function OnDestroy()
  destroyed = true
  clearButtonListener()
  unregisterResource()
end

---@desc 咬食音效音量

---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local DouyinUtility = CS.DouyinUtility
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local RESOURCE_ID = "module-multistage-cake"
local logger = Logger.create("pi-cake")
local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

local MAX_VISUAL_BITE_STEPS = 24
local visualStagePaths = { "ModuleRoot/StageFull" }
for biteIndex = 1, MAX_VISUAL_BITE_STEPS - 1 do
  table.insert(visualStagePaths, "ModuleRoot/StageBite" .. string.format("%02d", biteIndex))
end
table.insert(visualStagePaths, "ModuleRoot/StageCrumbs")

local visualStageObjects = {}
local candleFlameObjects = {}
local blessingDisplayRoot = nil
local blessingTextMesh = nil
local activeStageTransform = nil
local primaryButton = nil
local blessingButton = nil
local resetButton = nil
local localActor = nil
local currentInside = false
local netReady = false
local resourceEntry = nil
local registeredWithHost = false
local registerRetryTimer = 0
local registerRetryCount = 0
local maxRegisterRetries = 30
local ownershipPending = false
local lastAppliedCount = -1
local firstNetValueChange = true
local feedbackTimer = 0
local feedbackDuration = 0.18
local audioSource = nil
local biteClip = nil
local biteClipReady = false
local lastDisplayedBlessing = ""

local function clampInt(value, minValue, maxValue)
  local n = tonumber(value) or minValue
  n = math.floor(n)
  if n < minValue then return minValue end
  if n > maxValue then return maxValue end
  return n
end

local function clamp01(value, fallback)
  local n = tonumber(value)
  if n == nil then
    n = fallback or 1
  end
  if n < 0 then return 0 end
  if n > 1 then return 1 end
  return n
end

local function getBlessingColor()
  return UnityEngine.Color(
    clamp01(BlessingColorR, 1),
    clamp01(BlessingColorG, 0.88),
    clamp01(BlessingColorB, 0.38),
    clamp01(BlessingColorA, 1)
  )
end

local function normalizeSingleBlessing(value)
  local text = tostring(value or "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "^%s+", "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "%s+$", "")
  if text == "" then
    text = tostring(DefaultBlessingText or "生日快乐，愿心愿成真！")
  end
  local limit = clampInt(BlessingMaxChars, 1, 80)
  if string.len(text) > limit then
    text = string.sub(text, 1, limit)
  end
  return text
end

local function splitBlessingEntries(raw)
  local entries = {}
  local text = tostring(raw or "")
  for line in string.gmatch(text, "[^\n]+") do
    local normalized = normalizeSingleBlessing(line)
    if normalized ~= "" then
      table.insert(entries, normalized)
    end
  end
  return entries
end

local function encodeBlessingEntries(entries)
  if type(entries) ~= "table" or #entries == 0 then
    return ""
  end
  return table.concat(entries, "\n")
end

local function getBlessingEntries()
  if not netReady then return {} end
  return splitBlessingEntries(blessingText:GetValue())
end

local function getBlessingTextValue()
  local entries = getBlessingEntries()
  if #entries == 0 then
    return ""
  end
  return table.concat(entries, "\n")
end

local function appendBlessingEntry(text)
  local entries = getBlessingEntries()
  table.insert(entries, normalizeSingleBlessing(text))
  local maxEntries = clampInt(BlessingMaxEntries, 1, 20)
  while #entries > maxEntries do
    table.remove(entries, 1)
  end
  blessingText:SetValue(encodeBlessingEntries(entries))
end

local function getAutoBiteCount()
  return MAX_VISUAL_BITE_STEPS
end

local function getTotalBites()
  if AutoAdjustTotalBites ~= false then
    return clampInt(getAutoBiteCount(), 1, 24)
  end
  return clampInt(TotalBites, 1, 24)
end

local function getCleanedStep()
  return getTotalBites() + 1
end

local function getSafeProgressCount()
  if not netReady then
    return 0
  end
  return clampInt(eatenCount:GetValue(), 0, getCleanedStep())
end

local function hasBlownCandles()
  if not netReady then
    return false
  end
  return candlesBlown:GetValue() == true
end

local function isCleaned(count)
  return count >= getCleanedStep()
end

local function getStageIndex(count)
  if isCleaned(count) then
    return nil
  end

  local stageCount = #visualStagePaths
  if stageCount <= 1 or count <= 0 then
    return 1
  end

  local total = getTotalBites()
  if count >= total then
    return stageCount
  end

  local ratio = count / total
  local index = 1 + math.ceil(ratio * (stageCount - 1))
  if index < 1 then
    return 1
  end
  if index > stageCount then
    return stageCount
  end
  return index
end

local function setButtonText(buttonRef, text)
  if buttonRef == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = buttonRef:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function updateButtonText()
  local progress = getSafeProgressCount()
  if isCleaned(progress) then
    setButtonText(primaryButton, emptyButtonText)
  else
    local remainingBites = getTotalBites() - progress
    if remainingBites <= 0 then
      setButtonText(primaryButton, cleanButtonText)
    else
      setButtonText(primaryButton, interactionButtonText .. " x" .. tostring(remainingBites))
    end
  end

  if getSafeProgressCount() > 0 then
    setButtonText(blessingButton, "不可写祝福")
  elseif hasBlownCandles() then
    setButtonText(blessingButton, wishButtonText)
  else
    setButtonText(blessingButton, wishButtonText .. " / 吹蜡烛")
  end
  setButtonText(resetButton, resetButtonText)
end

local function buildBiteClip()
  if not BiteSoundEnabled or biteClipReady then
    return
  end

  pcall(function()
    audioSource = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.AudioSource))
    if audioSource == nil then
      audioSource = self.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.AudioSource))
    end
    audioSource.playOnAwake = false
    audioSource.spatialBlend = 1
    audioSource.volume = BiteSoundVolume

    local sampleRate = 22050
    local sampleCount = 2205
    biteClip = UnityEngine.AudioClip.Create("cake_bite_pop", sampleCount, 1, sampleRate, false)
    local samples = CS.System.Array.CreateInstance(typeof(CS.System.Single), sampleCount)
    for i = 0, sampleCount - 1 do
      local t = i / sampleRate
      local envelope = math.max(0, 1 - (i / sampleCount))
      local pop = math.sin(6.28318 * 520 * t) * 0.22 * envelope
      local crunch = math.sin(6.28318 * (1200 + 900 * envelope) * t) * 0.13 * envelope * envelope
      samples:SetValue(pop + crunch, i)
    end
    biteClip:SetData(samples, 0)
    biteClipReady = true
  end)
end

local function playBiteSound()
  if not BiteSoundEnabled then
    return
  end
  if not biteClipReady then
    buildBiteClip()
  end
  if audioSource == nil or biteClip == nil then
    return
  end
  pcall(function()
    audioSource.volume = BiteSoundVolume
    audioSource:PlayOneShot(biteClip, BiteSoundVolume)
  end)
end

local function startEatFeedback()
  feedbackTimer = feedbackDuration
  playBiteSound()
end

local function showToast(message)
  if message == nil or message == "" then return end
  DouyinUtility.Toast(tostring(message))
end

local function buildBlessingDisplay()
  if blessingDisplayRoot ~= nil then
    return true
  end

  local parentTransform = nil
  if resourceRoot ~= nil and resourceRoot.transform ~= nil then
    parentTransform = resourceRoot.transform
  elseif self ~= nil and self.transform ~= nil then
    parentTransform = self.transform
  end
  if parentTransform == nil then
    return false
  end

  blessingDisplayRoot = UnityEngine.GameObject("BlessingDisplay")
  blessingDisplayRoot.transform:SetParent(parentTransform, false)
  blessingDisplayRoot.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, BlessingDisplayHeight, 0)
  blessingDisplayRoot.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(1, 1, 1)

  blessingTextMesh = blessingDisplayRoot:AddComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.TextMesh))
  blessingTextMesh.anchor = UnityEngine.TextAnchor.MiddleCenter
  blessingTextMesh.alignment = UnityEngine.TextAlignment.Center
  blessingTextMesh.fontSize = 72
  blessingTextMesh.characterSize = 0.018
  blessingTextMesh.lineSpacing = 0.9
  blessingTextMesh.color = getBlessingColor()
  blessingTextMesh.text = ""

  local renderer = blessingDisplayRoot:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
  if renderer ~= nil then
    renderer.shadowCastingMode = CS.UnityEngine.Rendering.ShadowCastingMode.Off
    renderer.receiveShadows = false
  end

  blessingDisplayRoot:SetActive(false)
  return true
end

local function updateBlessingBillboard()
  if blessingDisplayRoot == nil then return end
  local cam = UnityEngine.Camera.main
  if cam ~= nil and cam.transform ~= nil then
    blessingDisplayRoot.transform.rotation = cam.transform.rotation
  end
  blessingDisplayRoot.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, BlessingDisplayHeight, 0)
  if blessingTextMesh ~= nil then
    blessingTextMesh.color = getBlessingColor()
  end
end

local function applyBlessingDisplay()
  local text = getBlessingTextValue()
  local shouldShow = text ~= ""

  if not shouldShow then
    if blessingDisplayRoot ~= nil then
      blessingDisplayRoot:SetActive(false)
    end
    lastDisplayedBlessing = ""
    return
  end

  if not buildBlessingDisplay() then
    logger:warnOnce("blessing-display-unavailable", "无法创建祝福语展示文本")
    return
  end

  if text ~= lastDisplayedBlessing and blessingTextMesh ~= nil then
    blessingTextMesh.text = "祝福墙：\n" .. text
    lastDisplayedBlessing = text
  end
  blessingDisplayRoot:SetActive(true)
  updateBlessingBillboard()
end

local function resetStageScale()
  if activeStageTransform ~= nil then
    activeStageTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(1, 1, 1)
  end
end

local function applyVisualStage(count, shouldPlayFeedback)
  local stageIndex = getStageIndex(count)
  activeStageTransform = nil

  for i = 1, #visualStageObjects do
    local go = visualStageObjects[i]
    if go ~= nil then
      local active = stageIndex ~= nil and i == stageIndex
      go:SetActive(active)
      if active then
        activeStageTransform = go.transform
      end
    end
  end

  resetStageScale()
  if shouldPlayFeedback then
    startEatFeedback()
  end

  updateButtonText()
  if currentInside then
    self:EnableInteraction()
  end
end

local function applyCandleFlames()
  local visible = not hasBlownCandles()
  for i = 1, #candleFlameObjects do
    local go = candleFlameObjects[i]
    if go ~= nil then
      go:SetActive(visible)
    end
  end
  updateButtonText()
  applyBlessingDisplay()
end

local function findVisualStages()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    return
  end

  for i = 1, #visualStagePaths do
    local go = runtimeScope:FindGameObject(visualStagePaths[i])
    visualStageObjects[i] = go
  end

  for stageIndex = 1, #visualStagePaths - 1 do
    local stagePath = visualStagePaths[stageIndex]
    for candleIndex = 1, 5 do
      local path = stagePath .. "/CakeBody/Candle_" .. tostring(candleIndex) .. "/WarmFlame"
      local flame = runtimeScope:FindGameObject(path)
      if flame ~= nil then
        table.insert(candleFlameObjects, flame)
      end
    end
  end
end

local handleWorldplayEvent

local function getRuntimeHost(methodName)
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable", "Runtime scope unavailable")
    return nil
  end

  local host, reason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "Runtime Host unavailable", reason)
    return nil
  end
  if methodName ~= nil and type(host[methodName]) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-method-missing", "Runtime Host method missing", methodName)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function tryRegisterWithHost()
  if registeredWithHost then return true end
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return false end
  if type(handleWorldplayEvent) ~= "function" then return false end

  local host = getRuntimeHost("RegisterResource")
  if host == nil then return false end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    events = { "CakeBlessing.submitted", "CakeBlessing.cancelled" },
    handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
  registeredWithHost = resourceEntry ~= nil
  return registeredWithHost
end

local function requestBlessingInput()
  if not netReady then
    showToast(BlessingUnavailableToast)
    return false
  end

  if getSafeProgressCount() > 0 then
    showToast(BlessingLockedToast)
    return false
  end

  tryRegisterWithHost()
  local host = getRuntimeHost("OpenCakeBlessing")
  if host == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
    showToast(BlessingUnavailableToast)
    return false
  end

  local opened = host.OpenCakeBlessing({
    sourceGameObject = resourceRoot,
    sourceResourceId = RESOURCE_ID,
    title = BlessingPanelTitle,
    placeholder = BlessingPlaceholder,
    defaultText = DefaultBlessingText,
    maxChars = BlessingMaxChars,
  })
  if opened == true then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    return true
  end

  showToast(BlessingUnavailableToast)
  return false
end

local function markBlessingSubmitted(text)
  if not netReady then
    return
  end

  if getSafeProgressCount() > 0 then
    showToast(BlessingLockedToast)
    return
  end

  local firstBlessing = not hasBlownCandles()
  appendBlessingEntry(text)
  if firstBlessing then
    candlesBlown:SetValue(true)
    showToast(BlowCandlesToast)
  else
    showToast(BlessingAddedToast)
  end
end

local function resetCakeState()
  if not netReady then
    return
  end
  eatenCount:SetValue(0)
  candlesBlown:SetValue(false)
  blessingText:SetValue("")
  showToast(ResetToast)
end

local function tryAdvanceOneStep()
  if not netReady then
    return
  end

  if not hasBlownCandles() then
    showToast("先写一句祝福，再开始庆祝吧")
    return
  end

  local cleanedStep = getCleanedStep()
  local current = clampInt(eatenCount:GetValue(), 0, cleanedStep)
  if current >= cleanedStep then
    updateButtonText()
    return
  end

  eatenCount:SetValue(current + 1)
  -- 清理盘子(进入 cleaned 状态)后，祝福列表应清空消失
  if current + 1 >= cleanedStep then
    blessingText:SetValue("")
  end
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

handleWorldplayEvent = function(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == "CakeBlessing.submitted" and type(payload) == "table" then
    ensureOwnership(function()
      markBlessingSubmitted(payload.blessingText)
    end)
    return true
  end

  if eventName == "CakeBlessing.cancelled" then
    if currentInside then
      self:EnableInteraction()
      updateButtonText()
    end
    return true
  end

  return false
end

function Start()
  findVisualStages()
  buildBiteClip()
  applyVisualStage(0, false)
  applyCandleFlames()
  tryRegisterWithHost()
end

function OnNetSpawned()
  netReady = true
  candlesBlown:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    applyCandleFlames()
    if currentInside then
      self:EnableInteraction()
    end
  end)
  blessingText:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    applyBlessingDisplay()
    updateButtonText()
  end)
  eatenCount:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    local cleanedStep = getCleanedStep()
    local current = clampInt(curVal, 0, cleanedStep)
    local previous = clampInt(preVal, 0, cleanedStep)
    local playFeedback = (not firstNetValueChange) and lastAppliedCount >= 0 and current > previous and current <= getTotalBites()
    firstNetValueChange = false
    lastAppliedCount = current
    applyVisualStage(current, playFeedback)
  end)

  local current = getSafeProgressCount()
  lastAppliedCount = current
  applyVisualStage(current, false)
  applyCandleFlames()
  applyBlessingDisplay()
end

function Update()
  if not registeredWithHost and registerRetryCount < maxRegisterRetries then
    registerRetryTimer = registerRetryTimer + Time.deltaTime
    if registerRetryTimer >= 0.5 then
      registerRetryTimer = 0
      registerRetryCount = registerRetryCount + 1
      tryRegisterWithHost()
    end
  end

  updateBlessingBillboard()

  if feedbackTimer <= 0 then
    return
  end

  feedbackTimer = math.max(0, feedbackTimer - Time.deltaTime)
  if activeStageTransform == nil then
    return
  end

  local t = feedbackTimer / feedbackDuration
  local scale = 1 + math.sin(t * 3.14159) * 0.06
  activeStageTransform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(scale, 1 + (scale - 1) * 0.35, scale)
  if feedbackTimer <= 0 then
    resetStageScale()
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  currentInside = true
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  currentInside = false
  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  primaryButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  blessingButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  resetButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  updateButtonText()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if index == 1 then
      tryAdvanceOneStep()
    elseif index == 2 then
      requestBlessingInput()
    elseif index == 3 then
      resetCakeState()
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if primaryButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(primaryButton)
  end
  if blessingButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(blessingButton)
  end
  if resetButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(resetButton)
  end
  primaryButton = nil
  blessingButton = nil
  resetButton = nil
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  updateButtonText()
end

function OnDestroy()
  local host = getRuntimeHost("UnregisterResource")
  if host ~= nil and resourceEntry ~= nil then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  if blessingDisplayRoot ~= nil then
    UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(blessingDisplayRoot)
  end
  blessingDisplayRoot = nil
  blessingTextMesh = nil
  resourceEntry = nil
  registeredWithHost = false
end

---@referenceName runtime-host.lua
-- 蛋糕祝福语输入流程的 Runtime Host：登记资源并转发输入面板事件。
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local hostLogger = Logger.create("cake-host")

local hostReady = false
local resources = {}
local resourceIdIndex = {}
local resourceObjectIndex = {}
local pendingCakeBlessing = nil
local nextRequestId = 0

local function removeEntryFromArray(array, entry)
  if array == nil then return end
  for i = #array, 1, -1 do
    if array[i] == entry then
      table.remove(array, i)
    end
  end
end

local function getResourceIdBucket(resourceId)
  resourceIdIndex[resourceId] = resourceIdIndex[resourceId] or {}
  return resourceIdIndex[resourceId]
end

local function getResourceObjectBucket(gameObject)
  resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] = resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] or {}
  return resourceObjectIndex[gameObject]
end

local function normalizeStringList(values)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}

  local function addValue(value)
    if value == nil then return end
    local normalized = tostring(value)
    if normalized == "" or seen[normalized] == true then return end
    seen[normalized] = true
    table.insert(result, normalized)
  end

  if type(values) == "string" then
    for value in string.gmatch(values, "[^,%s;]+") do
      addValue(value)
    end
  elseif type(values) == "table" then
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
      addValue(value)
    end
  end

  return result
end

local function buildStringSet(values)
  local result = {}
  if type(values) ~= "table" then return result end
  for _, value in ipairs(values) do
    result[value] = true
  end
  return result
end

local function findResourceEntry(gameObject, resourceId)
  for _, entry in ipairs(resources) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and entry.gameObject == gameObject and entry.resourceId == resourceId then
      return entry
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function indexResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  table.insert(getResourceIdBucket(entry.resourceId), entry)
  table.insert(getResourceObjectBucket(entry.gameObject), entry)
end

local function removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceIdIndex[entry.resourceId], entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceObjectIndex[entry.gameObject], entry)
end

local function cleanupBucket(bucket)
  if bucket == nil then return {} end
  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    local entry = bucket[i]
    if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
    end
  end
  return bucket
end

local function parentGameObject(gameObject)
  if gameObject == nil or gameObject.transform == nil then return nil end
  local parent = gameObject.transform.parent
  if parent == nil then return nil end
  return parent.gameObject
end

local function addEntry(result, seen, entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil or seen[entry] == true then return end
  seen[entry] = true
  table.insert(result, entry)
end

local function collectObjectEntries(gameObject, result, seen)
  local current = gameObject
  while current ~= nil do
    for _, entry in ipairs(cleanupBucket(resourceObjectIndex[current])) do
      addEntry(result, seen, entry)
    end
    current = parentGameObject(current)
  end
end

local function collectTargetEntries(target)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}
  if target == nil then return result end

  if type(target) ~= "table" then
    collectObjectEntries(target, result, seen)
    return result
  end

  local resourceId = target.id or target.resourceId
  if resourceId ~= nil then
    for _, entry in ipairs(cleanupBucket(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)])) do
      addEntry(result, seen, entry)
    end
  end
  if type(target.ids) == "table" then
    for _, id in ipairs(target.ids) do
      for _, entry in ipairs(cleanupBucket(resourceIdIndex[tostring(id)])) do
        addEntry(result, seen, entry)
      end
    end
  end
  if target.gameObject ~= nil then
    collectObjectEntries(target.gameObject, result, seen)
  end
  return result
end

local function acceptsEvent(entry, eventName)
  return entry ~= nil and entry.eventSet ~= nil and entry.eventSet[eventName] == true
end

local function safeText(value, fallback, maxChars)
  local text = tostring(value or "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "^%s+", "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "%s+$", "")
  if text == "" then
    text = fallback or "生日快乐，愿心愿成真！"
  end
  local limit = tonumber(maxChars) or 40
  if limit < 1 then limit = 1 end
  if limit > 80 then limit = 80 end
  if string.len(text) > limit then
    text = string.sub(text, 1, limit)
  end
  return text
end

function IsReady()
  return hostReady
end

function RegisterResource(gameObject, resourceId, config)
  if gameObject == nil or resourceId == nil then return nil end
  local normalizedResourceId = tostring(resourceId)
  if normalizedResourceId == "" then return nil end

  config = config or {}
  local entry = findResourceEntry(gameObject, normalizedResourceId)
  if entry ~= nil then
    removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  else
    entry = { gameObject = gameObject, resourceId = normalizedResourceId }
    table.insert(resources, entry)
  end

  entry.events = normalizeStringList(config.events)
  entry.eventSet = buildStringSet(entry.events)
  entry.handler = config.handler
  entry.options = config.options or entry.options or {}
  entry.removed = false
  indexResourceEntry(entry)
  return entry
end

function UnregisterResource(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true then return end
  removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resources, entry)
  entry.removed = true
end

function DispatchEvent(target, eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == nil then return 0 end
  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    if acceptsEvent(entry, eventName) and type(entry.handler) == "function" then
      local ok, result = pcall(entry.handler, eventName, payload or {}, context or {})
      if ok and result ~= false then
        count = count + 1
      elseif not ok then
        hostLogger:warn("dispatch failed", tostring(eventName), tostring(result))
      end
    end
  end
  return count
end

function OpenCakeBlessing(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.sourceGameObject == nil then
    return false
  end

  nextRequestId = nextRequestId + 1
  local requestId = nextRequestId
  local maxChars = tonumber(payload.maxChars) or 40
  pendingCakeBlessing = {
    requestId = requestId,
    sourceGameObject = payload.sourceGameObject,
    sourceResourceId = tostring(payload.sourceResourceId or "module-multistage-cake"),
    defaultText = safeText(payload.defaultText, "生日快乐，愿心愿成真！", maxChars),
    maxChars = maxChars,
  }

  local count = DispatchEvent(
    { id = "ui-cake-blessing" },
    "CakeBlessing.open",
    {
      requestId = requestId,
      title = tostring(payload.title or "写下生日祝福"),
      placeholder = tostring(payload.placeholder or "输入一段祝福语"),
      defaultText = pendingCakeBlessing.defaultText,
      maxChars = maxChars,
    },
    { sourceResourceId = pendingCakeBlessing.sourceResourceId }
  )

  if count <= 0 then
    pendingCakeBlessing = nil
    return false
  end
  return true
end

function SubmitCakeBlessing(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or pendingCakeBlessing == nil then
    return false
  end
  if tonumber(payload.requestId) ~= pendingCakeBlessing.requestId then
    return false
  end

  local text = safeText(payload.text, pendingCakeBlessing.defaultText, pendingCakeBlessing.maxChars)
  local targetGameObject = pendingCakeBlessing.sourceGameObject
  local sourceResourceId = pendingCakeBlessing.sourceResourceId
  pendingCakeBlessing = nil

  local count = DispatchEvent(
    { gameObject = targetGameObject },
    "CakeBlessing.submitted",
    { blessingText = text },
    { sourceResourceId = "ui-cake-blessing", targetResourceId = sourceResourceId }
  )
  return count > 0
end

function CancelCakeBlessing(payload)
  if pendingCakeBlessing == nil then
    return true
  end
  if type(payload) == "table" and payload.requestId ~= nil and tonumber(payload.requestId) ~= pendingCakeBlessing.requestId then
    return false
  end

  local targetGameObject = pendingCakeBlessing.sourceGameObject
  local sourceResourceId = pendingCakeBlessing.sourceResourceId
  pendingCakeBlessing = nil
  DispatchEvent(
    { gameObject = targetGameObject },
    "CakeBlessing.cancelled",
    {},
    { sourceResourceId = "ui-cake-blessing", targetResourceId = sourceResourceId }
  )
  return true
end

function Start()
  hostReady = true
end

---@id 78c05506-a630-4b32-96da-1a989d1f1b37

-- 祝福语输入面板：接收 Runtime Host 打开事件，提交文本后回传给蛋糕。
local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local RESOURCE_ID = "ui-cake-blessing"
local logger = Logger.create("ui-cake-blessing")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

local panelRoot = nil
local inputGo = nil
local submitButtonGo = nil
local cancelButtonGo = nil
local inputComponent = nil
local submitButton = nil
local cancelButton = nil
local resourceEntry = nil
local registered = false
local registerRetryTimer = 0
local registerRetryCount = 0
local maxRegisterRetries = 30
local currentRequestId = nil
local currentMaxChars = 40
local currentDefaultText = "生日快乐，愿心愿成真！"

local submitListener = nil
local cancelListener = nil

local function trimText(value)
  local text = tostring(value or "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "^%s+", "")
  text = string.gsub(text, "%s+$", "")
  return text
end

local function clampText(value)
  local text = trimText(value)
  if text == "" then
    text = currentDefaultText
  end
  local limit = tonumber(currentMaxChars) or 40
  if limit < 1 then limit = 1 end
  if limit > 80 then limit = 80 end
  if string.len(text) > limit then
    text = string.sub(text, 1, limit)
  end
  return text
end

local function getInputComponent(go)
  if go == nil then return nil end

  local input = go:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.InputField))
  if input ~= nil then return input end

  local ok, tmpInput = pcall(function()
    return go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TMP_InputField))
  end)
  if ok then return tmpInput end
  return nil
end

local function setPanelOpen(open)
  if panelRoot ~= nil then
    panelRoot:SetActive(open == true)
  end
end

local function setInputText(value)
  if inputComponent ~= nil then
    inputComponent.text = tostring(value or "")
  end
end

local function getInputText()
  if inputComponent == nil then return "" end
  return tostring(inputComponent.text or "")
end

local function getHost(methodName)
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable", "Runtime UI scope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end
  local host, reason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "Runtime Host unavailable", reason)
    return nil
  end
  if methodName ~= nil and type(host[methodName]) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-method-missing", "Runtime Host method missing", methodName)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function submitBlessing()
  if currentRequestId == nil then
    setPanelOpen(false)
    return
  end

  local host = getHost("SubmitCakeBlessing")
  if host == nil then return end
  local ok = host.SubmitCakeBlessing({
    requestId = currentRequestId,
    text = clampText(getInputText()),
  })
  if ok == true then
    currentRequestId = nil
    setPanelOpen(false)
  end
end

local function cancelBlessing()
  local requestId = currentRequestId
  currentRequestId = nil
  local host = getHost("CancelCakeBlessing")
  if host ~= nil and requestId ~= nil then
    host.CancelCakeBlessing({ requestId = requestId })
  end
  setPanelOpen(false)
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName ~= "CakeBlessing.open" or type(payload) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end

  currentRequestId = tonumber(payload.requestId)
  currentMaxChars = tonumber(payload.maxChars) or 40
  currentDefaultText = tostring(payload.defaultText or "生日快乐，愿心愿成真！")
  setInputText("")
  setPanelOpen(true)
  return currentRequestId ~= nil
end

local function tryRegisterWithHost()
  if registered then return true end
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return false end

  local host = getHost("RegisterResource")
  if host == nil then return false end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    events = { "CakeBlessing.open" },
    handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
  registered = resourceEntry ~= nil
  return registered
end

local function addButtonListener(buttonGo, callback)
  if buttonGo == nil or callback == nil then return nil end
  local button = buttonGo:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Button))
  if button == nil then return nil end
  button.onClick:AddListener(callback)
  return button
end

local function removeButtonListener(button, callback)
  if button ~= nil and callback ~= nil then
    button.onClick:RemoveListener(callback)
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable", "Runtime UI disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
    return
  end

  panelRoot = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("panelRoot")
  inputGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("panelRoot/blessingInput")
  submitButtonGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("panelRoot/submitButton")
  cancelButtonGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject("panelRoot/cancelButton")
  inputComponent = getInputComponent(inputGo)

  submitListener = function() submitBlessing() end
  cancelListener = function() cancelBlessing() end
  submitButton = addButtonListener(submitButtonGo, submitListener)
  cancelButton = addButtonListener(cancelButtonGo, cancelListener)

  setPanelOpen(false)
  tryRegisterWithHost()
end

function Update()
  if registered or registerRetryCount >= maxRegisterRetries then return end
  registerRetryTimer = registerRetryTimer + UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
  if registerRetryTimer < 0.5 then return end
  registerRetryTimer = 0
  registerRetryCount = registerRetryCount + 1
  tryRegisterWithHost()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeButtonListener(submitButton, submitListener)
  removeButtonListener(cancelButton, cancelListener)
  local host = getHost("UnregisterResource")
  if host ~= nil and resourceEntry ~= nil then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
  registered = false
end

661cc44b-fd0c-4264-8683-c4afcdd55a6a.content:
---@id 661cc44b-fd0c-4264-8683-c4afcdd55a6a
---@referenceName ms-rotate.lua
-- 让长条方块围绕自身中心点持续旋转。
---@start
---@var RotationSpeedDegPerSecond:number=45
---@name 旋转速度
---@desc 方块每秒绕自身中心旋转的角度，单位为度/秒；可设为负数反向旋转。
---@range -360,360,1
---@group 运动
---@var EnableRotation:boolean=true
---@name 启用旋转
---@desc 关闭后方块保持当前角度不再自转。
---@group 运动
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local target = nil
local baseEuler = nil
local angleOffset = 0

local function normalizeAngle(angle)
  local result = angle % 360
  if result < 0 then
    result = result + 360
  end
  return result
end

function Start()
  target = self.transform
  if target ~= nil then
    baseEuler = target.localEulerAngles
    angleOffset = 0
  end
end

function Update()
  if target == nil then return end
  if baseEuler == nil then
    baseEuler = target.localEulerAngles
  end
  if not EnableRotation then return end

  angleOffset = normalizeAngle(angleOffset + RotationSpeedDegPerSecond * Time.deltaTime)
  target.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(baseEuler.x, normalizeAngle(baseEuler.y + angleOffset), baseEuler.z)
end

db729bf3-f804-460f-bb66-2db0fdedb7e8.content:
---@id db729bf3-f804-460f-bb66-2db0fdedb7e8
---@referenceName pi-seat.lua
-- 处理方块座位的靠近提示、点击坐下/起身和角色对齐。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始 2 米交互范围等比放大或缩小
---@group 交互
---@var enterSeatText:string="坐下"
---@name 坐下文案
---@desc 座位空闲时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@var exitSeatText:string="起身"
---@name 起身文案
---@desc 本地玩家坐下后交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local seatAnchorPath = "CubeRoot/Body/SeatAnchor"
local standUpAnchorPath = "CubeRoot/Body/StandUpAnchor"

local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local seatTrans = nil
local standUpTrans = nil
local savedBoardOffset = nil
local savedBoardRotation = nil
local currentPlayer = nil
local JoyStickControlMain = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local ownershipPending = false

local function vectorSub(a, b)
  if a == nil or b == nil then
    return UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  end
  return UnityEngine.Vector3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z)
end

local function safeScaleDivide(original, parentScale)
  if original == nil then
    original = UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  end
  if parentScale == nil then
    return original
  end

  local x = parentScale.x
  local y = parentScale.y
  local z = parentScale.z
  if x == 0 then x = 1 end
  if y == 0 then y = 1 end
  if z == 0 then z = 1 end

  return UnityEngine.Vector3(original.x / x, original.y / y, original.z / z)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

function resolveSeatTrans()
  return seatTrans
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end
  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity
  trans.localScale = safeScaleDivide(savedScale[actor], target.lossyScale)

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end
  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPos = hips.position
  local transPos = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    transPos.x - (hipsPos.x - transPos.x),
    transPos.y - (hipsPos.y - transPos.y),
    transPos.z - (hipsPos.z - transPos.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = enabled
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  actor.gameObject.transform:SetParent(nil)
  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    actor.gameObject.transform.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end
  if standUpTrans ~= nil then
    actor.position = standUpTrans.position
    actor.rotation = standUpTrans.rotation
  elseif savedBoardOffset ~= nil then
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + savedBoardOffset.x,
      self.transform.position.y + savedBoardOffset.y,
      self.transform.position.z + savedBoardOffset.z
    )
    actor.rotation = savedBoardRotation
    savedBoardOffset = nil
    savedBoardRotation = nil
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + right.x,
      self.transform.position.y,
      self.transform.position.z + right.z
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end
end

function Start()
  seatTrans = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:FindTransform(seatAnchorPath) or nil
  standUpTrans = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:FindTransform(standUpAnchorPath) or nil

  JoyStickControlMain = CS.DouyinUIService.GetJoyStickControl(CS.UIType.MoveJoyStick)
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OnUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OffUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
    JoyStickControlMain = nil
  end
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = nil
  if not hasPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if hasPassenger then
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  else
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 then
    return
  end

  local actorForAction = localActor
  if hasPassenger then
    actorForAction = currentPlayer
  end
  if actorForAction == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if hasPassenger then
      actorForAction:StandUp(self.gameObject)
    else
      if seatTrans == nil then
        return
      end
      actorForAction:SitDown(self.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasPassenger = false
      currentPlayer = nil
      setButtonText(enterSeatText)
    end
    return
  end

  if actor.isLocal then
    savedBoardOffset = vectorSub(actor.gameObject.transform.position, self.transform.position)
    savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    hasPassenger = true
    currentPlayer = actor
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  end

  savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    hasPassenger = false
    currentPlayer = nil
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
    if localActor == nil then
      self:DisableInteraction()
    else
      self:EnableInteraction()
    end
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(eventData)
  local actor = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if actor == nil or currentPlayer ~= actor then return end
  actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
end

697b6b31-d8bb-4782-b9cb-e5bbd344a4b5.content:
---@id 697b6b31-d8bb-4782-b9cb-e5bbd344a4b5
---@referenceName pi-painting.lua
-- 画板观察与显示：初始显示线稿，按 Runtime Host 正确步骤事件显示上传图片。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@var observeText:string="观察画面"
---@name 观察文案
---@desc 靠近画板时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local logger = Logger.create("pi-board")

local RESOURCE_ID = "module-easel-board"
local STEP_EVENT = "Board.ShowStep"
local MAX_STEPS = 5
