local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
local stepEntries = {}
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local resourceEntry = nil
local currentStep = 0

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function clampStep(step)
  local value = tonumber(step) or 0
  if value < 0 then value = 0 end
  if value > MAX_STEPS then value = MAX_STEPS end
  return math.floor(value)
end

local function setStepVisible(step)
  currentStep = clampStep(step)
  for index = 0, MAX_STEPS do
    local entry = stepEntries[index]
    if entry ~= nil then
      local visible = index == currentStep
      if entry.object ~= nil then
        entry.object:SetActive(visible)
      end
      for _, renderer in ipairs(entry.renderers) do
        if renderer ~= nil then
          renderer.enabled = visible
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

local function collectRenderers(go)
  local renderers = {}
  if go == nil then return renderers end
  local ownRenderer = go:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
  if ownRenderer ~= nil then
    renderers[#renderers + 1] = ownRenderer
  end
  local childRenderers = go:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.MeshRenderer), true)
  if childRenderers ~= nil then
    for i = 0, childRenderers.Length - 1 do
      local renderer = childRenderers[i]
      if renderer ~= nil and renderer ~= ownRenderer then
        renderers[#renderers + 1] = renderer
      end
    end
  end
  return renderers
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName ~= STEP_EVENT or type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end
  setStepVisible(payload.step)
  return true
end

local function getHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "画板无法连接 Runtime Host", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end
  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "画板请求跳过", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function registerResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-unavailable", "画板登记接口不可用")
    return
  end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    tags = { "painting-board" },
    events = { STEP_EVENT },
    handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
end

local function requestObserveBoard()
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.ObserveBoard) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("observe-board-unavailable", "观察接口不可用")
    return
  end
  host.ObserveBoard({ sourceResourceId = RESOURCE_ID })
end

local function syncInitialBoardState()
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.GetPaintingState) ~= "function" then return end
  local state = host.GetPaintingState()
  if type(state) == "table" then
    setStepVisible(state.unlockedStep or state.currentStep or 0)
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "画板步骤图片节点不可用", runtimeScopeReason)
  else
    for step = 0, MAX_STEPS do
      local path = "ModuleRoot/BoardAssembly/PictureStep" .. tostring(step)
      local go = runtimeScope:FindGameObject(path)
      if go ~= nil then
        stepEntries[step] = {
          object = go,
          renderers = collectRenderers(go),
        }
      else
        stepEntries[step] = nil
        logger:warnOnce("step-node-missing-" .. tostring(step), "画板步骤图片节点缺失", path)
      end
    end
  end
  setStepVisible(0)
  registerResource()
  syncInitialBoardState()
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if actor == localActor then
    localActor = nil
  end
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  setButtonText(observeText)
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then return end
  requestObserveBoard()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnDisable()
  local host = getHost()
  if host ~= nil and resourceEntry ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
  localActor = nil
end

589da7d7-d52b-4424-ba1e-72ecee116000.content:
---@id 589da7d7-d52b-4424-ba1e-72ecee116000
---@referenceName pi-pickup.lua
-- 画笔靠近后可拾取或放下，并在拾取期间挂到玩家右手。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@var pickupText:string="拾取画笔"
---@name 拾取文案
---@desc 物体可被本地玩家拾取时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@var dropText:string="放下画笔"
---@name 放下文案
---@desc 物体正由本地玩家持有时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local HandType = CS.HandType
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local logger = Logger.create("pi-brush")

local RESOURCE_ID = "module-paintbrush"
local COLOR_EVENT = "Brush.SetTipColor"
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

local gripAnchorPath = "ModuleRoot/GripSocket/GripAnchor"
local brushTipPath = "ModuleRoot/BluePaintTip"
local pickupHand = HandType.Right

local gripPoint = nil
local rigidbody = nil
local isKinematic = false
local bodyColliders = {}
local currentPlayer = nil
local prevParent = nil
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local brushTipRenderer = nil
local resourceEntry = nil
local AUTO_RESET_SECONDS = 5 * 60
local autoResetElapsed = 0
local homePosition = nil
local homeRotation = nil

local function getHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "画笔无法连接 Runtime Host", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end
  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "画笔跨资源状态跳过", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function applyTipColor(r, g, b)
  if brushTipRenderer == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("tip-renderer-missing", "画笔笔尖渲染器缺失")
    return false
  end

  local color = UnityEngine.Color(r, g, b, 1)
  local material = brushTipRenderer.material
  if material == nil then return false end
  pcall(function() material.color = color end)
  pcall(function() material:SetColor("_BaseColor", color) end)
  pcall(function() material:SetColor("_Color", color) end)
  return true
end

local function handleWorldplayEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName ~= COLOR_EVENT or type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end
  local r = tonumber(payload.r)
  local g = tonumber(payload.g)
  local b = tonumber(payload.b)
  if r == nil or g == nil or b == nil then return false end
  return applyTipColor(r, g, b)
end

local function registerBrushResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-unavailable", "画笔登记接口不可用")
    return
  end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    tags = { "paintbrush" },
    events = { COLOR_EVENT },
    handler = handleWorldplayEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
end

local function setBrushHeld(held)
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.SetBrushHeld) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("set-brush-held-unavailable", "画笔持有状态接口不可用")
    return false
  end
  return host.SetBrushHeld({ held = held == true, sourceResourceId = RESOURCE_ID })
end

local function collectBodyColliders()
  local result = {}
  local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if colliders ~= nil then
    for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
      local col = colliders[i]
      if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then
        result[#result + 1] = col
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled)
  for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do
    if col ~= nil then
      col.enabled = enabled
    end
  end
end

local function disablePhysical()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = true
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(false)
end

local function enablePhysical()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function isHeldByLocal()
  return currentPlayer ~= nil and currentPlayer.isLocal
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function updateTransform(handType, pickupMatrix)
  if currentPlayer == nil then return end
  local isLeft = handType == HandType.Left
  local palmPosition, palmRotation = currentPlayer:CalculatePalmTransform(isLeft)
  local palmWorldMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    palmPosition,
    palmRotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  local finalMatrix = palmWorldMatrix * pickupMatrix
  self.transform.position = finalMatrix:GetPosition()
  self.transform.rotation = finalMatrix.rotation
end

local function computeGripMatrix()
  if gripPoint == nil then
    return UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity
  end
  local selfMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    self.transform.position,
    self.transform.rotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  local gripMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(
    gripPoint.position,
    gripPoint.rotation,
    UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  )
  return selfMat.inverse * gripMat
end

local function tryPickupOrDrop(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  if isHeldByLocal() then
    actor:Drop(self.gameObject)
  else
    disablePhysical()
    actor:Pickup(self.gameObject, pickupHand, computeGripMatrix())
  end
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    gripPoint = runtimeScope:FindTransform(gripAnchorPath)
    local tipGo = runtimeScope:FindGameObject(brushTipPath)
    if tipGo ~= nil then
      brushTipRenderer = tipGo:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
    end
  else
    local _ = runtimeScopeReason
  end
  rigidbody = self.transform:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    isKinematic = rigidbody.isKinematic
  end

  bodyColliders = collectBodyColliders()
  registerBrushResource()
  homePosition = self.transform.position
  homeRotation = self.transform.rotation
end

local function applyHomeTransform()
  if homePosition == nil or homeRotation == nil then return end
  self.transform.position = homePosition
  self.transform.rotation = homeRotation
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    pcall(function() rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero end)
    pcall(function() rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero end)
  end
end

function Update()
  if homePosition == nil then return end
  autoResetElapsed = autoResetElapsed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
  if autoResetElapsed < AUTO_RESET_SECONDS then return end
  if currentPlayer ~= nil then return end
  autoResetElapsed = 0
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled or self:HasOwnership() then
    applyHomeTransform()
  else
    ensureOwnership(applyHomeTransform)
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  if actor == localActor then
    localActor = nil
  end
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if isHeldByLocal() then
    setButtonText(dropText)
  else
    setButtonText(pickupText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    tryPickupOrDrop(localActor)
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnPickup(actor, handType, pickUpPoint)
  if actor == nil then return end

  local resolvedHandType = handType or pickupHand
  disablePhysical()
  currentPlayer = actor

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator ~= nil then
    local bone = nil
    if resolvedHandType == HandType.Left then
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.LeftHand)
    else
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.RightHand)
    end
    if bone ~= nil then
      prevParent = self.transform.parent
      self.transform:SetParent(bone)
    end
  end

  local pickupMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity
  if pickUpPoint ~= nil then
    pickupMatrix = pickUpPoint.inverse
  end
  updateTransform(resolvedHandType, pickupMatrix)
  if actor ~= nil and actor.isLocal then
    setButtonText(dropText)
    setBrushHeld(true)
  end
end

function OnDrop(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor ~= currentPlayer then return end

  self.transform:SetParent(prevParent)
  prevParent = nil
  enablePhysical()
  currentPlayer = nil
  if actor ~= nil and actor.isLocal then
    setButtonText(pickupText)
    setBrushHeld(false)
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  local host = getHost()
  if host ~= nil and resourceEntry ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
  setBrushHeld(false)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
  localActor = nil
end

4eb69a44-0382-4c22-a8ad-1d45e0ff0b21.content:
---@id 4eb69a44-0382-4c22-a8ad-1d45e0ff0b21
---@referenceName pi-pickup.lua
-- 调色盘蘸色交互：玩家手持画笔靠近后，通过颜色按钮按顺序蘸取颜料。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local logger = Logger.create("pi-palette")

local RESOURCE_ID = "module-palette"
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local colorOptions = {
  { name = "蓝色", r = 0.18, g = 0.55, b = 1.0 },
  { name = "绿色", r = 0.27, g = 0.75, b = 0.35 },
  { name = "黄色", r = 1.0, g = 0.85, b = 0.16 },
  { name = "红色", r = 0.93, g = 0.18, b = 0.15 },
  { name = "紫色", r = 0.65, g = 0.42, b = 1.0 },
}

local localActor = nil
local colorButtons = {}

local function getHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "调色盘无法连接 Runtime Host", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end
  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "调色盘蘸色请求跳过", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function setButtonText(button, text)
  if button == nil then return end
  local label = button:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function requestDipColor(colorIndex)
  local option = colorOptions[colorIndex]
  if option == nil then return end
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.DipBrush) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("dip-brush-unavailable", "蘸色接口不可用")
    return
  end
  local result = host.DipBrush({
    colorIndex = colorIndex,
    colorName = option.name,
    r = option.r,
    g = option.g,
    b = option.b,
    sourceResourceId = RESOURCE_ID,
  })
  if type(result) == "table" and result.ok == false then
    logger:warnOnce("dip-brush-rejected", "蘸色未生效", result.reason)
  end
end

local function isBrushHeld()
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.GetPaintingState) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  local state = host.GetPaintingState()
  return type(state) == "table" and state.brushHeld == true
end

local function removeColorButtons()
  for _, button in ipairs(colorButtons) do
    if button ~= nil then
      self:RemoveInteractorButton(button)
    end
  end
  colorButtons = {}
end

local function setPaletteNear(near)
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.SetPaletteNear) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("palette-near-unavailable", "调色盘靠近状态接口不可用")
    return
  end
  host.SetPaletteNear({ near = near == true, sourceResourceId = RESOURCE_ID })
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActor = actor
  setPaletteNear(true)
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if actor == localActor then
    localActor = nil
    setPaletteNear(false)
  end
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  removeColorButtons()
  if not isBrushHeld() then
    logger:warnOnce("brush-not-held-for-palette-ui", "未拿起画笔，不显示蘸色按钮")
    return
  end
  for index, option in ipairs(colorOptions) do
    local button = self:AddInteractorButton()
    colorButtons[index] = button
    setButtonText(button, "蘸" .. option.name)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if localActor == nil or index == nil then return end
  if not isBrushHeld() then
    removeColorButtons()
    return
  end
  if index >= 1 and index <= #colorOptions then
    requestDipColor(index)
  end
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeColorButtons()
end

function OnDisable()
  removeColorButtons()
  if localActor ~= nil then
    setPaletteNear(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
end

af56cf3b-0c38-4631-90b3-e8adafb9269e.content:
---@id af56cf3b-0c38-4631-90b3-e8adafb9269e
---@referenceName runtime-host.lua
-- 绘画步骤玩法的跨资源协调脚本：登记资源、保存画笔颜色和同步画板填色进度。
---@start
---@varSync BoardStateCode:int=0
---@end
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local hostLogger = Logger.create("runtime-host")

local hostReady = false
local registry = {}
local resources = {}
local resourceIdIndex = {}
local resourceTagIndex = {}
local resourceObjectIndex = {}
local statsVersion = 0
local netSpawned = false
local ownershipPending = false

local MAX_STEPS = 5
local colorSteps = {
  { regionIndex = 1, regionName = "天空", colorIndex = 1, colorName = "蓝色", prompt = "请选择蓝色，然后点击右侧画面中的天空区域。", unlockedMessage = "天空区域填色正确，已同步蓝天画面。", r = 0.18, g = 0.55, b = 1.0 },
  { regionIndex = 2, regionName = "草地", colorIndex = 2, colorName = "绿色", prompt = "请选择绿色，然后点击右侧画面中的草地和山坡区域。", unlockedMessage = "草地区域填色正确，已同步绿色草地画面。", r = 0.27, g = 0.75, b = 0.35 },
  { regionIndex = 3, regionName = "太阳和向日葵", colorIndex = 3, colorName = "黄色", prompt = "请选择黄色，然后点击右侧画面中的太阳或向日葵区域。", unlockedMessage = "黄色区域填色正确，已同步太阳和向日葵画面。", r = 1.0, g = 0.85, b = 0.16 },
  { regionIndex = 4, regionName = "红色花朵", colorIndex = 4, colorName = "红色", prompt = "请选择红色，然后点击右侧画面中的红色花朵区域。", unlockedMessage = "红色花朵填色正确，已同步红色花朵画面。", r = 0.93, g = 0.18, b = 0.15 },
  { regionIndex = 5, regionName = "紫色花朵", colorIndex = 5, colorName = "紫色", prompt = "请选择紫色，然后点击右侧画面中的紫色花朵区域。", unlockedMessage = "紫色花朵填色正确，最终成品已多人同步。", r = 0.65, g = 0.42, b = 1.0 },
}
local paintingState = {
  brushHeld = false,
  paletteNear = false,
  currentColorIndex = 0,
  currentColorName = "",
  currentColor = nil,
  filledMask = 0,
  unlockedStep = 0,
  expectedColorIndex = 1,
  lastSelectedColorIndex = 0,
  lastSelectedColorName = "",
  lastCorrect = false,
  lastMessage = "请先拿起画笔，再选择左侧颜色并点击右侧对应区域填色。",
  prompt = "请选择蓝色，然后点击右侧画面中的天空区域。",
  observeVersion = 0,
  observedStep = 0,
  maxSteps = MAX_STEPS,
}

local function getCurrentStepDef()
  if paintingState.unlockedStep >= MAX_STEPS then return nil end
  return colorSteps[paintingState.unlockedStep + 1]
end

local function maskForStep(step)
  local value = tonumber(step) or 0
  if value < 0 then value = 0 end
  if value > MAX_STEPS then value = MAX_STEPS end
  return math.floor((2 ^ value) - 1)
end

local function stepFromMask(mask)
  local value = tonumber(mask) or 0
  local step = 0
  while step < MAX_STEPS and value >= maskForStep(step + 1) do
    step = step + 1
  end
  return step
end

local function refreshExpectedPrompt()
  local stepDef = getCurrentStepDef()
  if stepDef == nil then
    paintingState.expectedColorIndex = 0
    paintingState.prompt = "画面已完成！可以关闭观察面板或点击重置重新开始。"
    return
  end
  paintingState.expectedColorIndex = stepDef.colorIndex
  paintingState.prompt = stepDef.prompt
end

local function dispatchBoardStep()
  local stepPayload = {
    step = paintingState.unlockedStep,
    maxSteps = MAX_STEPS,
    colorIndex = paintingState.currentColorIndex,
    colorName = paintingState.currentColorName,
    prompt = paintingState.prompt,
  }
  DispatchEvent({ id = "module-easel-board" }, "Board.ShowStep", stepPayload, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
end

local function applyBoardMask(mask, reason)
  local oldStep = paintingState.unlockedStep
  local nextMask = tonumber(mask) or 0
  if nextMask < 0 then nextMask = 0 end
  if nextMask > maskForStep(MAX_STEPS) then nextMask = maskForStep(MAX_STEPS) end
  paintingState.filledMask = math.floor(nextMask)
  paintingState.unlockedStep = stepFromMask(paintingState.filledMask)
  paintingState.observedStep = paintingState.unlockedStep
  if paintingState.unlockedStep == 0 then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "画板已重置为线稿，请重新选择颜色并点击对应区域。"
    paintingState.currentColorIndex = 0
    paintingState.currentColorName = ""
    paintingState.currentColor = nil
  elseif paintingState.unlockedStep > oldStep then
    local stepDef = colorSteps[paintingState.unlockedStep]
    paintingState.lastMessage = stepDef ~= nil and stepDef.unlockedMessage or "画板填色已同步更新。"
  elseif reason == "sync" then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "画板状态已同步。"
  end
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  dispatchBoardStep()
  bumpVersion()
end

local function ensureHostOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then return end
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    action(false)
    return
  end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action(true)
    return
  end
  if ownershipPending then return end
  ownershipPending = true
  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action(true)
    end
  end)
end

local function setSyncedBoardMask(mask)
  if netSpawned and BoardStateCode ~= nil and DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    ensureHostOwnership(function(canSync)
      if canSync then
        BoardStateCode:SetValue(mask)
      else
        applyBoardMask(mask, "local")
      end
    end)
  else
    applyBoardMask(mask, "local")
  end
end

local function bumpVersion()
  statsVersion = statsVersion + 1
end

local function getBucket(component, group)
  registry[component] = registry[component] or {}
  registry[component][group] = registry[component][group] or {}
  return registry[component][group]
end

local function getResourceIdBucket(resourceId)
  if resourceId == nil then return {} end
  resourceIdIndex[resourceId] = resourceIdIndex[resourceId] or {}
  return resourceIdIndex[resourceId]
end

local function getResourceTagBucket(tag)
  if tag == nil then return {} end
  resourceTagIndex[tag] = resourceTagIndex[tag] or {}
  return resourceTagIndex[tag]
end

local function getResourceObjectBucket(gameObject)
  if gameObject == nil then return {} end
  resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] = resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] or {}
  return resourceObjectIndex[gameObject]
end

local function cloneShallowTable(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end
  for key, value in pairs(source) do
    result[key] = value
  end
  return result
end

local function cloneArray(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end
  for _, value in ipairs(source) do
    table.insert(result, value)
  end
  return result
end

local function normalizeStringList(values)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}
  local function addValue(value)
    if value == nil then return end
    local normalized = tostring(value)
    if normalized == "" or seen[normalized] == true then return end
    seen[normalized] = true
    table.insert(result, normalized)
  end
  if type(values) == "string" then
    for value in string.gmatch(values, "[^,%s;]+") do
      addValue(value)
    end
    return result
  end
  if type(values) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(values) do
      if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" then
        addValue(value)
      elseif type(key) == "string" and value == true then
        addValue(key)
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function buildStringSet(values)
  local result = {}
  if type(values) ~= "table" then return result end
  for _, value in ipairs(values) do
    result[value] = true
  end
  return result
end

local function snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return nil end
  return {
    gameObject = entry.gameObject,
    resourceId = entry.resourceId,
    options = cloneShallowTable(entry.options),
    removed = entry.removed == true,
    tags = cloneArray(entry.tags),
    events = cloneArray(entry.events),
  }
end

local function removeEntryFromArray(array, entry)
  if array == nil then return end
  for i = #array, 1, -1 do
    if array[i] == entry then
      table.remove(array, i)
    end
  end
end

local function removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceIdIndex[entry.resourceId], entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceObjectIndex[entry.gameObject], entry)
  if entry.tags ~= nil then
    for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags) do
      removeEntryFromArray(resourceTagIndex[tag], entry)
    end
  end
end

local function indexResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  table.insert(getResourceIdBucket(entry.resourceId), entry)
  table.insert(getResourceObjectBucket(entry.gameObject), entry)
  if entry.tags ~= nil then
    for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags) do
      table.insert(getResourceTagBucket(tag), entry)
    end
  end
end

local function cleanupResourceBucket(bucket)
  if bucket == nil then return {} end
  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    local entry = bucket[i]
    if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
    end
  end
  return bucket
end

local function findResourceEntry(gameObject, resourceId)
  for _, entry in ipairs(resources) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and entry.gameObject == gameObject and entry.resourceId == resourceId then
      return entry
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function acceptsEvent(entry, eventName)
  if entry == nil or entry.eventSet == nil or eventName == nil then return false end
  return entry.eventSet[eventName] == true
end

local function addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil or seen[entry] == true then return end
  seen[entry] = true
  table.insert(result, entry)
end

local function collectBucketEntries(bucket, result, seen)
  cleanupResourceBucket(bucket)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket or {}) do
    addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  end
end

local function collectGameObjectEntries(gameObject, result, seen)
  if gameObject == nil then return end
  local resourceRoot = RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(gameObject)
  collectBucketEntries(resourceObjectIndex[resourceRoot], result, seen)
end

local function collectSelectorList(values, visitor)
  if values == nil then return end
  if type(values) == "table" then
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
      visitor(value)
    end
    return
  end
  visitor(values)
end

local function collectTargetEntries(target)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}
  if target == nil then return result end
  if type(target) ~= "table" then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target, result, seen)
    return result
  end
  collectSelectorList(target.id or target.resourceId, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.ids or target.resourceIds, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tag, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tags, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)
  if target.gameObject ~= nil then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target.gameObject, result, seen)
  end
  return result
end

local function warnEventFailure(eventName, context, message)
  local source = context ~= nil and context.sourceResourceId or nil
  hostLogger:warn("event dispatch failed", "event=" .. tostring(eventName), "source=" .. tostring(source), "error=" .. tostring(message))
end

local function makeColorPayload()
  if paintingState.currentColor == nil then return nil end
  return {
    colorIndex = paintingState.currentColorIndex,
    colorName = paintingState.currentColorName,
    r = paintingState.currentColor.r,
    g = paintingState.currentColor.g,
    b = paintingState.currentColor.b,
  }
end

function IsReady()
  return hostReady
end

function EnsureScene()
  return true
end

function RegisterResource(gameObject, resourceId, config)
  if gameObject == nil or resourceId == nil then return nil end
  local normalizedResourceId = tostring(resourceId)
  if normalizedResourceId == "" then return nil end
  config = config or {}
  local entry = findResourceEntry(gameObject, normalizedResourceId)
  if entry ~= nil then
    removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  else
    entry = { gameObject = gameObject, resourceId = normalizedResourceId }
    table.insert(resources, entry)
  end
  entry.tags = normalizeStringList(config.tags)
  entry.events = normalizeStringList(config.events)
  entry.eventSet = buildStringSet(entry.events)
  entry.handler = config.handler
  entry.options = config.options or entry.options or {}
  entry.removed = false
  indexResourceEntry(entry)
  return entry
end

function UnregisterResource(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true then return end
  removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resources, entry)
  entry.removed = true
end

function GetResources(target)
  local snapshot = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    local item = snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
    if item ~= nil then table.insert(snapshot, item) end
  end
  return snapshot
end

function ForEachResource(target, visitor)
  if type(visitor) ~= "function" then return 0 end
  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    local item = snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
    if item ~= nil then
      visitor(item)
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end

function DispatchEvent(target, eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == nil then return 0 end
  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and type(entry.handler) == "function" and acceptsEvent(entry, eventName) then
      local ok, result = pcall(entry.handler, eventName, payload or {}, context or {})
      if ok and result ~= false then
        count = count + 1
      elseif not ok then
        warnEventFailure(eventName, context, result)
      end
    end
  end
  return count
end

function Register(component, group, gameObject, initialState, options)
  if component == nil or group == nil or gameObject == nil then return nil end
  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject == gameObject then
      entry.state = initialState or entry.state or {}
      entry.options = options or entry.options or {}
      return entry
    end
  end
  local entry = { component = component, group = group, gameObject = gameObject, state = initialState or {}, options = options or {} }
  table.insert(bucket, entry)
  bumpVersion()
  return entry
end

function UpdateRegistry(entry, patch)
  if entry == nil or entry.state == nil then return end
  if patch ~= nil then
    for key, value in pairs(patch) do
      entry.state[key] = value
    end
  end
  bumpVersion()
end

function Unregister(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  local bucket = getBucket(entry.component, entry.group)
  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    if bucket[i] == entry then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
      bumpVersion()
      return
    end
  end
end

function GetStats(component, group)
  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  local total = 0
  local active = 0
  local collected = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil then
      total = total + 1
      if entry.state == nil or entry.state.active ~= false then active = active + 1 end
      if entry.state ~= nil and entry.state.collected == true then collected = collected + 1 end
    end
  end
  return { total = total, active = active, collected = collected, allCollected = total > 0 and collected >= total, version = statsVersion }
end

function ForEach(component, group, visitor)
  if visitor == nil then return end
  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil then
      visitor(entry)
    end
  end
end

function SetBrushHeld(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.held) ~= "boolean" then return false end
  paintingState.brushHeld = payload.held
  if payload.held == true then
    if paintingState.unlockedStep >= MAX_STEPS then
      paintingState.lastMessage = "画面已经完成，可以靠近画板观察最终成品。"
    else
      paintingState.lastMessage = "已拿起画笔，请靠近调色盘选择颜色。"
    end
  else
    paintingState.lastMessage = "已放下画笔；再次拾取后可继续当前步骤。"
  end
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  bumpVersion()
  return true
end

function SetPaletteNear(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.near) ~= "boolean" then return false end
  paintingState.paletteNear = payload.near
  if payload.near == true then
    if paintingState.brushHeld == true then
      paintingState.lastMessage = "已靠近调色盘，请按当前步骤选择颜色。"
    else
      paintingState.lastMessage = "已靠近调色盘，请先拿起画笔再蘸色。"
    end
  else
    paintingState.lastMessage = "离开调色盘后，调色盘步骤看板已隐藏。"
  end
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  bumpVersion()
  return true
end

function DipBrush(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid-payload" } end
  local colorIndex = tonumber(payload.colorIndex)
  local r = tonumber(payload.r)
  local g = tonumber(payload.g)
  local b = tonumber(payload.b)
  if colorIndex == nil or colorIndex < 1 or colorIndex > 5 or r == nil or g == nil or b == nil then
    return { ok = false, reason = "invalid-payload" }
  end
  if paintingState.brushHeld ~= true then
    paintingState.lastCorrect = false
    paintingState.lastMessage = "请先拿起画笔，再选择颜色。"
    bumpVersion()
    return { ok = false, reason = "brush-not-held" }
  end
  local selectedIndex = math.floor(colorIndex)
  paintingState.currentColorIndex = selectedIndex
  paintingState.currentColorName = tostring(payload.colorName or "颜色" .. tostring(colorIndex))
  paintingState.currentColor = { r = r, g = g, b = b }
  paintingState.lastSelectedColorIndex = selectedIndex
  paintingState.lastSelectedColorName = paintingState.currentColorName
  local colorPayload = makeColorPayload()
  local brushDelivered = DispatchEvent({ id = "module-paintbrush" }, "Brush.SetTipColor", colorPayload, { sourceResourceId = "module-palette" })
  local stepDef = getCurrentStepDef()
  if stepDef == nil then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "画面已经完成，可以点击重置重新开始。"
  elseif selectedIndex == stepDef.colorIndex then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "已选择" .. paintingState.currentColorName .. "，请点击右侧画面中的" .. stepDef.regionName .. "区域填色。"
  else
    paintingState.lastMessage = "已选择" .. paintingState.currentColorName .. "；当前目标区域需要" .. stepDef.colorName .. "。"
  end
  paintingState.lastCorrect = false
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  bumpVersion()
  return { ok = true, selected = true, colorIndex = paintingState.currentColorIndex, step = paintingState.unlockedStep, completed = paintingState.unlockedStep >= MAX_STEPS, delivered = brushDelivered }
end

function FillRegion(payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return { ok = false, reason = "invalid-payload" } end
  local regionIndex = tonumber(payload.regionIndex)
  if regionIndex == nil or regionIndex < 1 or regionIndex > MAX_STEPS then
    return { ok = false, reason = "invalid-region" }
  end
  if paintingState.brushHeld ~= true then
    paintingState.lastCorrect = false
    paintingState.lastMessage = "请先拿起画笔，再进行填色。"
    bumpVersion()
    return { ok = false, reason = "brush-not-held" }
  end
  if paintingState.currentColorIndex <= 0 then
    paintingState.lastCorrect = false
    paintingState.lastMessage = "请先点击左侧颜色，再点击右侧对应部位。"
    bumpVersion()
    return { ok = false, reason = "no-color" }
  end
  local stepDef = getCurrentStepDef()
  if stepDef == nil then
    paintingState.lastCorrect = false
    paintingState.lastMessage = "画面已经完成，可以重置后重新填色。"
    bumpVersion()
    return { ok = true, correct = false, completed = true, reason = "already-completed" }
  end
  if math.floor(regionIndex) ~= stepDef.regionIndex or paintingState.currentColorIndex ~= stepDef.colorIndex then
    paintingState.lastCorrect = false
    paintingState.lastMessage = "没有填入：请先选择" .. stepDef.colorName .. "，再点击" .. stepDef.regionName .. "区域。"
    bumpVersion()
    return { ok = true, correct = false, expectedColorIndex = stepDef.colorIndex, expectedRegionIndex = stepDef.regionIndex }
  end
  paintingState.lastCorrect = true
  setSyncedBoardMask(maskForStep(paintingState.unlockedStep + 1))
  return { ok = true, correct = true, step = paintingState.unlockedStep + 1, completed = paintingState.unlockedStep + 1 >= MAX_STEPS }
end

function ResetPainting(payload)
  setSyncedBoardMask(0)
  return { ok = true }
end

function PaintStroke(payload)
  paintingState.lastMessage = "现在通过靠近调色盘并选择正确颜色来解锁画面。"
  bumpVersion()
  return { ok = false, reason = "painting-replaced-by-dip", step = paintingState.unlockedStep }
end

function ObserveBoard(payload)
  paintingState.observeVersion = paintingState.observeVersion + 1
  paintingState.observedStep = paintingState.unlockedStep
  if paintingState.unlockedStep >= MAX_STEPS then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "正在观察最终成品。"
  elseif paintingState.unlockedStep == 0 then
    paintingState.lastMessage = "正在观察线稿：按提示先选择天空的颜色。"
  else
    paintingState.lastMessage = "正在观察已解锁画面，请继续下一步颜色。"
  end
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  bumpVersion()
  return { ok = true, observedStep = paintingState.observedStep, prompt = paintingState.prompt }
end

function GetPaintingState()
  refreshExpectedPrompt()
  return {
    brushHeld = paintingState.brushHeld,
    paletteNear = paintingState.paletteNear,
    currentColorIndex = paintingState.currentColorIndex,
    currentColorName = paintingState.currentColorName,
    currentStep = paintingState.unlockedStep,
    filledMask = paintingState.filledMask,
    unlockedStep = paintingState.unlockedStep,
    expectedColorIndex = paintingState.expectedColorIndex,
    lastSelectedColorIndex = paintingState.lastSelectedColorIndex,
    lastSelectedColorName = paintingState.lastSelectedColorName,
    lastCorrect = paintingState.lastCorrect,
    lastMessage = paintingState.lastMessage,
    prompt = paintingState.prompt,
    observeVersion = paintingState.observeVersion,
    observedStep = paintingState.observedStep,
    maxSteps = MAX_STEPS,
    version = statsVersion,
  }
end

function OnNetSpawned()
  netSpawned = true
  if BoardStateCode ~= nil then
    BoardStateCode:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
      applyBoardMask(tonumber(curVal) or 0, "sync")
    end)
    applyBoardMask(tonumber(BoardStateCode:GetValue()) or 0, "sync")
  end
end

function OnNetDestroy()
  netSpawned = false
end

function Start()
  hostReady = true
end

bba5dde7-ccc8-4508-a0e4-92812253cdad.content:
---@id bba5dde7-ccc8-4508-a0e4-92812253cdad
---@referenceName ui.lua
-- 绘画玩法调色盘看板：轮询 Runtime Host 状态，显示步骤提示、进度和画板观察图。
local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local logger = Logger.create("ui-palette-guide")

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

local MAX_STEPS = 5
local POLL_INTERVAL = 0.2
local elapsed = 0
local lastVersion = -1
local lastObserveVersion = -1

local textNodes = {}
local badgeNodes = {}
local observeImages = {}
local guidePanelRoot = nil
local observePanelRoot = nil
local paletteBoardRoot = nil
local observePanelOpen = false
local currentBrushHeld = false
local currentPaletteNear = false
local buttonListeners = {}
local pollHost = nil
local refreshObserveImage = nil

local colorOptions = {
  [1] = { nodeName = "swatchBlue", name = "蓝色", r = 0.18, g = 0.55, b = 1.0 },
  [2] = { nodeName = "swatchGreen", name = "绿色", r = 0.27, g = 0.75, b = 0.35 },
  [3] = { nodeName = "swatchYellow", name = "黄色", r = 1.0, g = 0.85, b = 0.16 },
  [4] = { nodeName = "swatchRed", name = "红色", r = 0.93, g = 0.18, b = 0.15 },
  [5] = { nodeName = "swatchPurple", name = "紫色", r = 0.65, g = 0.42, b = 1.0 },
}

local promptByStep = {
  [0] = "请蘸取：天空的颜色（蓝色）。",
  [1] = "请蘸取：草地的颜色（绿色）。",
  [2] = "请蘸取：太阳和向日葵的颜色（黄色）。",
  [3] = "请蘸取：红色花朵的颜色（红色）。",
  [4] = "请蘸取：紫色花朵的颜色（紫色）。",
  [5] = "画面已完成！可以靠近画板观察最终成品。",
}

local observeTitleByStep = {
  [0] = "线稿阶段",
  [1] = "天空上色完成",
  [2] = "草地上色完成",
  [3] = "黄色元素完成",
  [4] = "红色花朵完成",
  [5] = "最终成品完成",
}

local badgeNames = {
  [1] = "swatchBlueBadge",
  [2] = "swatchGreenBadge",
  [3] = "swatchYellowBadge",
  [4] = "swatchRedBadge",
  [5] = "swatchPurpleBadge",
}

local regionOptions = {
  [1] = { nodeName = "fillSkyBtn", label = "天空" },
  [2] = { nodeName = "fillGrassBtn", label = "草地" },
  [3] = { nodeName = "fillYellowBtn", label = "太阳和向日葵" },
  [4] = { nodeName = "fillRedBtn", label = "红色花朵" },
  [5] = { nodeName = "fillPurpleBtn", label = "紫色花朵" },
}

local function findGo(path)
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  return runtimeScope:FindGameObject(path)
end

local function findText(path)
  local go = findGo(path)
  if go == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("ui-node-missing-" .. path, "UI 文本节点缺失", path)
    return nil
  end
  return go:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
end

local function setText(key, value)
  local node = textNodes[key]
  if node ~= nil then
    node.text = tostring(value or "")
  end
end

local function setActive(go, active)
  if go ~= nil then
    go:SetActive(active == true)
  end
end

local function setObservePanelOpen(open)
  observePanelOpen = open == true
  setActive(observePanelRoot, observePanelOpen)
end

local function getHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "调色盘看板无法连接 Runtime Host", runtimeScopeReason)
    return nil
  end
  local host, hostReason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "调色盘看板读取状态失败", hostReason)
    return nil
  end
  return host
end

local function requestDipColor(colorIndex)
  local option = colorOptions[colorIndex]
  if option == nil then return end
  if not currentBrushHeld then
    setText("promptText", "请先拿起画笔，拿起后才能点击颜色蘸取。")
    setText("statusText", "未拿起画笔时颜色点击不会生效。")
    return
  end
  if not currentPaletteNear then
    setText("promptText", "请靠近调色盘后再选择颜色。")
    setText("statusText", "离开调色盘时，调色盘步骤看板不会显示。")
    return
  end
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.DipBrush) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("dip-brush-unavailable", "UI 蘸色接口不可用")
    return
  end
  local result = host.DipBrush({
    colorIndex = colorIndex,
    colorName = option.name,
    r = option.r,
    g = option.g,
    b = option.b,
    sourceResourceId = "ui-palette-guide",
  })
  if type(result) == "table" and result.ok == false then
    logger:warnOnce("ui-dip-brush-rejected", "UI 蘸色未生效", result.reason)
  end
  pollHost()
end

local function requestFillRegion(regionIndex)
  if not currentBrushHeld then
    setText("promptText", "请先拿起画笔，拿起后才能填色。")
    setText("statusText", "未拿起画笔时点击画面不会填入颜色。")
    return
  end
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.FillRegion) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("fill-region-unavailable", "UI 填色接口不可用")
    return
  end
  local result = host.FillRegion({ regionIndex = regionIndex, sourceResourceId = "ui-palette-guide" })
  if type(result) == "table" and result.ok == false then
    logger:warnOnce("fill-region-rejected", "UI 填色未生效", result.reason)
  end
  pollHost()
end

local function requestResetPainting()
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.ResetPainting) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("reset-painting-unavailable", "重置接口不可用")
    return
  end
  host.ResetPainting({ sourceResourceId = "ui-palette-guide" })
  setObservePanelOpen(true)
  refreshObserveImage(0)
  pollHost()
end

local function bindButton(path, key, callback)
  local go = findGo(path)
  if go == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("button-node-missing-" .. key, "按钮节点缺失", key)
    return
  end
  local button = go:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Button))
  if button == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("button-component-missing-" .. key, "按钮组件缺失", key)
    return
  end
  button.onClick:AddListener(callback)
  buttonListeners[#buttonListeners + 1] = { button = button, listener = callback }
end

local function bindColorButton(colorIndex)
  local option = colorOptions[colorIndex]
  if option == nil then return end
  bindButton("guidePanelRoot/paletteBoardRoot/" .. option.nodeName, option.nodeName, function()
    requestDipColor(colorIndex)
  end)
end

local function clearButtonListeners()
  for _, item in ipairs(buttonListeners) do
    if item ~= nil and item.button ~= nil and item.listener ~= nil then
      item.button.onClick:RemoveListener(item.listener)
    end
  end
  buttonListeners = {}
end

local function clampStep(step)
  local value = tonumber(step) or 0
  if value < 0 then value = 0 end
  if value > MAX_STEPS then value = MAX_STEPS end
  return math.floor(value)
end

local function refreshBadges(expectedColorIndex, unlockedStep)
  for index, name in pairs(badgeNames) do
    local badge = badgeNodes[name]
    if badge ~= nil then
      if index <= unlockedStep then
        badge.text = "完成"
      elseif index == expectedColorIndex then
        badge.text = "下一步"
      else
        badge.text = "等待"
      end
    end
  end
end

function refreshObserveImage(step)
  local selected = clampStep(step)
  for index, go in pairs(observeImages) do
    setActive(go, index == selected)
  end
  setText("observeTitleText", observeTitleByStep[selected] or "画板观察")
  setText("observePromptText", promptByStep[selected] or "查看当前画板。")
end

local function refreshState(state)
  if type(state) ~= "table" then return end
  local unlockedStep = clampStep(state.unlockedStep or state.currentStep)
  local expectedColorIndex = tonumber(state.expectedColorIndex) or 0
  local version = tonumber(state.version) or 0
  local observeVersion = tonumber(state.observeVersion) or 0
  local brushHeld = state.brushHeld == true
  local paletteNear = state.paletteNear == true
  currentBrushHeld = brushHeld
  currentPaletteNear = paletteNear

  if version ~= lastVersion then
    lastVersion = version
    setText("progressText", "进度：" .. tostring(unlockedStep) .. " / " .. tostring(MAX_STEPS))
    setActive(guidePanelRoot, paletteNear)
    setActive(paletteBoardRoot, brushHeld and paletteNear)
    if not paletteNear then
      setText("promptText", "靠近调色盘后显示步骤看板。")
      setText("statusText", "当前不在调色盘旁，颜色按钮已隐藏。")
    elseif brushHeld then
      setText("promptText", tostring(state.prompt or promptByStep[unlockedStep] or "请按提示选择颜色。"))
      setText("statusText", tostring(state.lastMessage or "正确颜色会解锁对应画面，错误颜色不会填入。"))
    else
      setText("promptText", "请先拿起画笔，拿起后才能在调色盘旁蘸色。")
      setText("statusText", "未拿起画笔时，颜色按钮不会显示。")
    end
    refreshBadges(expectedColorIndex, unlockedStep)
    if observePanelOpen then
      refreshObserveImage(unlockedStep)
    end
  end

  if observeVersion ~= lastObserveVersion then
    lastObserveVersion = observeVersion
    if observeVersion > 0 then
      setObservePanelOpen(true)
      refreshObserveImage(unlockedStep)
    end
  end
end

function pollHost()
  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.GetPaintingState) ~= "function" then
    return
  end
  local state = host.GetPaintingState()
  refreshState(state)
end

function Start()
  textNodes.progressText = findText("guidePanelRoot/progressText")
  textNodes.promptText = findText("guidePanelRoot/promptText")
  textNodes.statusText = findText("guidePanelRoot/statusText")
  textNodes.observeTitleText = findText("observePanelRoot/observeTitleText")
  textNodes.observePromptText = findText("observePanelRoot/observePromptText")

  for _, name in pairs(badgeNames) do
    badgeNodes[name] = findText("guidePanelRoot/paletteBoardRoot/" .. name)
  end

  observePanelRoot = findGo("observePanelRoot")
  guidePanelRoot = findGo("guidePanelRoot")
  paletteBoardRoot = findGo("guidePanelRoot/paletteBoardRoot")
  setActive(guidePanelRoot, false)
  for index = 1, MAX_STEPS do
    bindColorButton(index)
  end
  for index = 1, MAX_STEPS do
    local option = regionOptions[index]
    if option ~= nil then
      local regionIndex = index
      bindButton("observePanelRoot/observeImageSlot/" .. option.nodeName, option.nodeName, function()
        requestFillRegion(regionIndex)
      end)
    end
  end
  bindButton("observePanelRoot/resetBoardBtn", "resetBoardBtn", requestResetPainting)
  bindButton("observePanelRoot/closeObserveBtn", "closeObserveBtn", function()
    setObservePanelOpen(false)
  end)
  for index = 0, MAX_STEPS do
    observeImages[index] = findGo("observePanelRoot/observeImageSlot/observeImage" .. tostring(index))
  end

  setObservePanelOpen(false)
  setActive(paletteBoardRoot, false)
  refreshBadges(1, 0)
  refreshObserveImage(0)
  pollHost()
end

function Update()
  elapsed = elapsed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
  if elapsed < POLL_INTERVAL then return end
  elapsed = 0
  pollHost()
end

function OnDestroy()
  clearButtonListeners()
  observeImages = {}
  badgeNodes = {}
  textNodes = {}
  guidePanelRoot = nil
  observePanelRoot = nil
  paletteBoardRoot = nil
end

df6ee627-cd27-4f76-be4a-16371ceec506.content:
---@id df6ee627-cd27-4f76-be4a-16371ceec506
---@referenceName pi-seat.lua
-- 花纹圆桶凳的靠近坐下、起身与坐姿对齐逻辑
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@var enterSeatText:string="坐下"
---@name 坐下文案
---@desc 座位空闲时交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@var exitSeatText:string="起身"
---@name 起身文案
---@desc 本地玩家坐下后交互按钮显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local seatAnchorPath = "model/SeatAnchor"
local standUpAnchorPath = "model/StandUpAnchor"
local seatTrans = nil
local standUpTrans = nil
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local hasPassenger = false
local currentPlayer = nil
local JoyStickControlMain = nil
local savedBoardOffset = nil
local savedBoardRotation = nil
local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local ownershipPending = false

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

function resolveSeatTrans()
  return seatTrans
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = enabled
  end
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or target == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local orig = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local p = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(orig.x / p.x, orig.y / p.y, orig.z / p.z)

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end
  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPos = hips.position
  local transPos = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    transPos.x - (hipsPos.x - transPos.x),
    transPos.y - (hipsPos.y - transPos.y),
    transPos.z - (hipsPos.z - transPos.z)
  )
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  actor.gameObject.transform:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    actor.gameObject.transform.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  if standUpTrans ~= nil then
    actor.position = standUpTrans.position
    actor.rotation = standUpTrans.rotation
  elseif savedBoardOffset ~= nil then
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + savedBoardOffset.x,
      self.transform.position.y + savedBoardOffset.y,
      self.transform.position.z + savedBoardOffset.z
    )
    actor.rotation = savedBoardRotation
    savedBoardOffset = nil
    savedBoardRotation = nil
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      self.transform.position.x + right.x,
      self.transform.position.y,
      self.transform.position.z + right.z
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end
end

function Start()
  seatTrans = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:FindTransform(seatAnchorPath) or nil
  standUpTrans = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:FindTransform(standUpAnchorPath) or nil

  JoyStickControlMain = CS.DouyinUIService.GetJoyStickControl(CS.UIType.MoveJoyStick)
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OnUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
  end
end

function OnDisable()
  if JoyStickControlMain ~= nil then
    JoyStickControlMain:OffUIDrag(OnUIDragMainMoveUI)
  end
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
  localActor = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  if hasPassenger then
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  else
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if hasPassenger then
      localActor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
    else
      if seatTrans == nil then
        return
      end
      localActor:SitDown(self.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasPassenger = false
      setButtonText(enterSeatText)
    end
    return
  end

  if actor.isLocal then
    local actorPos = actor.gameObject.transform.position
    local selfPos = self.transform.position
    savedBoardOffset = UnityEngine.Vector3(actorPos.x - selfPos.x, actorPos.y - selfPos.y, actorPos.z - selfPos.z)
    savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    currentPlayer = actor
    hasPassenger = true
    setButtonText(exitSeatText)
  end

  savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    currentPlayer = nil
    hasPassenger = false
    setButtonText(enterSeatText)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(eventData)
  local actor = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if actor == nil or currentPlayer ~= actor then return end
  actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
end

eed830a9-eed3-4a62-849e-ac41a4b19c92.content:
---@id eed830a9-eed3-4a62-849e-ac41a4b19c92
---@referenceName pi-flag-raise.lua
-- 靠近升旗台后通过交互按钮升起或降下旗帜。
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@var RaiseButtonText:string="升旗"
---@name 升旗按钮文案
---@desc 旗帜在底部时显示的按钮文字
---@group 交互
---@var LowerButtonText:string="下降"
---@name 下降按钮文案
---@desc 旗帜在顶部时显示的按钮文字
---@group 交互
---@var MoveDuration:number=3
---@name 升降耗时
---@desc 旗帜从一端移动到另一端的秒数
---@group 动画
---@var TravelHeight:number=2.04
---@name 升降高度
---@desc 旗帜从旗杆底部到顶部的垂直距离
---@group 动画
---@varSync FlagAtTop:boolean=false
---@varSync FlagMoveSerial:int=0
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local flagCarriage = nil
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local netReady = false
local isAtTop = false
local isMoving = false
local moveElapsed = 0
local moveStartY = 0
local moveTargetY = 0
local lowerY = 0
local upperY = 0

local function clamp01(value)
  if value < 0 then return 0 end
  if value > 1 then return 1 end
  return value
end

local function smoothStep(t)
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then
    return
  end

  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
  if isAtTop then
    setButtonText(LowerButtonText)
  else
    setButtonText(RaiseButtonText)
  end
end

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then
    return
  end

  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    return
  end

  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end

  if ownershipPending then
    return
  end
  ownershipPending = true

  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function applyFlagPosition(atTop)
  if flagCarriage == nil then
    return
  end

  local pos = flagCarriage.localPosition
  local y = lowerY
  if atTop then
    y = upperY
  end
  flagCarriage.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(pos.x, y, pos.z)
  isAtTop = atTop
  isMoving = false
  refreshButtonText()
end

local function startFlagMove(targetAtTop)
  if flagCarriage == nil or isMoving then
    return
  end

  local pos = flagCarriage.localPosition
  moveStartY = pos.y
  if targetAtTop then
    moveTargetY = upperY
  else
    moveTargetY = lowerY
  end
  moveElapsed = 0
  isMoving = true
end

local function syncFlagMove()
  if FlagAtTop == nil then
    startFlagMove(not isAtTop)
    return
  end
  startFlagMove(FlagAtTop:GetValue())
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    return
  end

  flagCarriage = runtimeScope:FindTransform("ModuleRoot/FlagCarriage")
  if flagCarriage == nil then
    return
  end

  lowerY = flagCarriage.localPosition.y
  upperY = lowerY + TravelHeight
end

function OnNetSpawned()
  netReady = true

  FlagAtTop:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    isAtTop = curVal == true
    refreshButtonText()
  end)

  FlagMoveSerial:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    syncFlagMove()
  end)

  applyFlagPosition(FlagAtTop:GetValue() == true)
end

function Update()
  if not isMoving or flagCarriage == nil then
    return
  end

  local duration = MoveDuration
  if duration <= 0.01 then
    duration = 0.01
  end

  moveElapsed = moveElapsed + Time.deltaTime
  local t = clamp01(moveElapsed / duration)
  local eased = smoothStep(t)
  local y = moveStartY + (moveTargetY - moveStartY) * eased
  local pos = flagCarriage.localPosition
  flagCarriage.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(pos.x, y, pos.z)

  if t >= 1 then
    isMoving = false
    isAtTop = moveTargetY >= upperY - 0.001
    refreshButtonText()
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then
    return
  end

  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  refreshButtonText()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then
    return
  end

  ensureOwnership(function()
    if netReady and FlagAtTop ~= nil and FlagMoveSerial ~= nil then
      FlagAtTop:SetValue(not FlagAtTop:GetValue())
      FlagMoveSerial:SetValue(FlagMoveSerial:GetValue() + 1)
    else
      startFlagMove(not isAtTop)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function OnOwnershipTransferred()
  refreshButtonText()
end

function OnDisable()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
  localActor = nil
  isMoving = false
end

function OnDestroy()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
  end
  interactionButton = nil
  localActor = nil
  isMoving = false
end

---@name 购买成功前缀
---@group 反馈
---@var purchaseCanceledToastText:string="已取消购买。"
---@name 取消购买提示
---@group 反馈
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local DouyinUtility = CS.DouyinUtility
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local logger = Logger.create("pi-product")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local gripAnchorPath = "model/GripAnchor"
local pickupHand = CS.HandType.Right
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local purchased = false
local gripPoint = nil
local rigidbody = nil
local isKinematic = false
local bodyColliders = {}
local currentPlayer = nil
local prevParent = nil
-- Added: five-minute reset and physical drop-to-ground state.
local resetDelaySeconds = 300
local resetRemaining = nil
local initialParent = nil
local initialPosition = nil
local initialRotation = nil
local initialUseGravity = true
local function ensureOwnership(action) if action == nil then return end; if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then logger:warnOnce("network-not-settled", "network is not settled"); return end; if self:HasOwnership() then action(); return end; if ownershipPending then return end; ownershipPending = true; self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed) ownershipPending = false; if bSucceed then action() end end) end
local function ShowToast(message) if message ~= nil and message ~= "" then DouyinUtility.Toast(tostring(message)) end end
local function ShowConfirmAlert(title, message, confirmText, cancelText, onConfirm, onCancel) DouyinUtility.Alert(title, message, confirmText, function() if onConfirm ~= nil then onConfirm() end end, cancelText, function() if onCancel ~= nil then onCancel() end end) end
local function collectBodyColliders() local result = {}; local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider)); if colliders ~= nil then for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do local col = colliders[i]; if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then result[#result + 1] = col end end end; return result end
local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled) for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do if col ~= nil then col.enabled = enabled end end end
local function disablePhysical() if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = true end; setBodyCollidersEnabled(false) end
local function enablePhysical() if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic end; setBodyCollidersEnabled(true) end
local function enableDropToGround()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = false
    rigidbody.useGravity = true
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
end
local function resetProduct()
  resetRemaining = nil
  if currentPlayer ~= nil then pcall(function() currentPlayer:Drop(self.gameObject) end) end
  currentPlayer = nil
  prevParent = nil
  self.transform:SetParent(initialParent)
  if initialPosition ~= nil then self.transform.position = initialPosition end
  if initialRotation ~= nil then self.transform.rotation = initialRotation end
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.useGravity = initialUseGravity
    rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
  purchased = false
  refreshButtonText()
end
local function isHeldByLocal() return currentPlayer ~= nil and currentPlayer.isLocal end
local function setButtonText(text) if interactionButton == nil then return end; local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text)); if label ~= nil then label.text = text end end
local function refreshButtonText() if not purchased then setButtonText(browseText) elseif isHeldByLocal() then setButtonText(dropText) else setButtonText(pickupText) end end
local function updateTransform(handType, pickupMatrix) if currentPlayer == nil then return end; local palmPosition, palmRotation = currentPlayer:CalculatePalmTransform(handType == CS.HandType.Left); local finalMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(palmPosition, palmRotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one) * pickupMatrix; self.transform.position = finalMatrix:GetPosition(); self.transform.rotation = finalMatrix.rotation end
local function computeGripMatrix() if gripPoint == nil then return UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity end; local selfMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(self.transform.position, self.transform.rotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one); local gripMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(gripPoint.position, gripPoint.rotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one); return selfMat.inverse * gripMat end
local function tryPickupOrDrop(actor) if actor == nil then return end; if isHeldByLocal() then actor:Drop(self.gameObject) elseif purchased then disablePhysical(); actor:Pickup(self.gameObject, pickupHand, computeGripMatrix()) end end
local function showPurchaseFlow(actor) local purchaseActor = actor; local message = "商品：" .. productName .. "\n介绍：" .. productDescription .. "\n标价：" .. productPrice .. "\n\n确认购买后会立即拾取。"; ShowConfirmAlert(browseAlertTitle, message, confirmButtonText, cancelButtonText, function() ensureOwnership(function() purchased = true; resetRemaining = resetDelaySeconds; ShowToast(purchaseSuccessPrefix .. productName); refreshButtonText(); tryPickupOrDrop(purchaseActor) end) end, function() ShowToast(purchaseCanceledToastText) end) end
local function clearInteractionButton() if interactionButton ~= nil then self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton) end; interactionButton = nil end
function Start() if runtimeScope ~= nil then local lookupReason = nil; gripPoint, lookupReason = runtimeScope:FindTransform(gripAnchorPath); if gripPoint == nil then logger:warnOnce("grip-point-missing", "GripPoint missing", lookupReason) end else logger:warnOnce("scope-unavailable", "RuntimeScope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason) end; rigidbody = self.transform:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody)); if rigidbody ~= nil then isKinematic = rigidbody.isKinematic end; bodyColliders = collectBodyColliders(); initialParent = self.transform.parent; initialPosition = self.transform.position; initialRotation = self.transform.rotation; if rigidbody ~= nil then initialUseGravity = rigidbody.useGravity end end
function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor) if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end; localActor = actor; self:EnableInteraction() end
function OnActorTriggerExit(actor) if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end; localActor = nil; self:DisableInteraction() end
function OnFocus(handType) interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton(); refreshButtonText() end
function OnInteractorButtonClick(index) if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then return end; ensureOwnership(function() if purchased then tryPickupOrDrop(localActor) else showPurchaseFlow(localActor) end end) end
function OnLostFocus(handType) clearInteractionButton() end
function OnPickup(actor, handType, pickUpPoint) if actor == nil then return end; local resolvedHandType = handType or pickupHand; disablePhysical(); currentPlayer = actor; local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator)); if animator ~= nil then local bone = nil; if resolvedHandType == CS.HandType.Left then bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.LeftHand) else bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.RightHand) end; if bone ~= nil then prevParent = self.transform.parent; self.transform:SetParent(bone) end end; local pickupMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity; if pickUpPoint ~= nil then pickupMatrix = pickUpPoint.inverse end; updateTransform(resolvedHandType, pickupMatrix); if actor.isLocal then refreshButtonText() end end
function OnDrop(actor, handType) if actor == nil or actor ~= currentPlayer then return end; self.transform:SetParent(prevParent); prevParent = nil; enableDropToGround(); currentPlayer = nil; if actor.isLocal then refreshButtonText() end end

function Update()
  if resetRemaining == nil then return end
  resetRemaining = resetRemaining - UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
  if resetRemaining <= 0 then ensureOwnership(resetProduct) end
end
function OnDisable() clearInteractionButton(); localActor = nil end

---@var purchaseCanceledToastText:string="已取消购买。"
---@name 取消购买提示

---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local DouyinUtility = CS.DouyinUtility
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-product")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local gripAnchorPath = "model/GripAnchor"
local pickupHand = CS.HandType.Right
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local purchased = false
local gripPoint = nil
local rigidbody = nil
local isKinematic = false
local bodyColliders = {}
local currentPlayer = nil
local prevParent = nil
-- Added: five-minute reset and physical drop-to-ground state.
local resetDelaySeconds = 300
local resetRemaining = nil
local initialParent = nil
local initialPosition = nil
local initialRotation = nil
local initialUseGravity = true

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then return end
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then
    logger:warnOnce("network-not-settled", "network is not settled")
    return
  end
  if self:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end
  if ownershipPending then return end
  ownershipPending = true
  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then action() end
  end)
end

local function ShowToast(message)
  if message == nil or message == "" then return end
  DouyinUtility.Toast(tostring(message))
end

local function ShowConfirmAlert(title, message, confirmText, cancelText, onConfirm, onCancel)
  DouyinUtility.Alert(
    title,
    message,
    confirmText,
    function()
      if onConfirm ~= nil then onConfirm() end
    end,
    cancelText,
    function()
      if onCancel ~= nil then onCancel() end
    end
  )
end

local function collectBodyColliders()
  local result = {}
  local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if colliders ~= nil then
    for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
      local col = colliders[i]
      if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then
        result[#result + 1] = col
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled)
  for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local DouyinUtility = CS.DouyinUtility
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local logger = Logger.create("pi-product")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local gripAnchorPath = "model/GripAnchor"
local pickupHand = CS.HandType.Right
local localActor = nil
local interactionButton = nil
local ownershipPending = false
local purchased = false
local gripPoint = nil
local rigidbody = nil
local isKinematic = false
local bodyColliders = {}
local currentPlayer = nil
local prevParent = nil
-- Added: five-minute reset and physical drop-to-ground state.
local resetDelaySeconds = 300
local resetRemaining = nil
local initialParent = nil
local initialPosition = nil
local initialRotation = nil
local initialUseGravity = true

local function ensureOwnership(action)
  if action == nil then return end
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then logger:warnOnce("network-not-settled", "network is not settled"); return end
  if self:HasOwnership() then action(); return end
  if ownershipPending then return end
  ownershipPending = true
  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed) ownershipPending = false; if bSucceed then action() end end)
end

local function ShowToast(message) if message ~= nil and message ~= "" then DouyinUtility.Toast(tostring(message)) end end

local function ShowConfirmAlert(title, message, confirmText, cancelText, onConfirm, onCancel)
  DouyinUtility.Alert(title, message, confirmText, function() if onConfirm ~= nil then onConfirm() end end, cancelText, function() if onCancel ~= nil then onCancel() end end)
end

local function collectBodyColliders()
  local result = {}
  local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if colliders ~= nil then
    for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
      local col = colliders[i]
      if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then result[#result + 1] = col end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled) for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do if col ~= nil then col.enabled = enabled end end end
local function disablePhysical() if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = true end; setBodyCollidersEnabled(false) end
local function enablePhysical() if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic end; setBodyCollidersEnabled(true) end
local function enableDropToGround()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = false
    rigidbody.useGravity = true
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
end

  resetRemaining = nil
  if currentPlayer ~= nil then pcall(function() currentPlayer:Drop(self.gameObject) end) end
  currentPlayer = nil
  prevParent = nil
  self.transform:SetParent(initialParent)
  if initialPosition ~= nil then self.transform.position = initialPosition end
  if initialRotation ~= nil then self.transform.rotation = initialRotation end
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.useGravity = initialUseGravity
    rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic
  end

  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then label.text = text end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
  if not purchased then setButtonText(browseText) elseif isHeldByLocal() then setButtonText(dropText) else setButtonText(pickupText) end
end

local function updateTransform(handType, pickupMatrix)
  if currentPlayer == nil then return end
  local palmPosition, palmRotation = currentPlayer:CalculatePalmTransform(handType == CS.HandType.Left)
  local finalMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(palmPosition, palmRotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one) * pickupMatrix
  self.transform.position = finalMatrix:GetPosition()
  self.transform.rotation = finalMatrix.rotation
end

local function computeGripMatrix()
  if gripPoint == nil then return UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity end

  local gripMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(gripPoint.position, gripPoint.rotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one)

end
