  if actor == nil then return end
  if isHeldByLocal() then actor:Drop(self.gameObject) elseif purchased then disablePhysical(); actor:Pickup(self.gameObject, pickupHand, computeGripMatrix()) end
end

  end, function() ShowToast(purchaseCanceledToastText) end)
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    local lookupReason = nil

  else

  if rigidbody ~= nil then isKinematic = rigidbody.isKinematic end

  ownershipPending = true
  self:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then action() end
  end)
end

local function ShowToast(message)
  if message == nil or message == "" then return end
  DouyinUtility.Toast(tostring(message))
end

local function ShowConfirmAlert(title, message, confirmText, cancelText, onConfirm, onCancel)
  DouyinUtility.Alert(
    title,
    message,
    confirmText,
    function()
      if onConfirm ~= nil then onConfirm() end
    end,
    cancelText,
    function()
      if onCancel ~= nil then onCancel() end
    end
  )
end

local function collectBodyColliders()
  local result = {}
  local colliders = self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if colliders ~= nil then
    for i = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
      local col = colliders[i]
      if col ~= nil and not col.isTrigger then
        result[#result + 1] = col
      end
    end
  end
  return result
end

local function setBodyCollidersEnabled(enabled)
  for _, col in ipairs(bodyColliders) do
    if col ~= nil then col.enabled = enabled end
  end
end

local function disablePhysical()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = true end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(false)
end

local function enablePhysical() if rigidbody ~= nil then rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic end; setBodyCollidersEnabled(true) end
local function enableDropToGround()
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.isKinematic = false
    rigidbody.useGravity = true
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
end
local function resetProduct()
  resetRemaining = nil
  if currentPlayer ~= nil then pcall(function() currentPlayer:Drop(self.gameObject) end) end
  currentPlayer = nil
  prevParent = nil
  self.transform:SetParent(initialParent)
  if initialPosition ~= nil then self.transform.position = initialPosition end
  if initialRotation ~= nil then self.transform.rotation = initialRotation end
  if rigidbody ~= nil then
    rigidbody.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.angularVelocity = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
    rigidbody.useGravity = initialUseGravity
    rigidbody.isKinematic = isKinematic
  end
  setBodyCollidersEnabled(true)
  purchased = false
  refreshButtonText()
end

local function isHeldByLocal()
  return currentPlayer ~= nil and currentPlayer.isLocal
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then label.text = text end
end

local function refreshButtonText()
  if not purchased then
    setButtonText(browseText)
  elseif isHeldByLocal() then
    setButtonText(dropText)
  else
    setButtonText(pickupText)
  end
end

local function updateTransform(handType, pickupMatrix)
  if currentPlayer == nil then return end
  local isLeft = handType == CS.HandType.Left
  local palmPosition, palmRotation = currentPlayer:CalculatePalmTransform(isLeft)
  local palmWorldMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(palmPosition, palmRotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one)
  local finalMatrix = palmWorldMatrix * pickupMatrix
  self.transform.position = finalMatrix:GetPosition()
  self.transform.rotation = finalMatrix.rotation
end

local function computeGripMatrix()
  if gripPoint == nil then return UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity end
  local selfMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(self.transform.position, self.transform.rotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one)
  local gripMat = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.TRS(gripPoint.position, gripPoint.rotation, UnityEngine.Vector3.one)
  return selfMat.inverse * gripMat
end

local function tryPickupOrDrop(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  if isHeldByLocal() then
    actor:Drop(self.gameObject)
  elseif purchased then
    disablePhysical()
    actor:Pickup(self.gameObject, pickupHand, computeGripMatrix())
  end
end

local function buildProductMessage()
  return "商品：" .. productName .. "\n介绍：" .. productDescription .. "\n标价：" .. productPrice .. "\n\n确认购买后会立即拾取。"
end

local function showPurchaseFlow(actor)
  local purchaseActor = actor
  ShowConfirmAlert(
    browseAlertTitle,
    buildProductMessage(),
    confirmButtonText,
    cancelButtonText,
    function()
      ensureOwnership(function()
        purchased = true; resetRemaining = resetDelaySeconds; ShowToast(purchaseSuccessPrefix .. productName)
        refreshButtonText()
        tryPickupOrDrop(purchaseActor)
      end)
    end,
    function()
      ShowToast(purchaseCanceledToastText)
    end
  )
end

local function clearInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton) end
  interactionButton = nil
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    local lookupReason = nil
    gripPoint, lookupReason = runtimeScope:FindTransform(gripAnchorPath)
    if gripPoint == nil then
      logger:warnOnce("grip-point-missing", "GripPoint missing", lookupReason)
    end
  else
    logger:warnOnce("scope-unavailable", "RuntimeScope unavailable", runtimeScopeReason)
  end
  rigidbody = self.transform:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  if rigidbody ~= nil then isKinematic = rigidbody.isKinematic end
  bodyColliders = collectBodyColliders(); initialParent = self.transform.parent; initialPosition = self.transform.position; initialRotation = self.transform.rotation; if rigidbody ~= nil then initialUseGravity = rigidbody.useGravity end end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActor = actor
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActor = nil
  self:DisableInteraction()
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  refreshButtonText()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActor == nil then return end
  ensureOwnership(function()
    if purchased then
      tryPickupOrDrop(localActor)
    else
      showPurchaseFlow(localActor)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  clearInteractionButton()
end

function OnPickup(actor, handType, pickUpPoint)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local resolvedHandType = handType or pickupHand
  disablePhysical()
  currentPlayer = actor
  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator ~= nil then
    local bone = nil
    if resolvedHandType == CS.HandType.Left then
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.LeftHand)
    else
      bone = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.RightHand)
    end
    if bone ~= nil then
      prevParent = self.transform.parent
      self.transform:SetParent(bone)
    end
  end
  local pickupMatrix = UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity
  if pickUpPoint ~= nil then pickupMatrix = pickUpPoint.inverse end
  updateTransform(resolvedHandType, pickupMatrix)
  if actor.isLocal then refreshButtonText() end
end

function OnDrop(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor ~= currentPlayer then return end
  self.transform:SetParent(prevParent); prevParent = nil; enableDropToGround(); currentPlayer = nil
  if actor.isLocal then refreshButtonText() end
end


function Update()
  if resetRemaining == nil then return end
  resetRemaining = resetRemaining - UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
  if resetRemaining <= 0 then ensureOwnership(resetProduct) end
end
function OnDisable()
  clearInteractionButton()
  localActor = nil
end

---@id d450102a-eff3-4b1c-ab81-0dd48fb9e443
---@referenceName ms-rainbow-dynamics.lua
-- 控制彩虹拱门的自动呼吸、波动和星光闪耀效果
---@start
---@var FlowSpeed:number=1.0
---@name 流动速度
---@desc 彩虹带波动与光晕呼吸的循环速度
---@group 彩虹动态
---@var GlowAmount:number=0.055
---@name 呼吸强度
---@desc 彩虹带和光晕缩放起伏的幅度
---@group 彩虹动态
---@var BobAmplitude:number=0.018
---@name 漂浮幅度
---@desc 彩虹带上下轻微漂浮的高度，单位米
---@group 彩虹动态
---@var SparkleSpinSpeed:number=86
---@name 星光旋转速度
---@desc 星形闪光每秒旋转角度
---@group 星光动态
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local elapsed = 0
local ready = false

local bands = {
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandRed", phase = 0.00 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandOrange", phase = 0.45 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandYellow", phase = 0.90 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandGreen", phase = 1.35 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandCyan", phase = 1.80 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandBlue", phase = 2.25 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/RainbowBands/BandViolet", phase = 2.70 },
}

local pulseNodes = {
  { path = "ModuleRoot/RainbowArch/GlowHaloPulse", phase = 0.15, amount = 1.35 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Clouds/LeftCloudPulse", phase = 0.70, amount = 0.48 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Clouds/RightCloudPulse", phase = 1.25, amount = 0.48 },
}

local sparkles = {
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleA", phase = 0.10, spin = 1 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleB", phase = 0.90, spin = -1 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleC", phase = 1.70, spin = 1 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleD", phase = 2.35, spin = -1 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleE", phase = 3.10, spin = 1 },
  { path = "ModuleRoot/Sparkles/SparkleF", phase = 3.80, spin = -1 },
}

local function cacheTransform(entry)
  if runtimeScope == nil or entry == nil or entry.path == nil then return false end
  local transform = runtimeScope:FindTransform(entry.path)
  if transform == nil then return false end

  local pos = transform.localPosition
  local scale = transform.localScale
  local euler = transform.localEulerAngles
  entry.transform = transform
  entry.px = pos.x
  entry.py = pos.y
  entry.pz = pos.z
  entry.sx = scale.x
  entry.sy = scale.y
  entry.sz = scale.z
  entry.rx = euler.x
  entry.ry = euler.y
  entry.rz = euler.z
  return true
end

local function cacheList(list)
  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
    if cacheTransform(entry) then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end

local function setScale(entry, scalarX, scalarY, scalarZ)
  if entry.transform == nil then return end
  entry.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(entry.sx * scalarX, entry.sy * scalarY, entry.sz * scalarZ)
end

local function updateRainbowBands(timeValue)
  for _, band in ipairs(bands) do
    if band.transform ~= nil then
      local wave = math.sin(timeValue * 2.0 + band.phase)
      local slowWave = math.sin(timeValue * 1.15 + band.phase * 0.55)
      local scale = 1 + GlowAmount * 0.42 * wave
      band.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(band.px, band.py + BobAmplitude * slowWave, band.pz)
      setScale(band, scale, 1 + GlowAmount * 0.24 * wave, scale)
    end
  end
end

local function updatePulseNodes(timeValue)
  for _, node in ipairs(pulseNodes) do
    if node.transform ~= nil then
      local wave = math.sin(timeValue * 1.55 + node.phase)
      local amount = GlowAmount * node.amount
      setScale(node, 1 + amount * wave, 1 + amount * 0.55 * wave, 1 + amount * wave)
    end
  end
end

local function updateSparkles(timeValue)
  for _, sparkle in ipairs(sparkles) do
    if sparkle.transform ~= nil then
      local pulse = 1 + GlowAmount * 2.2 * math.sin(timeValue * 3.2 + sparkle.phase)
      local bob = BobAmplitude * 1.9 * math.sin(timeValue * 2.25 + sparkle.phase)
      sparkle.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(sparkle.px, sparkle.py + bob, sparkle.pz)
      sparkle.transform.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(sparkle.rx, sparkle.ry, sparkle.rz + elapsed * SparkleSpinSpeed * sparkle.spin)
      setScale(sparkle, pulse, pulse, pulse)
    end
  end
end

local function restoreList(list)
  for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
    if entry.transform ~= nil then
      entry.transform.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(entry.px, entry.py, entry.pz)
      entry.transform.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(entry.rx, entry.ry, entry.rz)
      entry.transform.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(entry.sx, entry.sy, entry.sz)
    end
  end
end

local function restoreInitialTransforms()
  restoreList(bands)
  restoreList(pulseNodes)
  restoreList(sparkles)
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil then
    ready = false
    return
  end

  local cached = 0
  cached = cached + cacheList(bands)
  cached = cached + cacheList(pulseNodes)
  cached = cached + cacheList(sparkles)
  ready = cached > 0
end

function Update()
  if not ready then return end
  elapsed = elapsed + Time.deltaTime
  local timeValue = elapsed * FlowSpeed
  updateRainbowBands(timeValue)
  updatePulseNodes(timeValue)
  updateSparkles(timeValue)
end

function OnDisable()
  if ready then
    restoreInitialTransforms()
  end
end

function OnDestroy()
  if ready then
    restoreInitialTransforms()
  end
end

b767d6fe-9ea3-4f4b-8b8c-e6ec5d83a327.content:
---@id b767d6fe-9ea3-4f4b-8b8c-e6ec5d83a327
---@referenceName ms-seesaw-controller.lua
-- 根据六个座位的同步占用状态平滑倾斜跷跷板踏板
---@start
---@var MaxTiltAngle:number=18
---@name 最大倾斜角
---@desc 两端人数差较大时跷跷板达到的最大角度
---@range 0,30,1
---@group 倾斜
---@var TiltPerPerson:number=7
---@name 每人倾斜角
---@desc 两端人数每相差一人增加的目标倾斜角
---@range 0,15,0.5
---@group 倾斜
---@var TiltSmoothSpeed:number=5
---@name 倾斜平滑速度
---@desc 数值越大，跷跷板越快接近目标角度
---@range 0.5,12,0.1
---@group 倾斜
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)

local plankPivotPath = "ModuleRoot/PlankPivot"
local plankPivot = nil
local currentAngle = 0
local seatStates = {}

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
  if value < minValue then return minValue end
  if value > maxValue then return maxValue end
  return value
end

local function countSide(sideSign)
  local count = 0
  for _, state in pairs(seatStates) do
    if state.occupied and state.sideSign == sideSign then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope ~= nil then
    plankPivot = runtimeScope:FindTransform(plankPivotPath)
  end
  if plankPivot == nil and self.transform ~= nil then
    plankPivot = self.transform:Find(plankPivotPath)
  end
end

function SetSeatState(seatId, sideSign, occupied)
  if seatId == nil or sideSign == nil then
    return false
  end

  seatStates[tostring(seatId)] = {
    sideSign = sideSign,
    occupied = occupied == true
  }
  return true
end

function Update()
  if plankPivot == nil then
    return
  end

  local leftCount = countSide(-1)
  local rightCount = countSide(1)
  -- 竖向排列时左端位于 -Z，右端位于 +Z；绕 X 轴旋转：左多取负角让左端下沉，右多取正角让右端下沉。
  local targetAngle = clamp((rightCount - leftCount) * TiltPerPerson, -MaxTiltAngle, MaxTiltAngle)
  local t = clamp(Time.deltaTime * TiltSmoothSpeed, 0, 1)
  currentAngle = currentAngle + (targetAngle - currentAngle) * t
  if math.abs(currentAngle - targetAngle) < 0.02 then
    currentAngle = targetAngle
  end

  plankPivot.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(currentAngle, 0, 0)
end

---@desc 该座位被其他玩家占用时显示的文字
---@group 交互
---@var SeatKey:string="left-02"
---@name 座位编号
---@desc 用于向跷跷板控制器上报占用状态的稳定编号
---@group 座位
---@var SideSign:int=-1
---@name 所属端
---@desc -1 表示左端，1 表示右端
---@enum -1=左端,1=右端
---@group 座位
---@var StandUpPath:string="ModuleRoot/PlankPivot/LeftSeat02/StandUpAnchor"
---@name 离座点路径
---@desc 玩家起身后优先放置到这个节点位置
---@group 座位
---@varSync seatTaken:boolean=false
---@end

local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)
local commonSeat = nil
local configured = false
local function common()
  if commonSeat == nil and runtimeScope ~= nil then commonSeat = runtimeScope:GetScript("pi-seat-common.lua") end
  if not configured and commonSeat ~= nil and type(commonSeat.ConfigureSeat) == "function" then configured = commonSeat.ConfigureSeat(self, runtimeScope, { seatKey = SeatKey, sideSign = SideSign, standUpPath = StandUpPath, enterSeatText = enterSeatText, exitSeatText = exitSeatText, occupiedSeatText = occupiedSeatText, seatTaken = seatTaken }) end
  return commonSeat
end
function Start() common() end
function OnDisable() local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnDisableSeat) == "function" then c.OnDisableSeat(SeatKey) end end
function OnDestroy() OnDisable() end
function OnNetSpawned() local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnNetSpawnedSeat) == "function" then c.OnNetSpawnedSeat(SeatKey) end end
function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnActorTriggerEnterSeat) == "function" then c.OnActorTriggerEnterSeat(SeatKey, actor) end end
function OnActorTriggerExit(actor) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnActorTriggerExitSeat) == "function" then c.OnActorTriggerExitSeat(SeatKey, actor) end end
function OnFocus(handType) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnFocusSeat) == "function" then c.OnFocusSeat(SeatKey, handType) end end
function OnInteractorButtonClick(index) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnInteractorButtonClickSeat) == "function" then c.OnInteractorButtonClickSeat(SeatKey, index) end end
function OnLostFocus(handType) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnLostFocusSeat) == "function" then c.OnLostFocusSeat(SeatKey, handType) end end
function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnSeatEnteredSeat) == "function" then c.OnSeatEnteredSeat(SeatKey, actor, handType) end end
function OnSeatExited(actor) local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.OnSeatExitedSeat) == "function" then c.OnSeatExitedSeat(SeatKey, actor) end end
function LateUpdate() local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.LateUpdateSeat) == "function" then c.LateUpdateSeat(SeatKey) end end
function Update() local c = common(); if c ~= nil and type(c.UpdateSeat) == "function" then c.UpdateSeat(SeatKey) end end

8d1dcfc5-b953-4e9e-9912-fae79a95aa2e.content:
---@id 8d1dcfc5-b953-4e9e-9912-fae79a95aa2e
---@referenceName pi-seat-common.lua
-- 复用的跷跷板座位逻辑，供六个 SeatAnchor 脚本按座位编号调用

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local seatStates = {}

local function getState(seatKey)
  if seatKey == nil then return nil end
  local key = tostring(seatKey)
  if seatStates[key] == nil then
    seatStates[key] = {
      seatKey = key,
      localActor = nil,
      interactionButton = nil,
      ownershipPending = false,
      netReady = false,
      pendingSeatValue = nil,
      syncTaken = false,
      pendingNotify = true,
      seatTrans = nil,
      standUpTrans = nil,
      savedBoardOffset = nil,
      savedBoardRotation = nil,
      currentPlayer = nil,
      joyStick = nil,
      onJoyStickDrag = nil,
      triggerCollider = nil,
      triggerSize = nil,
      triggerCenter = nil,
      seatedActors = {},
      savedScale = {}
    }
  end
  return seatStates[key]
end

local function ensureOwnership(state, action)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or action == nil then return end
  if not DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled then return end
  if state.host:HasOwnership() then
    action()
    return
  end
  if state.ownershipPending then return end
  state.ownershipPending = true
  state.host:RequestOwnership(function(bSucceed)
    state.ownershipPending = false
    if bSucceed then
      action()
    end
  end)
end

local function setButtonText(state, text)
  if state == nil or state.interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = state.interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.UI.Text))
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function refreshButtonText(state)
  if state == nil then return end
  if state.currentPlayer ~= nil then
    setButtonText(state, state.exitSeatText)
  elseif state.syncTaken then
    setButtonText(state, state.occupiedSeatText)
  else
    setButtonText(state, state.enterSeatText)
  end
end

local function notifyController(state)
  if state == nil or state.runtimeScope == nil then return false end
  local controller = state.runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-seesaw-controller.lua")
  if controller ~= nil and type(controller.SetSeatState) == "function" then
    return controller.SetSeatState(state.seatKey, state.sideSign, state.syncTaken)
  end
  return false
end

local function flushSeatValue(state)
  if state == nil or state.pendingSeatValue == nil or not state.netReady or state.seatTaken == nil then return end
  local value = state.pendingSeatValue
  ensureOwnership(state, function()
    state.seatTaken:SetValue(value)
    if state.pendingSeatValue == value then
      state.pendingSeatValue = nil
    end
  end)
end

local function queueSeatValue(state, value)
  if state == nil then return end
  state.pendingSeatValue = value
  flushSeatValue(state)
end

local function cacheSeatTrigger(state)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or state.host.gameObject == nil then return end
  if state.triggerCollider ~= nil then return end
  local collider = state.host.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.BoxCollider))
  if collider == nil or not collider.isTrigger then return end
  state.triggerCollider = collider
  local size = collider.size
  state.triggerSize = UnityEngine.Vector3(size.x, size.y, size.z)
  local center = collider.center
  state.triggerCenter = UnityEngine.Vector3(center.x, center.y, center.z)
end

local function setSeatTriggerEnabled(state, enabled)
  cacheSeatTrigger(state)
  if state == nil or state.triggerCollider == nil then return end
  state.triggerCollider.enabled = enabled == true
end

local function restoreSeatTrigger(state)
  cacheSeatTrigger(state)
  if state == nil or state.triggerCollider == nil then return end
  if state.triggerSize ~= nil then
    state.triggerCollider.size = UnityEngine.Vector3(state.triggerSize.x, state.triggerSize.y, state.triggerSize.z)
  end
  if state.triggerCenter ~= nil then
    state.triggerCollider.center = UnityEngine.Vector3(state.triggerCenter.x, state.triggerCenter.y, state.triggerCenter.z)
  end
  state.triggerCollider.enabled = true
end

local function disableSeatInteraction(state)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil then return end
  if state.interactionButton ~= nil then
    state.host:RemoveInteractorButton(state.interactionButton)
  end
  state.interactionButton = nil
  state.localActor = nil
  state.host:DisableInteraction()
end

local function ensureLeaveSeatButton(state)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or state.currentPlayer == nil then return end
  state.localActor = state.currentPlayer
  state.host:EnableInteraction()
  if state.interactionButton == nil then
    state.interactionButton = state.host:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(state, state.exitSeatText)
end

local function resolveSeatTrans(state)
  return state ~= nil and state.seatTrans or nil
end

local function safeDiv(a, b)
  if b == nil or math.abs(b) < 0.0001 then return a end
  return a / b
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(state, actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans(state)
  if state == nil or actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end
  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local orig = state.savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local p = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(safeDiv(orig.x, p.x), safeDiv(orig.y, p.y), safeDiv(orig.z, p.z))

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end
  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end
  local hipsPos = hips.position
  local transPos = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    transPos.x - (hipsPos.x - transPos.x),
    transPos.y - (hipsPos.y - transPos.y),
    transPos.z - (hipsPos.z - transPos.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider ~= nil then
    collider.enabled = enabled
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(state, actor)
  if state == nil or actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  actor.gameObject.transform:SetParent(nil)
  if state.savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    actor.gameObject.transform.localScale = state.savedScale[actor]
    state.savedScale[actor] = nil
  end
  if state.standUpTrans ~= nil then
    actor.position = state.standUpTrans.position
    actor.rotation = state.standUpTrans.rotation
  elseif state.savedBoardOffset ~= nil and state.host ~= nil then
    local basePos = state.host.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(basePos.x + state.savedBoardOffset.x, basePos.y + state.savedBoardOffset.y, basePos.z + state.savedBoardOffset.z)
    actor.rotation = state.savedBoardRotation
    state.savedBoardOffset = nil
    state.savedBoardRotation = nil
  elseif state.host ~= nil then
    local right = state.host.transform.right
    local basePos = state.host.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(basePos.x + right.x, basePos.y, basePos.z + right.z)
    actor.rotation = state.host.transform.rotation
  end
end

function ConfigureSeat(host, runtimeScope, config)
  if host == nil or config == nil or config.seatKey == nil then return false end
  local state = getState(config.seatKey)
  if state == nil then return false end
  state.host = host
  state.runtimeScope = runtimeScope
  state.seatTaken = config.seatTaken
  state.sideSign = config.sideSign
  state.enterSeatText = config.enterSeatText
  state.exitSeatText = config.exitSeatText
  state.occupiedSeatText = config.occupiedSeatText
  state.standUpPath = config.standUpPath
  state.seatTrans = host.transform
  state.standUpTrans = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:FindTransform(config.standUpPath) or nil
  state.pendingNotify = true
  cacheSeatTrigger(state)

  if state.joyStick == nil then
    state.joyStick = CS.DouyinUIService.GetJoyStickControl(CS.UIType.MoveJoyStick)
    if state.joyStick ~= nil then
      state.onJoyStickDrag = function(eventData)
        OnUIDragMainMoveUI(state.seatKey, eventData)
      end
      state.joyStick:OnUIDrag(state.onJoyStickDrag)
    end
  end
  refreshButtonText(state)
  return true
end

function OnDisableSeat(seatKey)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state ~= nil and state.joyStick ~= nil and state.onJoyStickDrag ~= nil then
    state.joyStick:OffUIDrag(state.onJoyStickDrag)
  end
  if state ~= nil then
    state.joyStick = nil
    state.onJoyStickDrag = nil
  end
end

function OnNetSpawnedSeat(seatKey)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.seatTaken == nil then return end
  state.netReady = true
  state.seatTaken:OnValueChange(function(curVal, preVal)
    state.syncTaken = curVal == true
    if state.syncTaken then
      setSeatTriggerEnabled(state, false)
    else
      restoreSeatTrigger(state)
    end
    state.pendingNotify = true
    refreshButtonText(state)
  end)
  state.syncTaken = state.seatTaken:GetValue() == true
  if state.syncTaken then
    setSeatTriggerEnabled(state, false)
  else
    restoreSeatTrigger(state)
  end
  state.pendingNotify = true
  flushSeatValue(state)
  refreshButtonText(state)
end

function OnActorTriggerEnterSeat(seatKey, actor)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if state.syncTaken then return end
  state.localActor = actor
  state.host:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExitSeat(seatKey, actor)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if state.currentPlayer ~= actor then
    state.localActor = nil
    state.host:DisableInteraction()
  end
end

function OnFocusSeat(seatKey, handType)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil then return end
  if state.localActor == nil or state.syncTaken then return end
  state.interactionButton = state.host:AddInteractorButton()
  refreshButtonText(state)
end

function OnInteractorButtonClickSeat(seatKey, index)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil or index ~= 1 or state.localActor == nil then return end
  ensureOwnership(state, function()
    if state.currentPlayer ~= nil then
      state.localActor:StandUp(state.host.gameObject)
    elseif not state.syncTaken then
      state.localActor:SitDown(state.host.gameObject)
    end
  end)
end

function OnLostFocusSeat(seatKey, handType)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil then return end
  if state.currentPlayer ~= nil then
    ensureLeaveSeatButton(state)
    return
  end
  if state.interactionButton ~= nil then
    state.host:RemoveInteractorButton(state.interactionButton)
  end
  state.interactionButton = nil
end

function OnSeatEnteredSeat(seatKey, actor, handType)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local target = resolveSeatTrans(state)
  if target == nil then
    setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
    if actor.isLocal then
      state.currentPlayer = nil
      refreshButtonText(state)
    end
    return
  end

  if actor.isLocal then
    local actorPos = actor.gameObject.transform.position
    local basePos = state.host.transform.position
    state.savedBoardOffset = UnityEngine.Vector3(actorPos.x - basePos.x, actorPos.y - basePos.y, actorPos.z - basePos.z)
    state.savedBoardRotation = actor.gameObject.transform.rotation
    state.currentPlayer = actor
    state.localActor = actor
    setSeatTriggerEnabled(state, false)
    queueSeatValue(state, true)
    ensureLeaveSeatButton(state)
  end
  state.savedScale[actor] = actor.gameObject.transform.localScale
  alignActorHipsToSeat(state, actor, target)
  state.seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
end

function OnSeatExitedSeat(seatKey, actor)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or actor == nil then return end
  state.seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(state, actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  if actor.isLocal then
    state.currentPlayer = nil
    restoreSeatTrigger(state)
    disableSeatInteraction(state)
    queueSeatValue(state, false)
  end
end

function LateUpdateSeat(seatKey)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil then return end
  for actor, target in pairs(state.seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(state, actor, target)
  end
end

function UpdateSeat(seatKey)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil then return end
  flushSeatValue(state)
  if state.pendingNotify and notifyController(state) then
    state.pendingNotify = false
  end
end

function OnUIDragMainMoveUI(seatKey, eventData)
  local state = getState(seatKey)
  if state == nil or state.host == nil then return end
  local actor = CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
  if actor == nil or state.currentPlayer ~= actor then return end
  ensureOwnership(state, function()
    actor:StandUp(state.host.gameObject)
  end)
end

80b6c947-1cc2-4ca2-afb5-7422e3f30b01.content:
---@id 80b6c947-1cc2-4ca2-afb5-7422e3f30b01
---@referenceName ms-ball-physics.lua
-- 弹力球物理运动：缓存动态刚体、设置防带飞层，并提供受击出球冲量。
---@start
---@var HitImpulse:number=7.5
---@name 命中冲量
---@desc 玩家有效命中后给球的一次性出球冲量。
---@range 1,16,0.1
---@group 弹力球手感
---@var HitUpwardBias:number=0.65
---@name 上抛比例
---@desc 命中后额外向上的方向权重，用于形成清晰抛物线。
---@range 0,1.5,0.05
---@group 弹力球手感
---@var SpinImpulse:number=1.6
---@name 旋转冲量
---@desc 命中时附加的旋转冲量，增强受击反馈。
---@range 0,6,0.1
---@group 弹力球手感
---@var ClearDownwardVelocityOnHit:boolean=true
---@name 命中抑制下坠
---@desc 命中瞬间弱化已有下坠速度，保证回球方向稳定可读。
---@group 弹力球手感
---@var EnableSpawnImpulse:boolean=true
---@name 初始抛出
---@desc 生成后给球一个轻微初始冲量，使其立即出现抛物线运动。
---@group 初始运动
---@var SpawnImpulse:number=2.2
---@name 初始冲量
---@desc 初始抛出力度。
---@range 0,8,0.1
---@group 初始运动
---@var BounceAssistImpulse:number=0.75
---@name 反弹辅助
---@desc 与场景发生实体碰撞时的轻量向上回弹辅助，避免默认材质过钝。
---@range 0,4,0.05
---@group 弹力反馈
---@var MaxAngularVelocity:number=18
---@name 最大角速度
---@desc 刚体允许的最大角速度，数值越大旋转反馈越明显。
---@range 1,40,0.5
---@group 弹力反馈
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local PROPS_LAYER = 6
local rb = nil
local warnedNoRigidbody = false
local didSpawnImpulse = false
local lastPlayerHitTime = -999
local lastBounceAssistTime = -999

local function numberValue(value, fallback)
  local n = tonumber(value)
  if n == nil then return fallback end
  return n
end

local function boolValue(value, fallback)
  if value == nil then return fallback end
  return value == true
end

local function setLayerRecursive(trans, layer)
  if trans == nil then return end
  trans.gameObject:SetLayer(layer)
  for i = 0, trans.childCount - 1 do
    setLayerRecursive(trans:GetChild(i), layer)
  end
end

local function vectorLength(x, y, z)
  return math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
end

local function normalizedVector(x, y, z, fallbackX, fallbackY, fallbackZ)
  local len = vectorLength(x, y, z)
  if len < 0.0001 then
    return fallbackX, fallbackY, fallbackZ
  end
  return x / len, y / len, z / len
end

local function getRigidbody()
  if rb ~= nil then return rb end
  if self == nil or self.gameObject == nil then return nil end

  rb = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  if rb == nil then
    local ok, childRb = pcall(function()
      return self.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
    end)
    if ok then rb = childRb end
  end

  if rb == nil and not warnedNoRigidbody then
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("module-bouncy-ball: Rigidbody not found; hit impulse is disabled until the component exists.")
    warnedNoRigidbody = true
  end
  return rb
end

local function getActorTransform(actor)
  if actor == nil then return nil end
  if actor.transform ~= nil then return actor.transform end
  if actor.gameObject ~= nil then return actor.gameObject.transform end
  return nil
end

local function computeDirectionFromActor(actor)
  local fallbackForward = self.transform.forward
  local fx, fy, fz = fallbackForward.x, fallbackForward.y, fallbackForward.z
  local ax, ay, az = 0, 0, 0

  local actorTrans = getActorTransform(actor)
  if actorTrans ~= nil then
    local forward = actorTrans.forward
    fx, fy, fz = forward.x, forward.y, forward.z

    local ballPos = self.transform.position
    local actorPos = actorTrans.position
    ax, ay, az = normalizedVector(ballPos.x - actorPos.x, 0, ballPos.z - actorPos.z, fx, 0, fz)
  end

  fx, fy, fz = normalizedVector(fx, 0, fz, 0, 0, 1)
  local awayWeight = 0.35
  local x = fx + ax * awayWeight
  local z = fz + az * awayWeight
  local dotAway = x * ax + z * az
  if dotAway < 0 then
    x = x + ax * (-dotAway + 0.3)
    z = z + az * (-dotAway + 0.3)
  end

  local y = math.max(0.1, fy) + numberValue(HitUpwardBias, 0.65)
  return normalizedVector(x, y, z, 0, 0.65, 0.76)
end

local function softenDownwardVelocity(targetRb)
  if not boolValue(ClearDownwardVelocityOnHit, true) then return end
  local vel = targetRb.velocity
  if vel == nil or vel.y >= 0 then return end
  targetRb.velocity = UnityEngine.Vector3(vel.x * 0.55, 0, vel.z * 0.55)
end

local function applyImpulse(directionX, directionY, directionZ, impulse)
  local targetRb = getRigidbody()
  if targetRb == nil then return false end

  local force = UnityEngine.Vector3(directionX * impulse, directionY * impulse, directionZ * impulse)
  targetRb:AddForce(force, UnityEngine.ForceMode.Impulse)

  local spin = numberValue(SpinImpulse, 1.6)
  if spin > 0 then
    local torque = UnityEngine.Vector3(-directionZ * spin, 0.25 * spin, directionX * spin)
    targetRb:AddTorque(torque, UnityEngine.ForceMode.Impulse)
  end
  return true
end

local function applySpawnImpulse()
  if didSpawnImpulse or not boolValue(EnableSpawnImpulse, true) then return end
  didSpawnImpulse = true
  local trans = self.transform
  if trans == nil then return end
  local f = trans.forward
  local x, y, z = normalizedVector(f.x, f.y + 0.55, f.z, 0, 0.6, 0.8)
  applyImpulse(x, y, z, numberValue(SpawnImpulse, 2.2))
end

function Start()
  setLayerRecursive(self.transform, PROPS_LAYER)
  local targetRb = getRigidbody()
  if targetRb ~= nil then
    targetRb.maxAngularVelocity = numberValue(MaxAngularVelocity, 18)
  end
  applySpawnImpulse()
end

function OnEnable()
  rb = nil
  warnedNoRigidbody = false
end

function ApplyPlayerHit(actor)
  local targetRb = getRigidbody()
  if targetRb == nil then return false end

  lastPlayerHitTime = Time.time
  softenDownwardVelocity(targetRb)
  local x, y, z = computeDirectionFromActor(actor)
  return applyImpulse(x, y, z, numberValue(HitImpulse, 7.5))
end

function OnCollisionEnter(collision)
  local targetRb = getRigidbody()
  if targetRb == nil then return end
  local now = Time.time
  if now - lastPlayerHitTime < 0.12 then return end
  if now - lastBounceAssistTime < 0.08 then return end

  local assist = numberValue(BounceAssistImpulse, 0.75)
  if assist <= 0 then return end

  local vel = targetRb.velocity
  if vel == nil then return end
  local speed = vectorLength(vel.x, vel.y, vel.z)
  if speed < 0.7 then return end

  lastBounceAssistTime = now
  targetRb:AddForce(UnityEngine.Vector3(0, assist, 0), UnityEngine.ForceMode.Impulse)
end

e7ea09f8-d442-46d6-99d6-81848d06e0d5.content:
---@id e7ea09f8-d442-46d6-99d6-81848d06e0d5
---@referenceName pi-bouncy-ball.lua
-- 弹力球玩家接触入口：只在 Actor 进入根触发区时做一次受击施力，不创建按钮。
---@start
---@var HitCooldown:number=0.22
---@name 命中冷却
---@desc 同一物理接触窗口内的去重时间，防止一次进入重复施力。
---@range 0.05,1,0.01
---@group 命中判定
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local motionScript = nil
local warnedNoMotionScript = false
local lastHitAt = -999
local actorLastHitAt = {}

local function numberValue(value, fallback)
  local n = tonumber(value)
  if n == nil then return fallback end
  return n
end

local function getMotionScript()
  if motionScript ~= nil then return motionScript end
  local ok, douyinScript = pcall(function()
    return self:GetDouyinScript("ms-ball-physics.lua")
  end)
  if ok and douyinScript ~= nil then
    motionScript = douyinScript.script
  end
  if motionScript == nil and not warnedNoMotionScript then
    UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("module-bouncy-ball: ms-ball-physics.lua is not available; contact force is disabled.")
    warnedNoMotionScript = true
  end
  return motionScript
end

local function canHit(actor)
  if actor == nil then return false end
  local now = Time.time
  local cooldown = numberValue(HitCooldown, 0.22)
  if now - lastHitAt < cooldown then return false end

  local actorTime = actorLastHitAt[actor]
  if actorTime ~= nil and now - actorTime < cooldown then return false end
  return true
end

local function markHit(actor)
  local now = Time.time
  lastHitAt = now
  if actor ~= nil then
    actorLastHitAt[actor] = now
  end
end

function Start()
  getMotionScript()
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if not canHit(actor) then return end

  local script = getMotionScript()
  if script == nil or script.ApplyPlayerHit == nil then return end

  local ok = script.ApplyPlayerHit(actor)
  if ok ~= false then
    markHit(actor)
  end
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  -- 保持成对回调；冷却只按时间释放，不在退出时改变状态，避免贴边抖动连发。
end

2d90cbef-3c9b-4a90-9f49-dfc9243bc0d9.content:
---@id 2d90cbef-3c9b-4a90-9f49-dfc9243bc0d9
---@referenceName pi-trampoline.lua
-- 蹦床的靠近检测与「上蹦床」入口，负责与 Runtime Host 协作
---@displayName 蹦床交互
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始接近检测范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-trampoline")
local RESOURCE_ID = "module-trampoline"
local ENTER_EVENT = "Trampoline.enter"
local TELEPORT_NODE_PATH = "ModelRoot/BounceZone"
local TELEPORT_OFFSET_Y = 0.5
local BOUNCE_SCRIPT_ID = "ModelRoot/BounceZone/pi-bounce.lua"
local REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL = 0.5

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "trampoline host link disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
end

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local resourceEntry = nil
local localActor = nil
-- nearbyDesired 是本地玩家当前是否在范围内；nearbyReported 是 Host 已确认接收的状态。
-- 两者分开保存，Host 尚未可用时不会丢失这次状态变化，登记成功后由 Update 补报。
local nearbyDesired = false
local nearbyReported = false
local nextRegisterRetryAt = 0
local teleportTransform = nil

local function getHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  return runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
end

-- 本地玩家离开蹦床接近范围时，把弹跳期间提高的跳跃高度还原成进入前的值。
local function restoreBounceJumpHeight()
  if runtimeScope == nil then return end

  local bounce = runtimeScope:GetScript(BOUNCE_SCRIPT_ID)
  if bounce == nil or type(bounce.RestoreJumpHeight) ~= "function" then return end
  bounce.RestoreJumpHeight()
end

-- 本地玩家进入蹦床范围时，趁角色还站在地面先记录原始跳跃高度。
local function captureBounceJumpHeight(actor)
  if runtimeScope == nil or actor == nil then return end

  local bounce = runtimeScope:GetScript(BOUNCE_SCRIPT_ID)
  if bounce == nil or type(bounce.CaptureJumpHeight) ~= "function" then return end
  bounce.CaptureJumpHeight(actor)
end

local function getTeleportTransform()
  if teleportTransform ~= nil then return teleportTransform end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  teleportTransform = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(TELEPORT_NODE_PATH)
  if teleportTransform == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("teleport-node-missing", "trampoline teleport skipped: BounceZone node not found")
  end
  return teleportTransform
end

-- 把本地玩家送到跳布中心上方，落下后由跳布脚本弹起。
local function enterTrampoline(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return false end

  local targetTransform = getTeleportTransform()
  if targetTransform == nil then return false end

  local targetPoint = targetTransform:TransformPoint(UnityEngine.Vector3(0, TELEPORT_OFFSET_Y, 0))
  actor:Teleport(targetPoint)
  logger:info("local actor teleported onto trampoline mat")
  return true
end

-- Host 会把 “Trampoline.enter” 广播给全部已登记的蹦床实例，payload.target 指明本次目标实例；
-- 只处理 target 为本实例资源根（或未指定 target）的请求，避免多台蹦床互相干扰。
local function handleHostEvent(eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName ~= ENTER_EVENT then return false end
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end

  local target = payload.target
  if target ~= nil and target ~= resourceRoot then return false end

  if localActor == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("enter-without-local-actor", "Trampoline.enter skipped: local actor not cached yet")
    return false
  end

  return enterTrampoline(localActor)
end

local function registerResource()
  if resourceEntry ~= nil or runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end

  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "trampoline registration skipped")
    return
  end

  local ok, entry = pcall(host.RegisterResource, resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    events = { ENTER_EVENT },
    handler = handleHostEvent,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
  if not ok or entry == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("register-resource-failed", "trampoline registration failed")
    return
  end

  resourceEntry = entry
end

-- 上报一次接近状态，只有 Host 明确接受（返回 true）才记录为已上报。
local function pushNearby(nearby)
  if resourceRoot == nil then return false end

  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.SetTrampolineNearby) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("set-nearby-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: SetTrampolineNearby")
    return false
  end

  local ok, accepted = pcall(host.SetTrampolineNearby, resourceRoot, nearby)
  if not ok then
    logger:warnOnce("set-nearby-failed", "SetTrampolineNearby failed")
    return false
  end
  if accepted ~= true then
    logger:warnOnce("set-nearby-rejected", "SetTrampolineNearby rejected nearby state")
    return false
  end

  nearbyReported = nearby
  return true
end

-- 先确保已完成登记，再把尚未被 Host 确认的接近状态补报上去。
local function flushNearby()
  if nearbyDesired == nearbyReported then return true end

  registerResource()
  if resourceEntry == nil then return false end

  return pushNearby(nearbyDesired)
end

-- 只上报本地玩家自己的接近状态，远端玩家不改变本机提示。
local function reportNearby(nearby)
  nearbyDesired = nearby
  flushNearby()
end

local function unregisterResource()
  local entry = resourceEntry

  -- 先撤回已上报的接近状态，避免实例禁用后 Host 里残留这台蹦床。
  if nearbyReported then pushNearby(false) end
  restoreBounceJumpHeight()

  resourceEntry = nil
  nearbyReported = false
  localActor = nil

  if entry == nil then return end

  local host = getHost()
  if host == nil or type(host.UnregisterResource) ~= "function" then return end
  pcall(host.UnregisterResource, entry)
end

-- Host 可能晚于本脚本可用：Start / OnEnable 登记失败时，在 Update 中继续重试。
function Start()
  registerResource()
  flushNearby()
end

function OnEnable()
  registerResource()
  flushNearby()
end

function Update()
  if resourceEntry == nil then
    local now = Time.time
    if now >= nextRegisterRetryAt then
      nextRegisterRetryAt = now + REGISTER_RETRY_INTERVAL
      registerResource()
    end
  end
  flushNearby()
end

function OnDisable()
  unregisterResource()
end

function OnDestroy()
  unregisterResource()
  nearbyDesired = false
end

-- 不依赖范围触发也能拿到本地角色；离开范围不清空，避免提示还在时点击失效。
function OnActorSpawned(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  localActor = actor
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  localActor = actor
  captureBounceJumpHeight(actor)
  reportNearby(true)
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  reportNearby(false)
  restoreBounceJumpHeight()
end

59ea6a14-6458-4164-967d-bef938d23aaa.content:
---@id 59ea6a14-6458-4164-967d-bef938d23aaa
---@referenceName ui.lua
local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local ButtonType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Button)
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Animation = require("official.ui.animation")

local RESOURCE_ID = "ui-trampoline-prompt"
local HOST_SCRIPT = "runtime-host.lua"
local PROMPT_EVENT = "Trampoline.prompt"
local PROMPT_BUTTON_PATH = "promptButton"

local uiLogger = Logger.create("ui-trampoline-prompt")
local Anim = Animation.create("ui-trampoline-prompt-animation")

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil

local listeners = {}
local promptGo = nil
local isVisible = false
local promptCount = 0
local resourceEntry = nil
local hostRef = nil

-- 提示胶囊只在玩家靠近蹦床时出现，局部状态跟随 Runtime Host 推送，不自行判定距离。
local getRuntimeHost
local handlePromptEvent
local setPromptVisible

local function bindButton(nodePath, handler)
    if runtimeScope == nil then return end
    local buttonGo, lookupReason = runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(nodePath)
    if buttonGo == nil then
        uiLogger:warn("button not found", nodePath, "reason=" .. tostring(lookupReason))
        return
    end
    local button = buttonGo:GetComponent(ButtonType)
    if button == nil then
        uiLogger:warn("node is not Button", nodePath)
        return
    end
    button.onClick:AddListener(handler)
    table.insert(listeners, { button = button, handler = handler })
end

local function clearListeners()
    for _, item in ipairs(listeners) do
        if item.button ~= nil and item.handler ~= nil then
            item.button.onClick:RemoveListener(item.handler)
        end
    end
    listeners = {}
end

getRuntimeHost = function()
    if runtimeScope == nil then
        return nil, runtimeScopeReason
    end

    local host, reason = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript(HOST_SCRIPT)
    if host == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    -- 不检查 IsReady：RegisterResource / GetTrampolinePrompt / RequestTrampolineEnter 都是
    -- 纯数据接口，不依赖 Host 的 Start 是否已执行。本界面 Start 早于 Host Start 时若因此
    -- 返回 nil，登记只做一次的流程会被永久跳过，提示按钮再也不出现。
    return host, nil
end

setPromptVisible = function(visible, count)
    if promptGo == nil then return end

    promptCount = count or 0
    if visible == isVisible then return end
    isVisible = visible

    if visible then
        promptGo:SetActive(true)
        Anim.fadeIn(promptGo, 0.22, 0)
    else
        Anim.fadeOutThen(promptGo, 0.18, function()
            -- 淡出期间可能重新收到显示事件，回调里再确认一次当前状态。
            if not isVisible and promptGo ~= nil then
                promptGo:SetActive(false)
            end
        end)
    end
end

handlePromptEvent = function(eventName, payload, context)
    if eventName ~= PROMPT_EVENT then return false end
    if type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end

    local count = tonumber(payload.count) or 0
    setPromptVisible(payload.visible == true, count)
    return true
end

local function registerPromptReceiver()
    local host, hostReason = getRuntimeHost()
    if host == nil then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "prompt events disabled, reason=" .. tostring(hostReason))
        return
    end

    hostRef = host
    if type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("register-resource-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: RegisterResource")
        return
    end

    resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
        events = { PROMPT_EVENT },
        handler = handlePromptEvent,
        options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
    })
end

local function syncInitialPromptState()
    local host = hostRef
    if host == nil or type(host.GetTrampolinePrompt) ~= "function" then return end

    local ok, snapshot = pcall(host.GetTrampolinePrompt)
    if not ok or type(snapshot) ~= "table" then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("trampoline-prompt-snapshot-failed", "GetTrampolinePrompt failed")
        return
    end

    setPromptVisible(snapshot.visible == true, tonumber(snapshot.count) or 0)
end

local function onPromptClicked()
    local host, hostReason = getRuntimeHost()
    if host == nil then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable-click", "enter request skipped, reason=" .. tostring(hostReason))
        return
    end
    if type(host.RequestTrampolineEnter) ~= "function" then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("request-enter-unavailable", "Runtime Host API missing: RequestTrampolineEnter")
        return
    end

    local ok, accepted = pcall(host.RequestTrampolineEnter)
    if not ok then
        uiLogger:warn("RequestTrampolineEnter failed")
        return
    end

    -- 返回 0 表示当前范围内没有可用蹦床：保持提示原状态，不做任何本地切换。
    if accepted == nil or accepted == 0 then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("trampoline-enter-no-target", "no trampoline accepted the enter request")
        return
    end

    -- 被接受后由蹦床实例上报离开范围，Runtime Host 推送隐藏事件，这里不猜测结果。
end

function Start()
    if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
        uiLogger:warnOnce("runtime-scope-unavailable", RESOURCE_ID, "reason=" .. tostring(runtimeScopeReason))
        return
    end

    local go, lookupReason = runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(PROMPT_BUTTON_PATH)
    if go == nil then
        uiLogger:warn("prompt button not found", PROMPT_BUTTON_PATH, "reason=" .. tostring(lookupReason))
        return
    end

    promptGo = go
    isVisible = false
    promptGo:SetActive(false)

    bindButton(PROMPT_BUTTON_PATH, onPromptClicked)
    registerPromptReceiver()
    syncInitialPromptState()
end

function Update()
    Anim.tick(UnityEngine.Time.unscaledDeltaTime)
end

function OnDestroy()
    if resourceEntry ~= nil then
        local host = hostRef
        if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
            pcall(host.UnregisterResource, resourceEntry)
        end
        resourceEntry = nil
    end

    clearListeners()
    Anim.clearAll()
    promptGo = nil
    isVisible = false
    promptCount = 0
    hostRef = nil
end

60e2b726-13a3-4864-97f7-efc7a24aa34b.content:
---@id 60e2b726-13a3-4864-97f7-efc7a24aa34b
---@referenceName runtime-host.lua
-- 多资源世界的 Runtime Host 骨架；按当前玩法补充确实需要的接口。
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local hostLogger = Logger.create("runtime-host")

local hostReady = false
local registry = {}
local resources = {}
local resourceIdIndex = {}
local resourceTagIndex = {}
local resourceObjectIndex = {}
local statsVersion = 0

-- 蹦床玩法共享状态。
-- 参与资源：
--   module-trampoline        每个实例上报“本地玩家是否已靠近”，并接收 “Trampoline.enter”。
--   ui-trampoline-prompt     接收 “Trampoline.prompt”，点击后调用 RequestTrampolineEnter()。
-- nearbyOrder 按“本地玩家进入范围的先后”保存蹦床实例资源根，队尾为最近进入的一台；
-- 多台蹦床范围重叠时，上蹦床请求只发给队尾实例。
local TRAMPOLINE_RESOURCE_ID = "module-trampoline"
local TRAMPOLINE_PROMPT_RESOURCE_ID = "ui-trampoline-prompt"
local nearbyOrder = {}
local nearbySet = {}
local promptVisible = false

local function removeNearby(gameObject)
  if nearbySet[gameObject] ~= true then return false end

  nearbySet[gameObject] = nil
  for i = #nearbyOrder, 1, -1 do
    if nearbyOrder[i].gameObject == gameObject then
      table.remove(nearbyOrder, i)
    end
  end
  return true
end

local function notifyTrampolinePrompt()
  local visible = #nearbyOrder > 0
  if visible == promptVisible then return end
  promptVisible = visible

  DispatchEvent({ id = TRAMPOLINE_PROMPT_RESOURCE_ID }, "Trampoline.prompt", {
    visible = visible,
    count = #nearbyOrder,
  }, { sourceResourceId = "runtime-host" })
end

local function bumpVersion()
  statsVersion = statsVersion + 1
end

local function getBucket(component, group)
  registry[component] = registry[component] or {}
  registry[component][group] = registry[component][group] or {}
  return registry[component][group]
end

local function getResourceIdBucket(resourceId)
  if resourceId == nil then return {} end
  resourceIdIndex[resourceId] = resourceIdIndex[resourceId] or {}
  return resourceIdIndex[resourceId]
end

local function getResourceTagBucket(tag)
  if tag == nil then return {} end
  resourceTagIndex[tag] = resourceTagIndex[tag] or {}
  return resourceTagIndex[tag]
end

local function getResourceObjectBucket(gameObject)
  if gameObject == nil then return {} end
  resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] = resourceObjectIndex[gameObject] or {}
  return resourceObjectIndex[gameObject]
end

local function cloneShallowTable(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end

  for key, value in pairs(source) do
    result[key] = value
  end
  return result
end

local function cloneArray(source)
  local result = {}
  if type(source) ~= "table" then return result end

  for _, value in ipairs(source) do
    table.insert(result, value)
  end
  return result
end

local function normalizeStringList(values)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}

  local function addValue(value)
    if value == nil then return end
    local normalized = tostring(value)
    if normalized == "" or seen[normalized] == true then return end
    seen[normalized] = true
    table.insert(result, normalized)
  end

  if type(values) == "string" then
    for value in string.gmatch(values, "[^,%s;]+") do
      addValue(value)
    end
    return result
  end

  if type(values) == "table" then
    for key, value in pairs(values) do
      if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" then
        addValue(value)
      elseif type(key) == "string" and value == true then
        addValue(key)
      end
    end
  end

  return result
end

local function buildStringSet(values)
  local result = {}
  if type(values) ~= "table" then return result end

  for _, value in ipairs(values) do
    result[value] = true
  end
  return result
end

local function snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return nil end

  return {
    gameObject = entry.gameObject,
    resourceId = entry.resourceId,
    options = cloneShallowTable(entry.options),
    removed = entry.removed == true,
    tags = cloneArray(entry.tags),
    events = cloneArray(entry.events),
  }
end

local function removeEntryFromArray(array, entry)
  if array == nil then return end

  for i = #array, 1, -1 do
    if array[i] == entry then
      table.remove(array, i)
    end
  end
end

local function removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end

  removeEntryFromArray(resourceIdIndex[entry.resourceId], entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resourceObjectIndex[entry.gameObject], entry)

  if entry.tags ~= nil then
    for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags) do
      removeEntryFromArray(resourceTagIndex[tag], entry)
    end
  end
end

local function indexResourceEntry(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end

  table.insert(getResourceIdBucket(entry.resourceId), entry)
  table.insert(getResourceObjectBucket(entry.gameObject), entry)

  if entry.tags ~= nil then
    for _, tag in ipairs(entry.tags) do
      table.insert(getResourceTagBucket(tag), entry)
    end
  end
end

local function cleanupResourceBucket(bucket)
  if bucket == nil then return {} end

  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    local entry = bucket[i]
    if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
    end
  end
  return bucket
end

local function findResourceEntry(gameObject, resourceId)
  for _, entry in ipairs(resources) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and entry.gameObject == gameObject and entry.resourceId == resourceId then
      return entry
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function acceptsEvent(entry, eventName)
  if entry == nil or entry.eventSet == nil or eventName == nil then return false end
  return entry.eventSet[eventName] == true
end

local function addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true or entry.gameObject == nil or seen[entry] == true then return end

  seen[entry] = true
  table.insert(result, entry)
end

local function collectBucketEntries(bucket, result, seen)
  cleanupResourceBucket(bucket)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket or {}) do
    addResourceEntry(result, seen, entry)
  end
end

local function collectGameObjectEntries(gameObject, result, seen)
  if gameObject == nil then return end

  local resourceRoot = RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(gameObject)
  collectBucketEntries(resourceObjectIndex[resourceRoot], result, seen)
end

local function collectSelectorList(values, visitor)
  if values == nil then return end

  if type(values) == "table" then
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
      visitor(value)
    end
    return
  end

  visitor(values)
end

local function collectTargetEntries(target)
  local result = {}
  local seen = {}

  if target == nil then return result end

  if type(target) ~= "table" then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target, result, seen)
    return result
  end

  collectSelectorList(target.id or target.resourceId, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.ids or target.resourceIds, function(resourceId)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceIdIndex[tostring(resourceId)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tag, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)
  collectSelectorList(target.tags, function(tag)
    collectBucketEntries(resourceTagIndex[tostring(tag)], result, seen)
  end)

  if target.gameObject ~= nil then
    collectGameObjectEntries(target.gameObject, result, seen)
  end

  return result
end

local function warnEventFailure(eventName, context, message)
  local source = context ~= nil and context.sourceResourceId or nil
  hostLogger:warn(
    "event dispatch failed",
    "event=" .. tostring(eventName),
    "source=" .. tostring(source),
    "error=" .. tostring(message)
  )
end

function IsReady()
  return hostReady
end

function EnsureScene()
  return true
end

function RegisterResource(gameObject, resourceId, config)
  if gameObject == nil or resourceId == nil then return nil end

  local normalizedResourceId = tostring(resourceId)
  if normalizedResourceId == "" then return nil end

  config = config or {}
  local entry = findResourceEntry(gameObject, normalizedResourceId)
  if entry ~= nil then
    removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  else
    entry = {
      gameObject = gameObject,
      resourceId = normalizedResourceId,
    }
    table.insert(resources, entry)
  end

  entry.tags = normalizeStringList(config.tags)
  entry.events = normalizeStringList(config.events)
  entry.eventSet = buildStringSet(entry.events)
  entry.handler = config.handler
  entry.options = config.options or entry.options or {}
  entry.removed = false

  indexResourceEntry(entry)
  return entry
end

function UnregisterResource(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.removed == true then return end

  removeResourceEntryFromIndexes(entry)
  removeEntryFromArray(resources, entry)
  entry.removed = true

  -- 蹦床实例销毁或禁用后不再参与“上蹦床”目标选择，避免提示残留。
  if entry.resourceId == TRAMPOLINE_RESOURCE_ID and removeNearby(entry.gameObject) then
    notifyTrampolinePrompt()
  end
end

function GetResources(target)
  local snapshot = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    local item = snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
    if item ~= nil then
      table.insert(snapshot, item)
    end
  end
  return snapshot
end

function ForEachResource(target, visitor)
  if type(visitor) ~= "function" then return 0 end

  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    local item = snapshotResourceEntry(entry)
    if item ~= nil then
      visitor(item)
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end

function DispatchEvent(target, eventName, payload, context)
  if eventName == nil then return 0 end

  local count = 0
  for _, entry in ipairs(collectTargetEntries(target)) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.removed ~= true and type(entry.handler) == "function" and acceptsEvent(entry, eventName) then
      local ok, result = pcall(entry.handler, eventName, payload or {}, context or {})
      if ok and result ~= false then
        count = count + 1
      elseif not ok then
        warnEventFailure(eventName, context, result)
      end
    end
  end
  return count
end

function Register(component, group, gameObject, initialState, options)
  if component == nil or group == nil or gameObject == nil then return nil end

  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject == gameObject then
      entry.state = initialState or entry.state or {}
      entry.options = options or entry.options or {}
      return entry
    end
  end

  local entry = {
    component = component,
    group = group,
    gameObject = gameObject,
    state = initialState or {},
    options = options or {},
  }
  table.insert(bucket, entry)
  bumpVersion()
  return entry
end

function UpdateRegistry(entry, patch)
  if entry == nil or entry.state == nil then return end
  if patch ~= nil then
    for key, value in pairs(patch) do
      entry.state[key] = value
    end
  end
  bumpVersion()
end

function Unregister(entry)
  if entry == nil then return end
  local bucket = getBucket(entry.component, entry.group)
  for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
    if bucket[i] == entry then
      table.remove(bucket, i)
      bumpVersion()
      return
    end
  end
end

function GetStats(component, group)
  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  local total = 0
  local active = 0
  local collected = 0

  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil then
      total = total + 1
      if entry.state == nil or entry.state.active ~= false then active = active + 1 end
      if entry.state ~= nil and entry.state.collected == true then collected = collected + 1 end
    end
  end

  return {
    total = total,
    active = active,
    collected = collected,
    allCollected = total > 0 and collected >= total,
    version = statsVersion,
  }
end

function ForEach(component, group, visitor)
  if visitor == nil then return end

  local bucket = getBucket(component, group)
  for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do
    if entry ~= nil and entry.gameObject ~= nil then
      visitor(entry)
    end
  end
end

-- 蹦床实例在本地玩家进入 / 离开接近范围时调用。
-- gameObject 必须是该实例自己的资源根（module-trampoline 的 root），不能传子节点。
-- nearby=true 表示本地玩家已进入该实例范围；false 表示已离开。
-- 返回 true 表示状态已接受（状态未变化时同样返回 true，调用方据此确认上报成功）。
function SetTrampolineNearby(gameObject, nearby)
  if gameObject == nil then return false end

  local changed = false
  if nearby == true then
    removeNearby(gameObject)
    table.insert(nearbyOrder, { gameObject = gameObject })
    nearbySet[gameObject] = true
    changed = true
  else
    changed = removeNearby(gameObject)
  end

  if changed then
    notifyTrampolinePrompt()
  end
  return true
end

-- 返回当前提示状态快照：{ visible = bool, count = int }。
-- Runtime UI 在登记事件接收方后调用一次，补齐登记前可能错过的提示事件。
function GetTrampolinePrompt()
  return {
    visible = #nearbyOrder > 0,
    count = #nearbyOrder,
  }
end

-- Runtime UI 点击「蹦床」按钮时调用。
-- 将 “Trampoline.enter” 发给全部已登记的蹦床实例，payload.target 指定最近进入范围的实例资源根，
-- 各实例只有自己是 target 时才执行传送；先按 resourceId 派发，再以 GameObject 选择器兜底。
-- 返回成功接收事件的实例数量；0 表示当前范围内没有可用蹦床，调用方保持原状态。
function RequestTrampolineEnter()
  for i = #nearbyOrder, 1, -1 do
    local item = nearbyOrder[i]
    if item ~= nil and item.gameObject ~= nil and nearbySet[item.gameObject] == true then
      local context = { sourceResourceId = TRAMPOLINE_PROMPT_RESOURCE_ID }

      local count = DispatchEvent({ id = TRAMPOLINE_RESOURCE_ID }, "Trampoline.enter", {
        target = item.gameObject,
      }, context)
      if count > 0 then
        return count
      end

      count = DispatchEvent({ gameObject = item.gameObject }, "Trampoline.enter", {
        target = item.gameObject,
      }, context)
      if count > 0 then
        return count
      end
    end
  end

  hostLogger:warnOnce("trampoline-enter-no-target", "Trampoline.enter skipped: no trampoline in range")
  return 0
end

function Start()
  hostReady = true
end

7fb2695b-9919-44f1-ae11-8c05bd497025.content:
---@id 7fb2695b-9919-44f1-ae11-8c05bd497025
---@referenceName ModelRoot_BounceZone_pi-bounce.lua
-- 跳布的落地弹起与下陷回弹表现，只对本地玩家结算
---@displayName 蹦床弹跳
---@start
---@var BounceHeight:number=6
---@name 弹起高度
---@desc 每次落到跳布时被弹起的相对高度，单位米
---@var DefaultJumpHeight:number=1
---@name 离开蹦床后的跳跃高度
---@desc 离开蹦床时把角色跳跃高度还原成该值，请填成你的世界里的正常跳跃高度
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始跳布检测范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time

local Logger = require("official.core.logger")
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local logger = Logger.create("pi-bounce")
local MAT_NODE_PATH = "ModelRoot/JumpMat"
local BOUNCE_COOLDOWN = 0.3
local DIP_DEPTH = 0.22
local DIP_DOWN_TIME = 0.07
local DIP_UP_TIME = 0.26
local MAT_RADIUS_LIMIT = 2.64
local MAT_LOCAL_MIN_Y = 1.44
local MAT_LOCAL_MAX_Y = 3.1
local OFF_MAT_RESTORE_DELAY = 0.6
-- 平台读取到的 jumpHeight 不一定是角色的默认跳跃高度（可能是 0 或当前跳跃剩余量），
-- 因此还原时只接受合理区间内的读数，否则使用面板里的标准跳跃高度。
local PLAUSIBLE_JUMP_MIN = 0.2
local PLAUSIBLE_JUMP_MAX = 3

local runtimeScope, runtimeScopeReason = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local resourceRoot = runtimeScope ~= nil and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot() or nil
if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then
  logger:warnOnce("resource-scope-unavailable", "trampoline bounce disabled", runtimeScopeReason)
end

Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local rootTransform = nil
local jumpMat = nil
local matBaseY = 0
local dipActive = false
local dipElapsed = 0
local lastBounceTime = -100
local zoneActor = nil

-- 弹起借用角色自身跳跃：在跳布上把 jumpHeight 提到弹起高度，离开蹦床后还原成进入前的值。
-- baseJumpHeight 只在本地玩家首次上跳布时记录一次，避免把已经提高过的值当成原始值。
local jumpActor = nil
local baseJumpHeight = nil
local jumpBoosted = false
local offMatTime = 0
local restorePending = false

local function startDip()
  if jumpMat == nil then return end
  dipActive = true
  dipElapsed = 0
end

-- 只认可位于跳布圆面正上方、竖直位置贴近垫面的本地玩家，方框检测的角落不会误触发。
local function isAboveMat(actor)
  if rootTransform == nil then return false end

  local point = rootTransform:InverseTransformPoint(actor.position)
  if point.y < MAT_LOCAL_MIN_Y or point.y > MAT_LOCAL_MAX_Y then return false end
  return (point.x * point.x + point.z * point.z) <= (MAT_RADIUS_LIMIT * MAT_RADIUS_LIMIT)
end

-- 进入蹦床范围时预先记录跳跃高度：此时角色站在地面、还没有被弹起，读数最接近进入前的状态。
-- 返回 true 表示本次完成记录；已有同角色的记录时不覆盖，避免把弹起后的值当成原始值。
function CaptureJumpHeight(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return false end
  if jumpBoosted then return false end
  if jumpActor == actor and baseJumpHeight ~= nil then return false end

  local value = actor.jumpHeight
  jumpActor = actor
  baseJumpHeight = value
  jumpBoosted = false

  if type(value) == "number" and value > 0 then
    logger:info("captured actor jump height " .. tostring(value))
  else
    logger:warnOnce("jump-height-unreadable", "actor jump height unreadable, fallback restore height will be used")
  end
  return true
end

-- 还原目标：优先使用进入蹦床前读到的合理值，读不到时使用面板中的标准跳跃高度。
local function resolveRestoreJumpHeight(captured)
  if type(captured) == "number"
      and captured >= PLAUSIBLE_JUMP_MIN
      and captured <= PLAUSIBLE_JUMP_MAX then
    return captured
  end

  if type(DefaultJumpHeight) == "number" and DefaultJumpHeight > 0 then
    return DefaultJumpHeight
  end
  return 1
end

local function applyJumpHeightRestore()
  local actor = jumpActor
  if jumpBoosted and actor ~= nil and actor.isLocal then
    actor.jumpHeight = resolveRestoreJumpHeight(baseJumpHeight)
  end

  jumpBoosted = false
  jumpActor = nil
  baseJumpHeight = nil
  offMatTime = 0
  restorePending = false
end

-- 供同资源的接近检测脚本在本地玩家离开蹦床时调用：把跳跃高度还原到进入前的水平。
-- 腾空时先挂起，落地后再写回，避免在空中写入跳跃高度影响这次跳跃。
function RestoreJumpHeight()
  if jumpActor == nil then
    restorePending = false
    return
  end

  if jumpActor.isLocal and not jumpActor:IsGrounded() then
    restorePending = true
    return
  end

  applyJumpHeightRestore()
end

local function applyBounceJumpHeight(actor)
  if jumpActor ~= actor or baseJumpHeight == nil then
    jumpActor = actor
    baseJumpHeight = actor.jumpHeight
    jumpBoosted = false
  end

  if not jumpBoosted then
    actor.jumpHeight = BounceHeight
    jumpBoosted = true
  end
end

-- 落到跳布时用角色跳跃把本地玩家重新弹起，并播放跳布下陷回弹。
local function bounceOnMat(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return false end
  if not isAboveMat(actor) then return false end
  if not actor:IsGrounded() then return false end

  local now = Time.time
  if (now - lastBounceTime) < BOUNCE_COOLDOWN then return false end

  applyBounceJumpHeight(actor)
  lastBounceTime = now
  actor:Jump()
  startDip()
  return true
end

function Start()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end

  rootTransform = resourceRoot.transform
  jumpMat = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(MAT_NODE_PATH)
  if jumpMat == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("jump-mat-missing", "trampoline mat animation disabled")
    return
  end

  matBaseY = jumpMat.localPosition.y
end

function Update()
  -- 离开蹦床时若还在空中，等落地后再把跳跃高度写回。
  if restorePending and jumpActor ~= nil and jumpActor.isLocal and jumpActor:IsGrounded() then
    applyJumpHeightRestore()
  end

  -- 兜底还原：本地玩家已站在跳布以外并落地一段时间，就把跳跃高度还回进入前的水平，
  -- 避免触发漏事件时把弹跳高度带到普通跳跃上。腾空期间不还原，保证连续弹跳。
  if jumpBoosted and jumpActor ~= nil and jumpActor.isLocal then
    local onMat = zoneActor ~= nil and isAboveMat(jumpActor)
    if onMat or not jumpActor:IsGrounded() then
      offMatTime = 0
    else
      offMatTime = offMatTime + Time.deltaTime
      if offMatTime >= OFF_MAT_RESTORE_DELAY then
        applyJumpHeightRestore()
      end
    end
  end

  -- 玩家落在跳布上时结算一次弹起；弹起后 IsGrounded 变假，不会连续重复触发。
  if zoneActor ~= nil then
    bounceOnMat(zoneActor)
  end

  if not dipActive or jumpMat == nil then return end

  dipElapsed = dipElapsed + Time.deltaTime

  local offset = 0
  if dipElapsed <= DIP_DOWN_TIME then
    offset = -DIP_DEPTH * (dipElapsed / DIP_DOWN_TIME)
  else
    local progress = (dipElapsed - DIP_DOWN_TIME) / DIP_UP_TIME
    if progress >= 1 then
      dipActive = false
    else
      offset = -DIP_DEPTH * math.cos(progress * (math.pi * 0.5))
    end
  end

  local position = jumpMat.localPosition
  jumpMat.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(position.x, matBaseY + offset, position.z)
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  zoneActor = actor
  bounceOnMat(actor)
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  if zoneActor ~= actor then return end

  zoneActor = nil
end

function OnDestroy()
  dipActive = false
  zoneActor = nil
  -- 脚本销毁后不会再有机会补写，直接还原，避免把弹跳高度留在角色身上。
  applyJumpHeightRestore()

  if jumpMat == nil then return end

  local position = jumpMat.localPosition
  jumpMat.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3(position.x, matBaseY, position.z)
end
